why.en: Multiplexing, head-of-line blocking, QUIC, anycast; the course's endpoint, standing almost only on parts built before.

why: the domain step: hold for count and remainder, the flagbyte format

value.zh: 做成了：count 和 remainder 都可以带输入 hold，为 1 的拍不算。
value.en: Done: count and remainder both take an input hold; a tick it is 1 does not count.

value.zh: 做成了：格式 flagbyte，校验位前面补 0 凑成一个字节，和内容一起填充；bytes、ends、sent、relayed 都按它解。
value.en: Done: the format flagbyte, its check bits padded with 0s in front to a whole byte and stuffed with the content; bytes, ends, sent and relayed decode it.

why: The written slots brought in line with the revised blueprint: counter, deserializer and CRC take hold; the deserializer says when its byte is done; the CRC gives the check due next; 1-16 reads it; 1-20 asks which bit flipped, after 1-15

brief.zh: 输出自「重来」上一次为 1 起已经过了几拍（那一拍为 0；「重来」还没为 1 过时，从第一拍数起）；「暂停」为 1 的拍不算，那一拍的数和上一拍相同。
brief.en: Output how many ticks have passed since restart was last 1 (0 on that tick; counted from the first tick before restart is ever 1); ticks on which hold is 1 do not count, and on them the number stays as it was.

t.zh: 要知道一个字节该发到第几位、已经收了几位，板得知道过了几拍；寄存卡只记一个值，手上的元件又都不能让一个数变大。新元件<part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref>给出两个数之和。
t.en: To know which bit of a byte is due, or how many have come in, a board must know how many ticks have passed; a register holds one value, and nothing in hand makes a number grow. The new part <part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref> gives the sum of two numbers.

desc.zh: 自「重来」上一次为 1 起过了几拍：那一拍为 0；「重来」还没为 1 过时从第一拍数起；「暂停」为 1 的拍不算，数停在原处。
desc.en: How many ticks since restart was last 1: 0 on that tick; counted from the first tick before restart is ever 1; ticks on which hold is 1 do not count, and the number stands still.

brief.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起，用 8 拍把那一拍输入的字节从最高位起逐位说到线上，之后说 0；最后一位说出的那一拍，「送完」为 1，其余各拍为 0。
brief.en: From the tick start is 1, say the byte input then on the wire bit by bit from the top over 8 ticks, then say 0; done is 1 on the tick the last bit is said and 0 on every other.

brief.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起（还没为 1 过时从第一拍起），每逢「暂停」为 0 的拍就收进线上的一位，最高位在前；收满 8 位的那一拍，「字节」输出这个字节，「收完」为 1，其余各拍「收完」为 0。
brief.en: From the tick start is 1 (from the first tick, before it ever is), take in the bit on the wire on every tick hold is 0, top bit first; on the tick the eighth is taken, output the byte and make done 1; done is 0 on every other tick.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-7"></level-ref>把一个字节拆成位送出去；线的另一头要把位拼回一个数。
t.en: <level-ref to="1-7"></level-ref> takes a byte apart into bits; the other end of the wire has to put the bits back into a number.

desc.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起（还没为 1 过时从第一拍起），每逢「暂停」为 0 收进一位，最高位在前；收满 8 位的那一拍给出这个字节，「收完」为 1；其余各拍字节是「—」，「收完」为 0。
desc.en: From the tick start is 1 (from the first tick, before it ever is), takes in a bit on every tick hold is 0, top bit first; on the tick the eighth is taken gives the byte with done 1; on every other tick the byte is 「—」 and done 0.

brief.zh: 每一拍输出到这一拍为止收到的位该跟的 3 位校验码：这些位后面补上三个 0、不进位地除以 1011 的余数，写成一个数。「重来」为 1 的那一拍从这一位重新算起；「暂停」为 1 的拍不收这一位。
brief.en: Every tick, output the 3 check bits due after the bits received so far: their carry-less remainder by 1011 with three 0s appended, as a number. On a tick restart is 1, start over from that bit; on a tick hold is 1, leave that bit out.

t.zh: 奇偶校验位只查得出奇数个错位：恰好翻两位时，校验照样相符。更强的校验把一串位当作一个大数，后面补上几个 0，用不进位的除法除以约好的除数（生成式），余数就是要跟在后面的校验码。不进位的除法里，每一步减法都是逐位的异或。
t.en: A parity bit catches only an odd number of flips: with exactly two flipped, it still checks out. A stronger check reads a run of bits as one big number, appends a few 0s and divides it, without carries, by an agreed divisor (the generator); the remainder is the check to send after the bits. In carry-less division, every subtraction is a bitwise XOR.

desc.zh: 到这一拍为止收进的位该跟的 3 位校验码（补上三个 0 后不进位地除以 1011 的余数，0 到 7 的数）；「重来」为 1 的那一拍从这一位重新算起，「暂停」为 1 的拍不收这一位。
desc.en: The 3 check bits due after the bits taken in so far (their carry-less remainder by 1011 with three 0s appended, a number from 0 to 7); on a tick restart is 1 it starts over from that bit, and on a tick hold is 1 it leaves that bit out.

brief.zh: 把交来的字节从第一拍起逐位送出（最高位在前），紧接着送出它的 3 位校验码。
brief.en: Send the byte handed to you bit by bit from the first tick, top bit first, followed at once by its 3 check bits.

brief.zh: 线上从第一拍起接连送来数据块：每块 4 位数据，后面跟 3 位校验码（生成式 1011）；线在每块里最多翻一位。在每块最后一位到达的那一拍，输出这块的第几位翻了（最先到达的是第 1 位，到第 7 位），没有翻就输出 0。
brief.en: Blocks come down the wire back to back from the first tick: 4 data bits each, followed by 3 check bits (generator 1011); the wire flips at most one bit in a block. On the tick each block's last bit arrives, output which of its bits flipped (1 for the first to arrive, up to 7), or 0 if none did.

t.zh: 到目前为止，校验码只用来判断收到的东西是好是坏。这一次每块只有 4 位数据，却带着 3 位校验码。
t.en: So far the check bits have only judged whether something arrived intact. This time each block carries just 4 data bits, and 3 check bits.

brief.zh: 线上从第一拍起接连送来数据块：每块 4 位数据，后面跟 3 位校验码（生成式 1011）；线在每块里最多翻一位。依次输出每块改正后的 4 位数据（写成一个数），早一拍晚一拍不论。
brief.en: Blocks come down the wire back to back from the first tick: 4 data bits each, followed by 3 check bits (generator 1011); the wire flips at most one bit in a block. Output each block's corrected 4 data bits as a number, in order; the tick does not matter.

t.zh: 到目前为止，校验码只用来判断一帧是好是坏。这一次每块只有 4 位数据，却带着 3 位校验码。
t.en: So far the check bits have only judged whether something arrived intact. This time each block carries just 4 data bits, and 3 check bits.

brief.zh: 把交来的字节从第一拍起逐位送出（最高位在前），紧接着送出它的 3 位校验码：让这 11 位不进位地除以 1011 余 0 的那 3 位。
brief.en: Send the byte handed to you bit by bit from the first tick, top bit first, followed at once by its 3 check bits: the three that make the eleven divide by 1011, without carries, leaving 0.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-15"></level-ref>在收的一方算出余数。发送方要在数据后面附上校验码，让整串位的余数为 0，收的一方一除便知是否完好。
t.en: <level-ref to="1-15"></level-ref> works out a remainder at the receiving end. The sender must append check bits that make the remainder of the whole run 0, so that one division tells the receiver whether it is intact.

brief.zh: 每一拍输出到这一拍为止收到的位串不进位地除以 1011 的余数（写成一个数）；「重来」为 1 的那一拍从这一位重新算起。
brief.en: Every tick, output the carry-less remainder of the bits received so far divided by 1011 (as a number); on a tick restart is 1, start over from that bit.

t.zh: 奇偶校验位只查得出奇数个错位：恰好翻两位时，校验照样相符。更强的校验把一串位当作一个大数，用不进位的除法除以约好的除数（生成式），余数就是校验码。不进位的除法里，每一步减法都是逐位的异或。
t.en: A parity bit catches only an odd number of flips: with exactly two flipped, it still checks out. A stronger check reads a run of bits as one big number and divides it, without carries, by an agreed divisor (the generator); the remainder is the check. In carry-less division, every subtraction is a bitwise XOR.

desc.zh: 到这一拍为止收进的位串不进位地除以 1011 的余数（0 到 7 的数）；「重来」为 1 的那一拍从这一位重新算起。
desc.en: The carry-less remainder, by 1011, of the bits taken in so far (a number from 0 to 7); on a tick restart is 1 it starts over from that bit.

brief.zh: 线上从第一拍起接连送来字节，每个字节后面跟一个奇偶校验位（让这 9 位里 1 的个数为偶数），线会翻位。在每个校验位到达的那一拍，「字节」输出收到的字节，「完好」说出校验是否相符；其余各拍两者都是「—」。
brief.en: Bytes come down the wire back to back from the first tick, each followed by a parity bit (making the count of 1s in the nine even), and the wire flips bits. On the tick each parity bit arrives, output the byte received and say whether its parity checks out; 「—」 on both at every other tick.

t.zh: 从这里起，线会把个别的位翻过来。收到的字节错了，收的一方却毫不知情，照样把它交出去。两头于是约好一条规则：发送方在数据后面附一位，收的一方按同一规则核对，就知道数据在线上有没有被改。
t.en: From here on, the wire flips the odd bit. A byte arrives wrong and the receiver hands it on without knowing. So the ends agree on a rule: the sender appends a bit after the data, and the receiver checks it by the same rule to tell whether the data changed on the way.

brief.zh: 线上连续送来位；每当到这一拍为止最近 8 位是 01111110，就在那一拍输出 1，其余各拍输出 0。
brief.en: Bits keep coming down the wire; output 1 on every tick at which the last 8 bits read 01111110, and 0 on every other.

t.zh: 起始位分得出一个个字节，却分不出哪几个字节是一帧：一帧有几个字节，事先并不知道。于是两头约好一个记号 01111110，叫旗标，用它标出一帧的开头和结尾。收的一方要在不停到来的位里随时认出它。
t.en: Start bits separate single bytes but not frames: how many bytes a frame holds is not known in advance. So the ends agree on a mark, 01111110, the flag, to show where a frame begins and ends. The receiver must spot it at any point in the stream of bits.

brief.zh: 把交来的字节依次送出，每个字节前加起始位 1，后加停止位 0；字节送完以后线上一直是 0。说「下一个」为 1 的那一拍取走眼前的字节，下一拍换上后一个。
brief.en: Send the bytes handed to you one after another, each with a start bit 1 before it and a stop bit 0 after; once they are all sent the wire stays 0. Saying next takes the byte in front of you that tick, and the following one shows the tick after.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-9"></level-ref>收的是这样的字节，现在轮到发送一方。要送的字节排成一队，一次只看得见排在最前面的那一个；队伍空了，看到的是「—」。
t.en: <level-ref to="1-9"></level-ref> received bytes like these; now it is the sender's turn. The bytes to send wait in a queue, and only the one in front can be seen; once the queue is empty, it shows 「—」.

brief.zh: 对方随时可能先说一个 1，再送 8 位，最后说一个 0；每收到一个字节，就在它最后一位到达的那一拍输出它，其余各拍输出「—」。
brief.en: At any tick the far end may say a 1, then 8 bits, then a 0; output each byte on the tick its last bit arrives, and 「—」 on every other tick.

t.zh: 发送方随时可能开口，而空着的线读出来是 0：一个以 0 开头的字节和安静的线分不出来，收的一方不知道从哪一拍数起。于是两头约好：字节之前先说一个 1，叫起始位；字节之后说一个 0，叫停止位。
t.en: The sender may begin at any tick, and an idle wire reads 0: a byte that begins with 0s looks just like a quiet wire, and the receiver cannot tell where to start counting. So the ends agree: before a byte comes a 1, the start bit, and after it a 0, the stop bit.

brief.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起（还没为 1 过时从第一拍起），线上连续送来 8 位，最高位在前；收满 8 位的那一拍输出这个字节。
brief.en: From the tick start is 1 (from the first tick, before it ever is), eight bits come down the wire, top bit first; output the byte on the tick the eighth arrives.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-7"></level-ref>把一个字节拆成位送出去；线的另一头要把位拼回一个数。
t.en: <level-ref to="1-7"></level-ref> takes a byte apart into bits; the other end of the wire has to put the bits back into a number.

desc.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起（还没为 1 过时从第一拍起）逐拍收进位，最高位在前；收满 8 位的那一拍给出这个字节，其余各拍给「—」。
desc.en: From the tick start is 1 (from the first tick, before it ever is) takes in a bit a tick, top bit first; gives the byte on the tick the eighth arrives and 「—」 on every other.

brief.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起，用 8 拍把那一拍输入的字节从最高位起逐位说到线上，之后说 0；最后一位说出的那一拍，「送完」为 1，其余各拍为 0。
brief.en: From the tick start is 1, say the byte input on that tick on the wire bit by bit from the top over 8 ticks, then say 0; done is 1 on the tick the last bit is said and 0 on every other.

t.zh: 要送过去的是 0 到 255 的数，线一拍却只送一位。一个字节是 8 位二进制数，每一位的分量是后一位的两倍。新元件<part-ref to="part:bit"></part-ref>从一个数里取出指定的一位，<part-ref to="part:equal"></part-ref>说两个数是否相同。
t.en: What must go across is a number from 0 to 255, but the wire carries one bit a tick. A byte is an 8-bit binary number, each place worth twice the next. The new part <part-ref to="part:bit"></part-ref> takes one given bit out of a number, and <part-ref to="part:equal"></part-ref> says whether two numbers are the same.

desc.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起，用 8 拍把那一拍的字节从最高位起逐位说出，之后说「—」（线上是 0）；说出最后一位的那一拍「送完」为 1。「开始」再为 1 时重新送。
desc.en: From the tick start is 1, says the byte of that tick bit by bit from the top over 8 ticks, then 「—」 (0 on a wire); done is 1 on the tick the last bit is said. Start again sends anew.

brief.zh: 输出自「重来」上一次为 1 起已经过了几拍（那一拍为 0；「重来」还没为 1 过时，从第一拍数起）。
brief.en: Output how many ticks have passed since restart was last 1 (0 on that tick; counted from the first tick before restart is ever 1).

t.zh: 要知道一个字节该发到第几位、已经收了几位，板得知道过了几拍；寄存卡只记一个值，手上的元件又都不能让一个数变大。新元件<part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref>给出两个数之和。
t.en: To know which bit of a byte is due, or how many have come in, a board must know how many ticks have passed; a register holds one value, and nothing in hand makes a number grow. The new part <part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref> gives the sum of two numbers.

desc.zh: 自「重来」上一次为 1 起过了几拍：那一拍为 0；「重来」还没为 1 过时从第一拍数起。
desc.en: How many ticks since restart was last 1: 0 on that tick; counted from the first tick before restart is ever 1.

why: The flags branch finished: the framer (1-12) and the deframer (1-13); start bits, flags and checks as three parallel branches after the byte

brief.zh: 把交来的字节一帧一帧地送出：每帧前后各加旗标 01111110，内容里每连着 5 个 1 就多说一个 0。一帧只在「发送」为 1 的拍开始，两帧之间线上是 0。「下一个」为 1 的那一拍取走眼前的字节，「末字节」说明它是不是这一帧的最后一个。
brief.en: Send the bytes handed to you frame by frame: the flag 01111110 at each end of a frame, and a 0 added after every five 1s in its content. A frame begins only on a tick send is 1, and the wire is 0 between frames. Saying next takes the byte in front of you; last says whether it ends its frame.

t.zh: 旗标标出一帧从哪开始、到哪结束。可一帧的内容本身也可能含有 01111110：收的一方会把它当成旗标，一帧被从中间切断。于是两头再约好一条：内容里每连着 5 个 1，发送方就多说一个 0，收的一方再把它去掉，内容里就永远不会出现旗标。
t.en: Flags mark where a frame begins and ends. But a frame's content may itself hold 01111110: the receiver takes it for a flag and the frame is cut in two. So the ends agree on one more rule: after every five 1s in a row in the content, the sender says an extra 0, and the receiver takes it out again, so the content never looks like a flag.

desc.zh: 把交来的字节一帧一帧地送出：「发送」为 1 的拍开始一帧，前后各加旗标 01111110，内容里每连着 5 个 1 多说一个 0；两帧之间线上是 0。「下一个」为 1 的那一拍取走眼前的字节。
desc.en: Sends the bytes handed to it frame by frame: a frame begins on a tick send is 1, with the flag 01111110 at each end and a 0 added after every five 1s in its content; the wire is 0 between frames. Next is 1 on the tick it takes the byte in front of it.

brief.zh: 从线上认出旗标之间的每一帧，去掉塞进的 0，逐个给出内容字节：一个字节收全的那一拍，「字节」给出它，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完的那一拍，「帧尾」为 1。其余各拍「字节」是「—」，「收到」和「帧尾」为 0。
brief.en: Find each frame between flags on the wire, take out the stuffed 0s and give the content bytes one by one: on the tick a byte is complete, output it and make got 1; on the tick the closing flag is complete, make end 1. On every other tick the byte is 「—」 and got and end are 0.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-12"></level-ref>送出的帧到了线的另一头：收的一方要认出旗标，把塞进的 0 去掉，再把位拼回字节。
t.en: Frames like those of <level-ref to="1-12"></level-ref> reach the other end of the wire: the receiver has to spot the flags, take out the stuffed 0s and put the bits back into bytes.

desc.zh: 在进线的位流里认出旗标之间的每一帧，去掉塞进的 0：一个内容字节收全的那一拍给出它，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完的那一拍「帧尾」为 1；其余各拍字节是「—」，「收到」「帧尾」为 0。
desc.en: Finds each frame between flags in the bits on its wire in and takes out the stuffed 0s: gives each content byte on the tick it is complete, with got 1, and makes end 1 on the tick the closing flag is complete; on every other tick the byte is 「—」 and got and end are 0.

brief.zh: 线会翻位。每帧的内容后面跟一个校验字节（5 个 0，再加整帧内容的 3 位校验码），和内容一起做位填充。逐个给出每帧的内容字节，每个字节在它后面那个字节收全的那一拍给出，同时「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完的那一拍「帧尾」为 1，「完好」说出这一帧是否完好。其余各拍「字节」「完好」是「—」，「收到」「帧尾」为 0。
brief.en: The wire flips bits. Each frame's content is followed by a check byte (five 0s, then the 3 check bits of the whole content), stuffed along with it. Give each frame's content bytes one by one, each on the tick the byte after it is complete, with got 1 on that tick; on the tick the closing flag is complete make end 1 and say in intact whether the frame arrived intact. On every other tick the byte and intact are 「—」, got and end 0.

t.zh: 到这里为止，校验码护着的只是一个字节。一帧有几个字节事先不知道，校验码于是放在整帧的内容后面，补成一个整字节：收的一方要等这一帧收完，才知道哪个字节是校验字节。
t.en: So far a check has guarded a single byte. A frame's length is not known in advance, so its check goes after the whole content, padded to a whole byte: the receiver only knows which byte is the check once the frame is over.

desc.zh: 从进线上拆出每一帧，扣下最后的校验字节：每个内容字节在它后面那个字节收全的那一拍给出，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完的那一拍「帧尾」为 1，「完好」说出这一帧是否完好。其余各拍字节和「完好」是「—」，「收到」「帧尾」为 0。
desc.en: Unwraps each frame off its wire in and holds back the closing check byte: gives each content byte on the tick the byte after it is complete, with got 1; on the tick the closing flag is complete, end is 1 and intact says whether the frame arrived intact. On every other tick the byte and intact are 「—」, got and end 0.

brief.zh: 搭一块网卡，两个方向同时在走。往下：交来的帧带上校验字节，成帧送到出线上；一帧只在「发送」为 1 的拍开始，「下一个」为 1 的那一拍取走眼前的字节。往上：进线上来的帧拆开、核对，每个内容字节在它后面那个字节收全的那一拍交给上面，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完的那一拍「帧尾」为 1，「完好」说出这一帧是否完好。其余各拍「字节」「完好」是「—」，「收到」「帧尾」为 0。
brief.en: Build a network card, with both directions running at once. Down: frames handed to it go out on the wire out, framed with their check byte; a frame begins only on a tick send is 1, and saying next takes the byte in front of you. Up: frames off the wire in are unwrapped and checked, each content byte going up on the tick the byte after it is complete, with got 1; on the tick the closing flag is complete, end is 1 and intact says whether the frame arrived intact. On every other tick the byte and intact are 「—」, got and end 0.

t.zh: 发帧、收帧、查错分在几块板上，每一个要用线的节点都得把它们重新接一遍。把它们装进一块网卡：对上面只收发整帧的字节，对下面只收发线上的位，上面不必知道旗标、填充和校验字节。这叫分层。
t.en: Sending frames, receiving them and checking them sit on separate boards, and every node that uses a wire would have to wire them up again. Put them in one network card: it deals in the bytes of whole frames with the layer above and in bits on the wire below, and the layer above never sees flags, stuffing or the check byte. This is layering.

desc.zh: 往下：交来的帧带上校验字节成帧送到出线上，「发送」为 1 的拍开始一帧，「下一个」为 1 的那一拍取走眼前的字节。往上：进线上来的帧拆开、核对，每个内容字节在它后面那个字节收全的那一拍给出，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完的那一拍「帧尾」为 1，「完好」说出这一帧是否完好。
desc.en: Down: frames handed to it go out on its wire out, framed with their check byte; a frame begins on a tick send is 1, and next is 1 on the tick it takes the byte in front of it. Up: frames off its wire in are unwrapped and checked, each content byte given on the tick the byte after it is complete, with got 1; on the tick the closing flag is complete, end is 1 and intact says whether the frame arrived intact.

brief.zh: 在两根线之间转发：左边进线上来的帧，一个字节一个字节地交给右边的网卡，从右边的出线送出去，不等整帧收完。左边到时是坏的帧，从右边出去也不能是完好的。
brief.en: Forward between two wires: pass each frame from the left wire in on to a card for the right-hand wire out, byte by byte, without waiting for the whole frame. A frame that arrived broken on the left must not leave intact on the right.

t.zh: 一根线只连着两头。要让帧走得更远，中间的节点得把一根线上收到的帧，转到另一根线上去。
t.en: A wire joins only two ends. For a frame to travel further, a node in the middle has to pass what it receives on one wire on to another.

why: copy: the game's title, kicker, lede and era texts; the era-1 encyclopedia, one entry per term, opening where it comes in

value.zh: 从一根线开始
value.en: From One Wire

value.zh: 计算机网络
value.en: Computer networks

value.zh: 一根线，一拍一位，还会出错。从传一位话开始，一层层搭出自己的网卡。
value.en: One wire, one bit a tick, and some bits go wrong. Start by passing a bit on, and build a network adapter of your own, layer by layer.

value.zh: 一根一拍只送一位、还会出错的线，两头怎样互相送出一帧，并知道它完好？
value.en: Over a wire that carries a bit a tick and gets some wrong, how do two ends send each other a frame and know it arrived intact?

ops.zh: 一根线
ops.en: One wire

body.zh: 世界前进的一步。每一拍，每根线送一位，板上的电路从头算一遍：读进来的线，说出去的线，存下要留到下一拍的值。
body.en: One step of the world. On each tick every wire carries one bit and the circuit on the board is worked out afresh: it reads the wires coming in, says on the wires going out, and stores what must last until the next tick.

body.zh: 真实的线路没有拍，位按时钟一个接一个地送；线的两头怎样对齐时钟，属于物理层，这里交给世界去做。
body.en: A real line has no ticks; bits follow one another at a clock rate, and how the two ends keep their clocks in step belongs to the physical layer, which the world here takes care of.

body.zh: 只有两种取值的最小信息单位，记作 0 和 1，也叫位。线上一拍送一位；更大的东西都由一串位组成。
body.en: The smallest unit of information, with just two values, written 0 and 1. A wire carries one bit a tick; anything larger is made of a run of bits.

body.zh: 一位从线的一头说出，到另一头收到，中间隔的时间。这里按拍数计；线越长，延迟越大。
body.en: The time from a bit being said at one end of a wire to its arrival at the other, counted here in ticks; the longer the wire, the longer the delay.

body.zh: 真实网络里，一帧到达的时间还取决于它有多长、线一秒送多少位；一拍只送一位时，这一点还看不出来。
body.en: In a real network, when a frame arrives also depends on how long it is and how many bits a second the line carries; at one bit a tick this does not yet show.

body.zh: 通信双方事先约好的规矩：线上的信号是什么意思，按什么格式、什么顺序说。双方的协议对不上，送过去的位再准确也没有用。
body.en: The rules both sides of a conversation agree on in advance: what the signals on the wire mean, and in what format and order things are said. If the two sides' protocols differ, the bits are useless however faithfully they arrive.

body.zh: 网络里的协议一层叠一层：下面的协议约定怎样送位，上面的协议约定这些位表示什么。
body.en: Protocols in a network stack on one another: those below agree how bits are carried, those above what the bits mean.

body.zh: 只用 0 和 1 两个数字写成的数，每一位的分量是它右边一位的两倍。8 位二进制数从左到右的分量是 128、64、32、16、8、4、2、1，例如 10110010 是 128 + 32 + 16 + 2 = 178。最左边的一位叫最高位。
body.en: A number written with only the digits 0 and 1, each place worth twice the place to its right. The places of an 8-bit binary number are worth 128, 64, 32, 16, 8, 4, 2 and 1 from left to right, so 10110010 is 128 + 32 + 16 + 2 = 178. The leftmost bit is the top bit.

body.zh: 在一根线上把数据一位接一位地送出去。两头要约好位的先后：这里最高位在前。
body.en: Sending data down one wire a bit after another. The two ends must agree on the order of the bits: here the top bit goes first.

body.zh: 真实的串口大多最低位在前，以太网也是逐字节最低位先送；先送哪一位只是约定，要紧的是两头一致。
body.en: Most real serial ports send the lowest bit first, and so does Ethernet within each byte; which end goes first is only a convention, and what matters is that both ends share it.

body.zh: 每个字节之前多说的一位，和线空着时的状态相反，告诉收的一方一个字节从下一拍开始。这样送字节的方式叫异步传输：两头不必事先约好在哪一拍开口。
body.en: An extra bit before each byte, the opposite of the idle wire, telling the receiver that a byte begins on the next tick. Sending bytes this way is asynchronous transmission: the ends need not agree beforehand on when to begin.

body.zh: 真实的串口里线空着时是 1，起始位是 0，停止位是 1；道理相同，只是反过来。
body.en: On a real serial port the idle wire is 1, the start bit 0 and the stop bit 1; the idea is the same, the other way round.

body.zh: 每个字节之后多说的一位，和线空着时的状态相同，让线回到空闲，下一个起始位才认得出来。
body.en: An extra bit after each byte, the same as the idle wire, which returns the wire to rest so that the next start bit can be seen.

body.zh: 在一根线上作为一个整体送出的一段数据：开头和结尾都有标记，收的一方据此把它从位流里分出来。帧有多长，事先不一定知道。
body.en: A piece of data sent over a link as one whole, marked at its start and end so the receiver can pick it out of the stream of bits. Its length need not be known in advance.

body.zh: 标出一帧开头和结尾的固定位串 01111110。HDLC 和 PPP 这类协议用的就是它。
body.en: The fixed bit pattern 01111110 that marks where a frame begins and ends. Protocols such as HDLC and PPP use exactly this one.

body.zh: 发送方在帧的内容里每连着 5 个 1 之后多说一个 0，收的一方再把它去掉。这样内容里永远不会连着出现 6 个 1，也就不会被误认成旗标。代价是帧变长了一点，长多少取决于内容。
body.en: After every five 1s in a row in a frame's content the sender adds a 0, and the receiver takes it out again. The content then never holds six 1s in a row, so it cannot be mistaken for a flag. The price is a slightly longer frame, by an amount that depends on the content.

body.zh: 发送方按约好的规则在数据后面附上几位校验位，收的一方按同一规则核对，以此判断数据在路上有没有被改。查出错只说明数据坏了，并不能把它改回来。
body.en: The sender appends a few check bits to the data by an agreed rule, and the receiver checks them by the same rule to tell whether the data changed on the way. Detecting an error says only that the data is damaged; it does not put it right.

body.zh: 没有一种校验查得出所有错误：线恰好把数据改成另一份校验也相符的数据时，就查不出来。校验位越多、规则越好，这种情况越少。
body.en: No check catches every error: if the wire happens to turn the data into other data whose check also matches, nothing shows. More check bits and a better rule make this rarer.

body.zh: 附在数据后面的一位，使连它在内的 1 的个数为偶数（偶校验）或奇数（奇校验）。这里用偶校验。
body.en: A bit appended to data so that the count of 1s, itself included, is even (even parity) or odd (odd parity). Even parity is used here.

body.zh: 像竖式长除法一样一步步除，只是加减都不进位、不借位：每一位上 0 和 1 的加和减都相同，结果是两位不同为 1、相同为 0。也叫模 2 除法。
body.en: Long division done step by step as usual, except that adding and subtracting never carry or borrow: in each place, adding and subtracting 0s and 1s come to the same thing, 1 when the two bits differ and 0 when they agree. It is also called modulo-2 division.

body.zh: CRC 里两头约好的除数，写成一串位，最高位总是 1。生成式有 n + 1 位，校验码就有 n 位：1011 给出 3 位校验码。
body.en: The divisor both ends agree on for a CRC, written as a run of bits whose top bit is always 1. A generator of n + 1 bits gives an n-bit check: 1011 gives a 3-bit check.

body.zh: 真实网络用的生成式长得多，以太网用的是 33 位的生成式，校验码有 32 位。
body.en: Real networks use much longer generators; Ethernet's has 33 bits and gives a 32-bit check.

body.zh: 一种差错检测：把数据当作一个大数，后面补上和校验码一样多的 0，不进位地除以生成式，余数就是校验码，跟在数据后面送出。简称 CRC。
body.en: A kind of error detection: the data is read as one big number, as many 0s as the check has bits are appended, and it is divided without carries by the generator; the remainder is the check, sent after the data. It is known as CRC.

body.zh: 它查得出奇偶校验漏掉的许多错误，硬件上又便宜，所以几乎每一种链路都用它。这里的生成式只有 4 位，查错能力远不如真实的 CRC。
body.en: It catches many errors that parity misses and is cheap in hardware, so nearly every kind of link uses it. The generator here has only 4 bits and catches far less than a real CRC.

body.zh: 把通信分成几层，每一层只用下一层提供的服务，也只向上一层提供自己的服务。网卡对上面只收发整帧的字节，对下面只收发位；上面不必知道旗标、填充和校验字节，换一种成帧的办法也不必改上面。
body.en: Dividing communication into layers, each using only the service of the layer below and offering only its own to the layer above. A network adapter deals in the bytes of whole frames with the layer above and in bits with the wire below; the layer above never sees flags, stuffing or check bytes, and a different way of framing would not change it.

body.zh: 这一层叫数据链路层：它负责一根线两头之间的帧。真实的网卡还有地址、介质访问等许多事要做。
body.en: This layer is the data link layer: it looks after frames between the two ends of one link. A real network adapter also deals with addresses, access to the medium and much else.

body.zh: 转发的节点不等一帧全部收完，收到开头就往下一根线上送。帧走得更快，代价是帧尾的校验到达之前，它已经送出去了大半。与它相对的是先把整帧存下、核对完再转发的存储转发。
body.en: A forwarding node sends a frame on to the next wire as soon as its start is in, without waiting for the whole of it. Frames move faster, at the price that most of a frame has gone on before its check arrives. The alternative is store-and-forward: hold the whole frame, check it, then send it on.

body.zh: 数据位和它的校验位合在一起的一整串位。4 位数据加 3 位校验码，就是 7 位的码字。
body.en: The data bits and their check bits together, as one run of bits. 4 data bits with a 3-bit check make a 7-bit codeword.

body.zh: 收的一方不只查出数据错了，还找出错在哪里并改回来，不必请对方重发。代价是要多附校验位。延迟很长、或者没法重发的地方，例如深空通信和存储介质，都靠纠错码。
body.en: The receiver not only finds that data is wrong but finds where, and puts it right without asking for it again. The price is more check bits. Where delays are long or a resend is impossible, as in deep-space links and storage media, error-correcting codes do the work.

body.zh: 世界前进的一步：每一拍，每根线送一位，板上的电路算一遍。
body.en: One step of the world: each tick every wire carries one bit and the board computes once.

value.zh: 一根一拍送一位、还会出错的线，怎样让两头可靠地交换一帧？
value.en: How do two ends exchange a frame over a wire that carries a bit a tick and gets some wrong?

value.zh: 一根线，每一拍送一位。从传一位话开始，一层层搭出能可靠地收发一帧的网卡。
value.en: One wire, one bit a tick. Start by passing a bit on, and build up, layer by layer, a network card that sends and receives a frame reliably.

value.zh: 开发中
value.en: In development

value.zh: network
value.en: network

why: copy: era 1 levels rewritten (briefs within length and with exact timing, intros that assemble the machine, hints, links to the encyclopedia)

body.zh: 8 位合成的一组，可以看作 0 到 255 的一个数。网络里的数据大多按字节计。
body.en: A group of 8 bits, which can be read as a number from 0 to 255. Most data on a network is measured in bytes.

brief.zh: 每一拍把左线上听到的位说到右线上。
brief.en: Every tick, say on the right wire the bit heard on the left wire.

t.zh: 两头之间只有一根线。线上分得出的只有两种状态，记作 0 和 1；两头对它们的约定，就是最初的<wiki-ref to="protocol"></wiki-ref>。线每<wiki-ref to="tick"></wiki-ref>送一<wiki-ref to="bit"></wiki-ref>，从一头说出，过几拍才到另一头，中间隔的拍数叫<wiki-ref to="delay"></wiki-ref>。这块板夹在两根线中间。
t.en: There is only a wire between the two ends. It shows just two states, written 0 and 1, and what the ends agree they mean is their first <wiki-ref to="protocol"></wiki-ref>. The wire carries one <wiki-ref to="bit"></wiki-ref> a <wiki-ref to="tick"></wiki-ref>: said at one end, it reaches the other some ticks later, and the ticks in between are the wire's <wiki-ref to="delay"></wiki-ref>. This board sits between two wires.

hint.zh: 这一关不必再放元件。
hint.en: No more parts are needed here.

hint.zh: 从左线的输出口拉一根连线，接到右线上。
hint.en: Draw a connection from the left wire's output to the right wire.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-1"></level-ref>的板只能原样照搬：线上来什么，就说什么。要说出和听到的不一样的位，板得能按条件改变一个值。新元件<part-ref to="part:select"></part-ref>按条件在两路之间取一路，<part-ref to="part:const"></part-ref>给出一个固定的数。
t.en: The board of <level-ref to="1-1"></level-ref> can only copy: whatever comes down the wire is what it says. To say a bit other than the one it hears, a board must change a value by a condition. The new part <part-ref to="part:select"></part-ref> picks one of two values by a condition, and <part-ref to="part:const"></part-ref> gives a fixed number.

hint.zh: 听到的位本身就可以当作条件。
hint.en: The bit you hear can itself be the condition.

hint.zh: 听到 1 时该说什么、听到 0 时该说什么，各由一个常数给出。
hint.en: What to say on a 1 and what to say on a 0 can each come from a constant.

t.zh: 到这里为止，说什么只取决于一根线。这一次板要同时听两根线，说出的位由两根线一起决定。
t.en: So far what the board says has depended on one wire. Now it listens to two, and what it says depends on both.

hint.zh: 先固定一根线的值，看另一根线该怎样决定输出。
hint.en: Hold one wire still and see how the other should decide the output.

hint.zh: 线 A 为 0 时，输出和线 B 是什么关系？线 A 为 1 时呢？
hint.en: When wire A is 0, how does the output relate to wire B? And when A is 1?

t.zh: 板上的电路每一拍从头算一遍，算完什么也不留下：上一拍听到了什么，这一拍无从知道。要把一个值留到下一拍，需要一对新元件：<part-ref to="part:keep"></part-ref>把值存进寄存卡，<part-ref to="part:reg"></part-ref>在下一拍读出它。
t.en: The circuit on the board is worked out afresh every tick and keeps nothing afterwards: what it heard the tick before is lost. Keeping a value for the next tick takes a new pair of parts: <part-ref to="part:keep"></part-ref> stores a value in a register, and <part-ref to="part:reg"></part-ref> reads it out the next tick.

hint.zh: 这一拍听到的，要到下一拍才说出去。
hint.en: What is heard this tick is said only on the next.

hint.zh: 存和读靠同一个寄存卡名字配对；第一拍读出的是初值。
hint.en: Keep and Register pair up by the register's name; on the first tick Register gives its start value.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-4"></level-ref>里，寄存卡存的是线上来的位。存进去的也可以是板上算出的任何值，下一拍再拿来接着算。
t.en: In <level-ref to="1-4"></level-ref> the register kept the bit off the wire. It can keep anything the board works out, to be worked on again the next tick.

hint.zh: 要记住的是「到现在为止听到过 1 没有」。
hint.en: What has to be remembered is whether a 1 has been heard yet.

hint.zh: 这一拍该说什么，取决于这一拍听到的和上一拍记下的。
hint.en: What to say this tick depends on what is heard now and what was kept last tick.

hint.zh: 听到 1 的那一拍就要说 1，不能等到下一拍。
hint.en: On the very tick a 1 is heard, the board must already say 1, not a tick later.

t.zh: 要知道一个字节该发到第几位、已经收了几位，板得知道过了几拍。寄存卡只记得住一个值，手上的元件又都不能让一个数变大。新元件<part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref>给出两个数之和。
t.en: To know which bit of a byte is due, or how many have come in, a board must know how many ticks have passed. A register holds a single value, and nothing in hand can make a number grow. The new part <part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref> gives the sum of two numbers.

hint.zh: 先不管「重来」和「暂停」，只让输出每拍大一。
hint.en: Leave restart and hold aside at first, and just make the output grow by one each tick.

hint.zh: 「重来」那一拍的数是 0；「暂停」那一拍的数和上一拍一样。两种情况各由一个选择决定。
hint.en: On a restart tick the number is 0; on a hold tick it is what it was. Each case is a choice of its own.

hint.zh: 要留到下一拍的值不止一个时，就用几个名字不同的寄存卡。
hint.en: When more than one value has to last until the next tick, use registers with different names.

t.zh: 要送过去的是 0 到 255 的数，线一拍却只送一位。一个<wiki-ref to="byte"></wiki-ref>是 8 位的<wiki-ref to="binary"></wiki-ref>，每一位的分量是后一位的两倍；把它拆成位，一拍一位地说出去，叫<wiki-ref to="serial"></wiki-ref>。新元件<part-ref to="part:bit"></part-ref>从一个数里取出指定的一位，<part-ref to="part:equal"></part-ref>说两个数是否相同。
t.en: What must go across is a number from 0 to 255, but the wire carries one bit a tick. A <wiki-ref to="byte"></wiki-ref> is an 8-bit <wiki-ref to="binary"></wiki-ref>, each place worth twice the next; taking it apart and saying it a bit a tick is <wiki-ref to="serial"></wiki-ref>. The new part <part-ref to="part:bit"></part-ref> takes a given bit out of a number, and <part-ref to="part:equal"></part-ref> says whether two numbers are the same.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref>说得出从「开始」起过了几拍。
hint.en: <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref> can tell how many ticks have passed since start.

hint.zh: 「开始」之前和 8 位说完以后，线上都要是 0。
hint.en: The wire must be 0 before start and after the eighth bit.

hint.zh: 说到一半时，输入上的字节可能已经换了。
hint.en: Halfway through, the byte on the input may already have changed.

brief.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起（还没为 1 过时从第一拍起），「暂停」为 0 的拍收进线上的一位，最高位在前；收满 8 位的那一拍输出这个字节，「收完」为 1，其余各拍为 0。
brief.en: From the tick start is 1 (from the first tick, before it ever is), take in the wire's bit on each tick hold is 0, top bit first; on the tick the eighth comes in, output the byte and make done 1, and 0 on every other tick.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-7"></level-ref>把一个字节拆成位送了出去。这一次换到线的另一头：把一位一位到来的位拼回一个数。
t.en: <level-ref to="1-7"></level-ref> takes a byte apart into bits and sends them. Now the board is at the other end of the wire, putting the bits back into a number as they come.

hint.zh: 每收进一位，已经攒下的数要怎样变，才能让先到的位分量更大？
hint.en: With each new bit, what must happen to the number held so far, so that earlier bits end up worth more?

hint.zh: 已经收了几位，<part-ref to="counter"></part-ref>数得出来；「暂停」的拍它也不数。
hint.en: <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref> can count the bits taken in, and it skips the hold ticks too.

hint.zh: 「开始」那一拍收进的就是第一位，之前攒下的都不算。
hint.en: The bit on the start tick is the first one; whatever was gathered before it does not count.

t.zh: 发送方随时可能开口，而空着的线读出来是 0：一个以 0 开头的字节和安静的线分不出来，收的一方不知道从哪一拍数起。于是两头约好：字节之前先说一个 1，叫<wiki-ref to="start-bit"></wiki-ref>；字节之后说一个 0，叫<wiki-ref to="stop-bit"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: The sender may begin at any tick, and an idle wire reads 0: a byte that begins with 0s looks just like a quiet wire, and the receiver cannot tell where to start counting. So the ends agree that a 1, the <wiki-ref to="start-bit"></wiki-ref>, comes before each byte, and a 0, the <wiki-ref to="stop-bit"></wiki-ref>, after it.

hint.zh: 线空着的时候，来的第一个 1 就是起始位。
hint.en: While the wire is idle, the first 1 to come is a start bit.

hint.zh: 正在收一个字节时，线上的 1 是数据，不是起始位。
hint.en: While a byte is coming in, a 1 on the wire is data, not a start bit.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="deserializer"></part-ref>从「开始」那一拍收进第一位。
hint.en: <part-ref to="deserializer"></part-ref> takes in its first bit on the start tick.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-9"></level-ref>收的是这样的字节，这一次换到发送的一方。要送的字节排成一队，板只看得见排在最前面的那一个；队伍空了，看到的是「—」。
t.en: <level-ref to="1-9"></level-ref> received bytes like these; now the board is the sender. The bytes to send wait in a queue, and only the one in front can be seen; once the queue is empty, it shows 「—」.

hint.zh: 一个字节连同起始位和停止位，一共占 10 拍。
hint.en: A byte with its start and stop bits takes 10 ticks.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="serializer"></part-ref>只说那 8 位，起始位那一拍要另外说。
hint.en: <part-ref to="serializer"></part-ref> says only the 8 bits; the start bit's tick is up to you.

hint.zh: 队伍空了以后，也不能再说起始位。
hint.en: Once the queue is empty, no more start bits either.

t.zh: 要送的往往不止一个字节，而是一串字节合成的一<wiki-ref to="frame"></wiki-ref>，有几个字节事先不知道。收的一方只看见不停到来的位，分不出一帧从哪里开始、到哪里结束。两头于是约好一个记号 01111110，叫<wiki-ref to="flag"></wiki-ref>，放在每一帧的开头和结尾；收的一方要在位流里随时认出它。
t.en: What goes across is often not one byte but a <wiki-ref to="frame"></wiki-ref>, a run of bytes whose length is not known in advance. The receiver sees only bits that keep coming, and cannot tell where a frame begins or ends. So the ends agree on a mark, 01111110, the <wiki-ref to="flag"></wiki-ref>, at each end of every frame; the receiver must spot it anywhere in the stream.

hint.zh: 旗标是一个 0，接着六个 1，再接一个 0。
hint.en: A flag is a 0, then six 1s, then a 0.

hint.zh: 数一数到这一拍为止连着来了几个 1，来了 0 就从头数。
hint.en: Count how many 1s in a row have come so far, starting over at each 0.

hint.zh: 那六个 1 前面必须真有一个 0：线一开始就来的 1 不算。
hint.en: The six 1s must really follow a 0: 1s from the very first tick do not count.

brief.zh: 一帧一帧送出交来的字节：前后加旗标 01111110，内容里每连着 5 个 1 多说一个 0。帧只在「发送」为 1 时开始，帧间线上为 0；「下一个」取走队首，「末字节」标出帧尾。
brief.en: Send the bytes handed to you frame by frame: the flag 01111110 at each end, and a 0 added after every five 1s in the content. A frame starts only on a tick send is 1, and the wire is 0 between frames. Next takes the byte in front; last marks a frame's final byte.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-11"></level-ref>里，旗标标出一帧的开头和结尾。可帧的内容本身也可能含有 01111110：收的一方会把它当成旗标，一帧被从中间切断。两头于是再约好一条：内容里每连着 5 个 1，发送方就多说一个 0，收的一方再把它去掉。这叫<wiki-ref to="stuffing"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: In <level-ref to="1-11"></level-ref> flags mark where a frame begins and ends. But the content itself may hold 01111110: the receiver takes it for a flag and the frame is cut in two. So the ends agree on one more rule: after every five 1s in a row in the content the sender says an extra 0, and the receiver takes it out again. This is <wiki-ref to="stuffing"></wiki-ref>.

hint.zh: 旗标原样说出，不做填充；填充只管内容。
hint.en: Flags go out as they are, unstuffed; only the content is stuffed.

hint.zh: 多说 0 的那一拍，内容停一拍不走：正在说的那一位留到下一拍。
hint.en: On the tick of the extra 0 the content stands still: the bit that was due waits a tick.

hint.zh: 该不该多说一个 0，要看刚说出去的内容里连着几个 1。
hint.en: Whether an extra 0 is due depends on how many 1s in a row the content has just put on the wire.

brief.zh: 认出线上旗标之间的每一帧，去掉塞进的 0，逐个给出内容字节：字节收全的那一拍输出它，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完的那一拍「帧尾」为 1。其余各拍字节为「—」，两个信号为 0。
brief.en: Find each frame between flags on the wire, take out the stuffed 0s and give the content bytes one by one: output each on the tick it is complete, with got 1; end is 1 on the tick the closing flag is complete. Otherwise the byte is 「—」 and both signals 0.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-12"></level-ref>送出的帧到了线的另一头。这一次在收的一方：认出旗标，去掉塞进的 0，把位拼回字节。
t.en: Frames like those of <level-ref to="1-12"></level-ref> reach the other end of the wire. Now the board is the receiver: spotting flags, taking out the stuffed 0s and putting the bits back into bytes.

hint.zh: 连着五个 1 之后来的 0 是塞进去的，不算内容。
hint.en: A 0 that comes after five 1s in a row was stuffed in and is not content.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="deserializer"></part-ref>在「暂停」的拍不收线上的位。
hint.en: <part-ref to="deserializer"></part-ref> leaves out the wire's bit on hold ticks.

hint.zh: 结尾旗标的 8 位收齐时，看起来也像收满了一个字节。
hint.en: When the 8 bits of the closing flag are in, they look like a full byte too.

brief.zh: 从第一拍起，线上接连送来字节，每个后跟一个校验位，使这 9 位里 1 的个数为偶数；线会翻位。每个校验位到达的那一拍，输出收到的字节和校验是否相符，其余各拍为「—」。
brief.en: From the first tick, bytes come down the wire back to back, each followed by a bit that makes the count of 1s in the nine even; the wire flips bits. On the tick each such bit arrives, output the byte received and whether it checks out; 「—」 on every other tick.

t.zh: 从这里起，线会把个别的位翻过来。收到的字节错了，收的一方却毫不知情，照样把它交出去。两头于是约好一条规则：发送方在数据后面附几位，收的一方按同一规则核对，就知道数据在线上有没有被改。这叫<wiki-ref to="error-detection"></wiki-ref>。最简单的规则只附一位，让 1 的个数凑成偶数，叫<wiki-ref to="parity"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: From here on, the wire flips the odd bit. A byte arrives wrong and the receiver hands it on without knowing. So the ends agree on a rule: the sender appends a few bits to the data, and the receiver checks them by the same rule to tell whether the data changed on the way. This is <wiki-ref to="error-detection"></wiki-ref>. The simplest rule appends one bit that makes the count of 1s even: a <wiki-ref to="parity"></wiki-ref>.

hint.zh: 1 的个数是奇是偶，可以一位一位地跟着记。
hint.en: Whether the count of 1s is odd or even can be tracked bit by bit.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="xor"></part-ref>把记下的奇偶和新来的一位合成新的奇偶。
hint.en: <part-ref to="xor"></part-ref> folds a new bit into the parity kept so far.

hint.zh: 字节一个接一个，中间没有空拍：每 9 拍从头算起。
hint.en: The bytes come back to back with no gap: start afresh every 9 ticks.

brief.zh: 每一拍输出到这一拍为止收到的位该跟的 3 位校验码，即这些位补上三个 0 后不进位地除以 1011 的余数；「重来」为 1 的拍从这一位重新算起，「暂停」为 1 的拍不收这一位。
brief.en: Every tick, output the 3 check bits due after the bits received so far: their carry-less remainder by 1011 with three 0s appended, as a number. On a tick restart is 1, start over from that bit; on a tick hold is 1, leave that bit out.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-14"></level-ref>的校验位只查得出奇数个错位：恰好翻两位时，校验照样相符。
t.en: The parity bit of <level-ref to="1-14"></level-ref> catches only an odd number of flips: with exactly two flipped, it still checks out.

t.zh: 更强的校验把一串位当作一个大数，后面补上几个 0，用<wiki-ref to="carryless"></wiki-ref>除以约好的除数，这个除数叫<wiki-ref to="generator"></wiki-ref>；余数就是跟在数据后面的校验码。这种校验叫<wiki-ref to="crc"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: A stronger check reads a run of bits as one big number, appends a few 0s and divides it by <wiki-ref to="carryless"></wiki-ref> by an agreed divisor, the <wiki-ref to="generator"></wiki-ref>; the remainder is the check sent after the data. This check is a <wiki-ref to="crc"></wiki-ref>.

hint.zh: 先在纸上把 1101 补上 000，不进位地除以 1011，看每一步余数怎样变。
hint.en: On paper, append 000 to 1101 and divide it by 1011 without carries, watching the remainder at each step.

hint.zh: 三个寄存卡各记一位，就记得下除到这一拍为止的结果。
hint.en: Three registers, a bit each, are enough to hold where the division stands.

hint.zh: 要的是补上三个 0 以后的余数：新来的一位先和结果的最高位比一比，再决定这一步减不减生成式。
hint.en: What is wanted is the remainder with three 0s appended: compare each new bit with the top bit held before deciding whether this step subtracts the generator.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-15"></level-ref>在收的一方算出校验码。这一次换到发送的一方：校验码要紧跟在数据后面送出去。
t.en: <level-ref to="1-15"></level-ref> works out the check at the receiving end. Now the board is the sender, and the check has to follow the data onto the wire.

hint.zh: 说到线上的每一位，也要同时交给<part-ref to="crc"></part-ref>。
hint.en: Every bit said on the wire should also go to <part-ref to="crc"></part-ref>.

hint.zh: 字节说完以后，<part-ref to="crc"></part-ref>不该再收位，不然校验码会跟着变。
hint.en: Once the byte is out, <part-ref to="crc"></part-ref> must take in no more bits, or the check moves.

hint.zh: 校验码是 0 到 7 的数：它的 3 位排在一个 8 位数的最后。
hint.en: The check is a number from 0 to 7: its 3 bits are the last three of an 8-bit number.

brief.zh: 逐个给出每帧的内容字节（校验字节除外）：每个在后一个字节收全的那一拍给出，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完时「帧尾」为 1，「完好」说出这帧是否完好；其余各拍为「—」或 0。
brief.en: Give each frame's content bytes, the check byte aside: each on the tick the byte after it is complete, with got 1. When the closing flag is complete, end is 1 and intact says whether the frame arrived intact. On every other tick, 「—」 or 0.

t.zh: 到这里为止，校验码护着的只是一个字节，线照样会翻位。一帧有几个字节事先不知道，校验码于是放在整帧内容的后面：前面补 5 个 0 凑成一个校验字节，和内容一起做位填充。收的一方要等这一帧结束，才知道最后收到的是校验字节。
t.en: So far a check has guarded a single byte, and the wire still flips bits. A frame's length is not known in advance, so its check goes after the whole content: five 0s in front make it a check byte, stuffed along with the content. Only when the frame ends does the receiver know the last byte was the check.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="deframer"></part-ref>交出的每个字节，都可能是最后那个校验字节。
hint.en: Any byte <part-ref to="deframer"></part-ref> gives could be the closing check byte.

hint.zh: 一个字节先留住，等下一个字节收全时再交出去。
hint.en: Hold each byte back until the next one is complete, then pass it on.

hint.zh: 帧尾那一拍，<part-ref to="crc"></part-ref>收进的应当只有内容字节的位。
hint.en: By the frame's end, <part-ref to="crc"></part-ref> should have taken in the bits of the content bytes and nothing else.

brief.zh: 搭一块网卡，两个方向同时工作。往下：交来的帧带上校验字节成帧，从出线送出，「发送」为 1 时开始，「下一个」取走队首。往上：进线上的帧拆开、核对，输出的时机同<part-ref to="receiver"></part-ref>。
brief.en: Build a network adapter that works both ways at once. Down: frames handed to it go out on the wire out, framed with their check byte, starting on a tick send is 1, next taking the byte in front. Up: frames off the wire in are unwrapped and checked, timed as in <part-ref to="receiver"></part-ref>.

t.zh: 发帧和收帧各是一个元件，查错的校验码又要另外算：每一个要用线的节点，都得把它们重新接一遍。把它们装进一块网卡：对上面只收发整帧的字节，对下面只收发线上的位，上面不必知道旗标、填充和校验字节。这叫<wiki-ref to="layering"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: Sending frames and receiving them are separate parts, and the check is worked out apart from both: every node that uses a wire would have to wire them up again. Put them into one network adapter: it deals in the bytes of whole frames with the layer above and in bits on the wire below, and the layer above never sees flags, stuffing or the check byte. This is <wiki-ref to="layering"></wiki-ref>.

hint.zh: 两个方向互不相干；往上的一半，手上已经有现成的元件。
hint.en: The two directions do not touch each other, and a part in hand already does the upward half.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="framer"></part-ref>只送交给它的字节：校验字节要在最后一个内容字节之后交给它。
hint.en: <part-ref to="framer"></part-ref> sends only the bytes it is given: the check byte has to be given to it after the last content byte.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="crc"></part-ref>要收的是内容字节本身的位，不是线上带着旗标和填充的位；整帧内容收完时的结果要留住。
hint.en: <part-ref to="crc"></part-ref> must take in the bits of the content bytes, not the wire's bits with flags and stuffing; keep its result from the moment the whole content is in.

after.zh: 从这里起，用线的节点只和网卡打交道：每一层只管自己的事。
after.en: From here on a node that uses a wire deals only with its adapter: each layer minds its own business.

brief.zh: 在两根线之间转发：左边进线上来的帧，一个字节一个字节地交给右边的网卡，从右边的出线送出，不等整帧收完。左边到时是坏的帧，从右边出去也不能是完好的。
brief.en: Forward between two wires: pass each frame from the left wire in to an adapter on the right wire out, byte by byte, without waiting for the whole frame. A frame that arrived broken on the left must not leave intact on the right.

t.zh: 一根线只连着两头。要让帧走得更远，中间的节点得把一根线上收到的帧，转到另一根线上去。不等整帧收完就往外转，叫<wiki-ref to="cut-through"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: A wire joins only two ends. For a frame to travel further, a node in the middle must pass what it receives on one wire on to another. Passing it on before the whole frame is in is <wiki-ref to="cut-through"></wiki-ref>.

hint.zh: 左边的网卡往上交字节，右边的网卡从上面取字节，两边的快慢并不一样。
hint.en: The left adapter hands bytes up and the right one takes them from above, and the two do not keep the same pace.

hint.zh: 右边要取字节的时候，左边未必刚好交来一个：中间要存得下几个字节。
hint.en: When the right side wants a byte, the left may not have one just then: the middle must hold a few.

hint.zh: 坏帧到帧尾才认得出，那时它的大部分已经送了出去；能动的只剩还没送出的那几位。
hint.en: A bad frame shows only at its end, when most of it has already gone out; all that can still change is the bits not yet sent.

brief.zh: 线上从第一拍起接连送来 7 位的码字：4 位数据加 3 位校验码（生成式 1011），每个码字最多翻一位。在码字最后一位到达的那一拍，输出翻的是第几位（先到的为第 1 位），没翻就输出 0。
brief.en: Codewords of 7 bits come down the wire back to back from the first tick: 4 data bits, then 3 check bits (generator 1011), with at most one bit flipped in each. On the tick a codeword's last bit arrives, output which bit flipped (the first to arrive is 1), or 0 if none did.

t.zh: 到这里为止，校验码只用来判断收到的东西是好是坏。这一次每个<wiki-ref to="codeword"></wiki-ref>只有 4 位数据，却带着 3 位校验码。
t.en: So far check bits have only judged whether something arrived intact. This time each <wiki-ref to="codeword"></wiki-ref> carries just 4 data bits, and 3 check bits.

hint.zh: 先在纸上算：没有翻位时余数是多少？只翻第 1 位时呢？
hint.en: Work it out on paper first: what is the remainder when nothing flipped? When only bit 1 flipped?

after.zh: 余数不只说出有没有错，还说得出错在哪里：校验码从此也能用来<wiki-ref to="error-correction"></wiki-ref>。
after.en: A remainder says not only whether something went wrong but where: from here a check can also serve for <wiki-ref to="error-correction"></wiki-ref>.

brief.zh: 线上从第一拍起接连送来数据块：每块 4 位数据，后面跟 3 位校验码（生成式 1011）；线在每块里最多翻一位。在每块最后一位到达的那一拍，输出这块的第几位翻了（最先到达的是第 1 位，到第 7 位），没有翻就输出 0。
brief.en: Blocks come down the wire back to back from the first tick: 4 data bits each, followed by 3 check bits (generator 1011); the wire flips at most one bit in a block. On the tick each block's last bit arrives, output which of its bits flipped (1 for the first to arrive, up to 7), or 0 if none did.

t.zh: 到目前为止，校验码只用来判断收到的东西是好是坏。这一次每块只有 4 位数据，却带着 3 位校验码。
t.en: So far the check bits have only judged whether something arrived intact. This time each block carries just 4 data bits, and 3 check bits.

brief.zh: 在两根线之间转发：左边进线上来的帧，一个字节一个字节地交给右边的网卡，从右边的出线送出去，不等整帧收完。左边到时是坏的帧，从右边出去也不能是完好的。
brief.en: Forward between two wires: pass each frame from the left wire in on to a card for the right-hand wire out, byte by byte, without waiting for the whole frame. A frame that arrived broken on the left must not leave intact on the right.

t.zh: 一根线只连着两头。要让帧走得更远，中间的节点得把一根线上收到的帧，转到另一根线上去。
t.en: A wire joins only two ends. For a frame to travel further, a node in the middle has to pass what it receives on one wire on to another.

brief.zh: 搭一块网卡，两个方向同时在走。往下：交来的帧带上校验字节，成帧送到出线上；一帧只在「发送」为 1 的拍开始，「下一个」为 1 的那一拍取走眼前的字节。往上：进线上来的帧拆开、核对，每个内容字节在它后面那个字节收全的那一拍交给上面，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完的那一拍「帧尾」为 1，「完好」说出这一帧是否完好。其余各拍「字节」「完好」是「—」，「收到」「帧尾」为 0。
brief.en: Build a network card, with both directions running at once. Down: frames handed to it go out on the wire out, framed with their check byte; a frame begins only on a tick send is 1, and saying next takes the byte in front of you. Up: frames off the wire in are unwrapped and checked, each content byte going up on the tick the byte after it is complete, with got 1; on the tick the closing flag is complete, end is 1 and intact says whether the frame arrived intact. On every other tick the byte and intact are 「—」, got and end 0.

t.zh: 发帧、收帧、查错分在几块板上，每一个要用线的节点都得把它们重新接一遍。把它们装进一块网卡：对上面只收发整帧的字节，对下面只收发线上的位，上面不必知道旗标、填充和校验字节。这叫分层。
t.en: Sending frames, receiving them and checking them sit on separate boards, and every node that uses a wire would have to wire them up again. Put them in one network card: it deals in the bytes of whole frames with the layer above and in bits on the wire below, and the layer above never sees flags, stuffing or the check byte. This is layering.

desc.zh: 往下：交来的帧带上校验字节成帧送到出线上，「发送」为 1 的拍开始一帧，「下一个」为 1 的那一拍取走眼前的字节。往上：进线上来的帧拆开、核对，每个内容字节在它后面那个字节收全的那一拍给出，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完的那一拍「帧尾」为 1，「完好」说出这一帧是否完好。
desc.en: Down: frames handed to it go out on its wire out, framed with their check byte; a frame begins on a tick send is 1, and next is 1 on the tick it takes the byte in front of it. Up: frames off its wire in are unwrapped and checked, each content byte given on the tick the byte after it is complete, with got 1; on the tick the closing flag is complete, end is 1 and intact says whether the frame arrived intact.

brief.zh: 线会翻位。每帧的内容后面跟一个校验字节（5 个 0，再加整帧内容的 3 位校验码），和内容一起做位填充。逐个给出每帧的内容字节，每个字节在它后面那个字节收全的那一拍给出，同时「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完的那一拍「帧尾」为 1，「完好」说出这一帧是否完好。其余各拍「字节」「完好」是「—」，「收到」「帧尾」为 0。
brief.en: The wire flips bits. Each frame's content is followed by a check byte (five 0s, then the 3 check bits of the whole content), stuffed along with it. Give each frame's content bytes one by one, each on the tick the byte after it is complete, with got 1 on that tick; on the tick the closing flag is complete make end 1 and say in intact whether the frame arrived intact. On every other tick the byte and intact are 「—」, got and end 0.

t.zh: 到这里为止，校验码护着的只是一个字节。一帧有几个字节事先不知道，校验码于是放在整帧的内容后面，补成一个整字节：收的一方要等这一帧收完，才知道哪个字节是校验字节。
t.en: So far a check has guarded a single byte. A frame's length is not known in advance, so its check goes after the whole content, padded to a whole byte: the receiver only knows which byte is the check once the frame is over.

desc.zh: 从进线上拆出每一帧，扣下最后的校验字节：每个内容字节在它后面那个字节收全的那一拍给出，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完的那一拍「帧尾」为 1，「完好」说出这一帧是否完好。其余各拍字节和「完好」是「—」，「收到」「帧尾」为 0。
desc.en: Unwraps each frame off its wire in and holds back the closing check byte: gives each content byte on the tick the byte after it is complete, with got 1; on the tick the closing flag is complete, end is 1 and intact says whether the frame arrived intact. On every other tick the byte and intact are 「—」, got and end 0.

brief.zh: 把交来的字节从第一拍起逐位送出（最高位在前），紧接着送出它的 3 位校验码。
brief.en: Send the byte handed to you bit by bit from the first tick, top bit first, followed at once by its 3 check bits.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-15"></level-ref>在收的一方算出余数。发送方要在数据后面附上校验码，让整串位的余数为 0，收的一方一除便知是否完好。
t.en: <level-ref to="1-15"></level-ref> works out a remainder at the receiving end. The sender must append check bits that make the remainder of the whole run 0, so that one division tells the receiver whether it is intact.

brief.zh: 每一拍输出到这一拍为止收到的位该跟的 3 位校验码：这些位后面补上三个 0、不进位地除以 1011 的余数，写成一个数。「重来」为 1 的那一拍从这一位重新算起；「暂停」为 1 的拍不收这一位。
brief.en: Every tick, output the 3 check bits due after the bits received so far: their carry-less remainder by 1011 with three 0s appended, as a number. On a tick restart is 1, start over from that bit; on a tick hold is 1, leave that bit out.

t.zh: 奇偶校验位只查得出奇数个错位：恰好翻两位时，校验照样相符。更强的校验把一串位当作一个大数，后面补上几个 0，用不进位的除法除以约好的除数（生成式），余数就是要跟在后面的校验码。不进位的除法里，每一步减法都是逐位的异或。
t.en: A parity bit catches only an odd number of flips: with exactly two flipped, it still checks out. A stronger check reads a run of bits as one big number, appends a few 0s and divides it, without carries, by an agreed divisor (the generator); the remainder is the check to send after the bits. In carry-less division, every subtraction is a bitwise XOR.

desc.zh: 到这一拍为止收进的位该跟的 3 位校验码（补上三个 0 后不进位地除以 1011 的余数，0 到 7 的数）；「重来」为 1 的那一拍从这一位重新算起，「暂停」为 1 的拍不收这一位。
desc.en: The 3 check bits due after the bits taken in so far (their carry-less remainder by 1011 with three 0s appended, a number from 0 to 7); on a tick restart is 1 it starts over from that bit, and on a tick hold is 1 it leaves that bit out.

brief.zh: 线上从第一拍起接连送来字节，每个字节后面跟一个奇偶校验位（让这 9 位里 1 的个数为偶数），线会翻位。在每个校验位到达的那一拍，「字节」输出收到的字节，「完好」说出校验是否相符；其余各拍两者都是「—」。
brief.en: Bytes come down the wire back to back from the first tick, each followed by a parity bit (making the count of 1s in the nine even), and the wire flips bits. On the tick each parity bit arrives, output the byte received and say whether its parity checks out; 「—」 on both at every other tick.

t.zh: 从这里起，线会把个别的位翻过来。收到的字节错了，收的一方却毫不知情，照样把它交出去。两头于是约好一条规则：发送方在数据后面附一位，收的一方按同一规则核对，就知道数据在线上有没有被改。
t.en: From here on, the wire flips the odd bit. A byte arrives wrong and the receiver hands it on without knowing. So the ends agree on a rule: the sender appends a bit after the data, and the receiver checks it by the same rule to tell whether the data changed on the way.

brief.zh: 从线上认出旗标之间的每一帧，去掉塞进的 0，逐个给出内容字节：一个字节收全的那一拍，「字节」给出它，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完的那一拍，「帧尾」为 1。其余各拍「字节」是「—」，「收到」和「帧尾」为 0。
brief.en: Find each frame between flags on the wire, take out the stuffed 0s and give the content bytes one by one: on the tick a byte is complete, output it and make got 1; on the tick the closing flag is complete, make end 1. On every other tick the byte is 「—」 and got and end are 0.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-12"></level-ref>送出的帧到了线的另一头：收的一方要认出旗标，把塞进的 0 去掉，再把位拼回字节。
t.en: Frames like those of <level-ref to="1-12"></level-ref> reach the other end of the wire: the receiver has to spot the flags, take out the stuffed 0s and put the bits back into bytes.

desc.zh: 在进线的位流里认出旗标之间的每一帧，去掉塞进的 0：一个内容字节收全的那一拍给出它，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完的那一拍「帧尾」为 1；其余各拍字节是「—」，「收到」「帧尾」为 0。
desc.en: Finds each frame between flags in the bits on its wire in and takes out the stuffed 0s: gives each content byte on the tick it is complete, with got 1, and makes end 1 on the tick the closing flag is complete; on every other tick the byte is 「—」 and got and end are 0.

brief.zh: 把交来的字节一帧一帧地送出：每帧前后各加旗标 01111110，内容里每连着 5 个 1 就多说一个 0。一帧只在「发送」为 1 的拍开始，两帧之间线上是 0。「下一个」为 1 的那一拍取走眼前的字节，「末字节」说明它是不是这一帧的最后一个。
brief.en: Send the bytes handed to you frame by frame: the flag 01111110 at each end of a frame, and a 0 added after every five 1s in its content. A frame begins only on a tick send is 1, and the wire is 0 between frames. Saying next takes the byte in front of you; last says whether it ends its frame.

t.zh: 旗标标出一帧从哪开始、到哪结束。可一帧的内容本身也可能含有 01111110：收的一方会把它当成旗标，一帧被从中间切断。于是两头再约好一条：内容里每连着 5 个 1，发送方就多说一个 0，收的一方再把它去掉，内容里就永远不会出现旗标。
t.en: Flags mark where a frame begins and ends. But a frame's content may itself hold 01111110: the receiver takes it for a flag and the frame is cut in two. So the ends agree on one more rule: after every five 1s in a row in the content, the sender says an extra 0, and the receiver takes it out again, so the content never looks like a flag.

desc.zh: 把交来的字节一帧一帧地送出：「发送」为 1 的拍开始一帧，前后各加旗标 01111110，内容里每连着 5 个 1 多说一个 0；两帧之间线上是 0。「下一个」为 1 的那一拍取走眼前的字节。
desc.en: Sends the bytes handed to it frame by frame: a frame begins on a tick send is 1, with the flag 01111110 at each end and a 0 added after every five 1s in its content; the wire is 0 between frames. Next is 1 on the tick it takes the byte in front of it.

brief.zh: 线上连续送来位；每当到这一拍为止最近 8 位是 01111110，就在那一拍输出 1，其余各拍输出 0。
brief.en: Bits keep coming down the wire; output 1 on every tick at which the last 8 bits read 01111110, and 0 on every other.

t.zh: 起始位分得出一个个字节，却分不出哪几个字节是一帧：一帧有几个字节，事先并不知道。于是两头约好一个记号 01111110，叫旗标，用它标出一帧的开头和结尾。收的一方要在不停到来的位里随时认出它。
t.en: Start bits separate single bytes but not frames: how many bytes a frame holds is not known in advance. So the ends agree on a mark, 01111110, the flag, to show where a frame begins and ends. The receiver must spot it at any point in the stream of bits.

brief.zh: 把交来的字节依次送出，每个字节前加起始位 1，后加停止位 0；字节送完以后线上一直是 0。说「下一个」为 1 的那一拍取走眼前的字节，下一拍换上后一个。
brief.en: Send the bytes handed to you one after another, each with a start bit 1 before it and a stop bit 0 after; once they are all sent the wire stays 0. Saying next takes the byte in front of you that tick, and the following one shows the tick after.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-9"></level-ref>收的是这样的字节，现在轮到发送一方。要送的字节排成一队，一次只看得见排在最前面的那一个；队伍空了，看到的是「—」。
t.en: <level-ref to="1-9"></level-ref> received bytes like these; now it is the sender's turn. The bytes to send wait in a queue, and only the one in front can be seen; once the queue is empty, it shows 「—」.

brief.zh: 对方随时可能先说一个 1，再送 8 位，最后说一个 0；每收到一个字节，就在它最后一位到达的那一拍输出它，其余各拍输出「—」。
brief.en: At any tick the far end may say a 1, then 8 bits, then a 0; output each byte on the tick its last bit arrives, and 「—」 on every other tick.

t.zh: 发送方随时可能开口，而空着的线读出来是 0：一个以 0 开头的字节和安静的线分不出来，收的一方不知道从哪一拍数起。于是两头约好：字节之前先说一个 1，叫起始位；字节之后说一个 0，叫停止位。
t.en: The sender may begin at any tick, and an idle wire reads 0: a byte that begins with 0s looks just like a quiet wire, and the receiver cannot tell where to start counting. So the ends agree: before a byte comes a 1, the start bit, and after it a 0, the stop bit.

brief.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起（还没为 1 过时从第一拍起），每逢「暂停」为 0 的拍就收进线上的一位，最高位在前；收满 8 位的那一拍，「字节」输出这个字节，「收完」为 1，其余各拍「收完」为 0。
brief.en: From the tick start is 1 (from the first tick, before it ever is), take in the bit on the wire on every tick hold is 0, top bit first; on the tick the eighth is taken, output the byte and make done 1; done is 0 on every other tick.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-7"></level-ref>把一个字节拆成位送出去；线的另一头要把位拼回一个数。
t.en: <level-ref to="1-7"></level-ref> takes a byte apart into bits; the other end of the wire has to put the bits back into a number.

desc.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起（还没为 1 过时从第一拍起），每逢「暂停」为 0 收进一位，最高位在前；收满 8 位的那一拍给出这个字节，「收完」为 1；其余各拍字节是「—」，「收完」为 0。
desc.en: From the tick start is 1 (from the first tick, before it ever is), takes in a bit on every tick hold is 0, top bit first; on the tick the eighth is taken gives the byte with done 1; on every other tick the byte is 「—」 and done 0.

brief.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起，用 8 拍把那一拍输入的字节从最高位起逐位说到线上，之后说 0；最后一位说出的那一拍，「送完」为 1，其余各拍为 0。
brief.en: From the tick start is 1, say the byte input then on the wire bit by bit from the top over 8 ticks, then say 0; done is 1 on the tick the last bit is said and 0 on every other.

t.zh: 要送过去的是 0 到 255 的数，线一拍却只送一位。一个字节是 8 位二进制数，每一位的分量是后一位的两倍。新元件<part-ref to="part:bit"></part-ref>从一个数里取出指定的一位，<part-ref to="part:equal"></part-ref>说两个数是否相同。
t.en: What must go across is a number from 0 to 255, but the wire carries one bit a tick. A byte is an 8-bit binary number, each place worth twice the next. The new part <part-ref to="part:bit"></part-ref> takes one given bit out of a number, and <part-ref to="part:equal"></part-ref> says whether two numbers are the same.

desc.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起，用 8 拍把那一拍的字节从最高位起逐位说出，之后说「—」（线上是 0）；说出最后一位的那一拍「送完」为 1。「开始」再为 1 时重新送。
desc.en: From the tick start is 1, says the byte of that tick bit by bit from the top over 8 ticks, then 「—」 (0 on a wire); done is 1 on the tick the last bit is said. Start again sends anew.

brief.zh: 输出自「重来」上一次为 1 起已经过了几拍（那一拍为 0；「重来」还没为 1 过时，从第一拍数起）；「暂停」为 1 的拍不算，那一拍的数和上一拍相同。
brief.en: Output how many ticks have passed since restart was last 1 (0 on that tick; counted from the first tick before restart is ever 1); ticks on which hold is 1 do not count, and on them the number stays as it was.

t.zh: 要知道一个字节该发到第几位、已经收了几位，板得知道过了几拍；寄存卡只记一个值，手上的元件又都不能让一个数变大。新元件<part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref>给出两个数之和。
t.en: To know which bit of a byte is due, or how many have come in, a board must know how many ticks have passed; a register holds one value, and nothing in hand makes a number grow. The new part <part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref> gives the sum of two numbers.

desc.zh: 自「重来」上一次为 1 起过了几拍：那一拍为 0；「重来」还没为 1 过时从第一拍数起；「暂停」为 1 的拍不算，数停在原处。
desc.en: How many ticks since restart was last 1: 0 on that tick; counted from the first tick before restart is ever 1; ticks on which hold is 1 do not count, and the number stands still.

brief.zh: 线上出现 1 之前一直说 0；出现过 1 以后，每一拍都说 1。
brief.en: Say 0 until a 1 has come down the wire, and 1 on every tick after that.

t.zh: 寄存卡记住的不必是线上的位：存进去的可以是板上算出的任何值，下一拍再拿来接着算。
t.en: A register need not keep the bit off the wire: it can keep anything the board works out, to be worked on again the next tick.

brief.zh: 每一拍说出上一拍听到的位；第一拍说 0。
brief.en: Every tick, say the bit heard the tick before; say 0 on the first tick.

t.zh: 板上的电路每一拍从头算一遍，算完什么也不留下，所以「上一拍听到的」它无从知道。要把一个值留到下一拍，用一对新元件：<part-ref to="part:keep"></part-ref>把值存进寄存卡，<part-ref to="part:reg"></part-ref>在下一拍读出它。
t.en: The board computes afresh every tick and keeps nothing once done, so it cannot know what it heard the tick before. To keep a value for the next tick there is a new pair of parts: <part-ref to="part:keep"></part-ref> stores a value in a register, and <part-ref to="part:reg"></part-ref> reads it out the next tick.

brief.zh: 听两根线：两根线上的位不同时说 1，相同时说 0。
brief.en: Listen to two wires: say 1 when their bits differ and 0 when they agree.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-2"></level-ref>里，条件和被选的值来自同一根线。这一次条件来自一根线，要说什么还取决于另一根线。
t.en: In <level-ref to="1-2"></level-ref> the condition and the value came from the same wire. Now the condition comes from one wire, and what to say depends on the other as well.

desc.zh: 两位不同为 1，相同为 0；碰到「—」给「—」。
desc.en: 1 when two bits differ, 0 when they agree; 「—」 for 「—」.

brief.zh: 每一拍把听到的位反过来说出去：听到 1 说 0，听到 0 说 1。
brief.en: Every tick, say the opposite of the bit you hear: 0 for 1, 1 for 0.

t.zh: 传话的板只能原样照搬：线上来什么，就说什么。要让说出的位和听到的不一样，板得能按条件改变一个值。新元件<part-ref to="part:select"></part-ref>按条件在两路之间取一路，<part-ref to="part:const"></part-ref>给出一个固定的数。
t.en: A relay can only copy: what comes down the wire is what it says. To say something other than what it hears, a board must change a value by a condition. The new part <part-ref to="part:select"></part-ref> picks one of two values by a condition, and <part-ref to="part:const"></part-ref> gives a fixed number.

brief.zh: 每一拍把左线上听到的位说到右线上。
brief.en: Every tick, say on the right-hand wire the bit heard on the left-hand wire.

t.zh: 两头之间只有一根线，约好的只有两种状态：0 和 1。线每<wiki-ref to="tick"></wiki-ref>送一位，从一头说出，过一会儿才到另一头。这块板夹在两根线中间。
t.en: Between the two ends there is only a wire, and all they agree on is two states, 0 and 1. The wire carries one bit a <wiki-ref to="tick"></wiki-ref>, said at one end and arriving at the other a little later. This board sits between two wires.

why: copy: 1-18 and 1-20 briefs within length; the blueprint's era question follows the rewritten one

ops.en: Build a network adapter working both ways at once. Down: frames handed to it go out framed on the wire out with their check byte, starting on a tick send is 1, next taking the byte in front. Up: frames off the wire in are unwrapped and checked, timed as in <part-ref to="receiver"></part-ref>.

ops.zh: 线上从第一拍起接连送来 7 位码字：4 位数据加 3 位校验码（生成式 1011），每个最多翻一位。码字最后一位到达的那一拍，输出翻的是第几位（先到的为第 1 位），没翻输出 0。
ops.en: From the first tick, 7-bit codewords come down the wire back to back: 4 data bits, then 3 check bits (generator 1011), with at most one bit flipped in each. On the tick a codeword's last bit arrives, output which bit flipped (the first to arrive is 1), or 0 if none.

value.zh: 一根一拍只送一位、还会出错的线，两头怎样互相送出一帧，并知道它完好？
value.en: Over a wire that carries a bit a tick and gets some wrong, how do two ends send each other a frame and know it arrived intact?

value.zh: 一根一拍送一位、还会出错的线，怎样让两头可靠地交换一帧？
value.en: How do two ends exchange a frame over a wire that carries a bit a tick and gets some wrong?

value.zh: 线上从第一拍起接连送来 7 位的码字：4 位数据加 3 位校验码（生成式 1011），每个码字最多翻一位。在码字最后一位到达的那一拍，输出翻的是第几位（先到的为第 1 位），没翻就输出 0。
value.en: Codewords of 7 bits come down the wire back to back from the first tick: 4 data bits, then 3 check bits (generator 1011), with at most one bit flipped in each. On the tick a codeword's last bit arrives, output which bit flipped (the first to arrive is 1), or 0 if none did.

value.zh: 搭一块网卡，两个方向同时工作。往下：交来的帧带上校验字节成帧，从出线送出，「发送」为 1 时开始，「下一个」取走队首。往上：进线上的帧拆开、核对，输出的时机同<part-ref to="receiver"></part-ref>。
value.en: Build a network adapter that works both ways at once. Down: frames handed to it go out on the wire out, framed with their check byte, starting on a tick send is 1, next taking the byte in front. Up: frames off the wire in are unwrapped and checked, timed as in <part-ref to="receiver"></part-ref>.

why: the course blueprint, revised by the review: XOR built where error detection first needs it, equal on its own slot before bit, counter without hold, hold as pausable successors where stuffing and the frame check need them, start bits before flags, a flag spotter part, framing split into steps, practice clusters for counting, compare, flags and parity, the relay deferred to era 2

topic.zh: 计算机网络：从一根会出错的线搭到今天的互联网
topic.en: Computer networks: from one faulty wire up to today's internet

learner.zh: 不假设任何 IT 基础：比特、二进制数、「协议」这个词都在游戏里从头讲起。
learner.en: No IT background assumed: bits, binary numbers and the word “protocol” are all taught from scratch.

endpoint.zh: 在模拟世界里打开一个网页，跑的全是自己搭的东西：网卡、交换机、路由器、路由协议、可靠传输、拥塞控制、解析器、HTTP、TLS、QUIC，并能看清每一层在每一拍做了什么。
endpoint.en: Open a web page in the simulated world running only what the player built: network card, switch, router, routing protocol, reliable transport, congestion control, resolver, HTTP, TLS and QUIC, and see what every layer does at every tick.

scope.zh: 这份蓝图只写第 1 代「一根线」：两头之间一根逐拍送位、会翻位的线，从传一位走到一块能装到线两头的网卡。第 0 代（纸笔）的内容并进第 1 代用得着它的关，或推迟到用得着它的那一代；第 2–11 代只记一句，留待后续。
scope.en: This blueprint covers era 1, “One wire”: one wire between two ends carrying a bit a tick and flipping some, from passing on a bit to a network card that sits at both ends. What era 0 (paper and pencil) teaches is folded into the era-1 levels that need it, or deferred to the era that first needs it; eras 2–11 get one line each, for later.

why.zh: 这一代的内容全是时间里的事：位一拍一拍地到，晚到，要数拍、记住前几拍、在一串位里找开头。板每拍跑一遍，寄存卡跨拍保存，正好就是真实网卡里的移位寄存器和计数器。
why.en: Everything in this era happens in time: bits arrive one a tick and late, and the board must count ticks, remember earlier ones and find where a run begins. A board run every tick with registers across ticks is exactly the shift register and counter inside a real network card.

about.zh: 节点接在点对点的线上：每根线从一头把位逐拍送到另一头，过若干拍才到；没人说话时线上是 0。板上每根进来的线一个「线」元件，每根出去的线一个「说」元件。
about.en: A node sits on point-to-point wires: each wire carries one end's bits, a tick at a time, to the other end some ticks later; a wire nobody drives reads 0. A board has a line card for each wire coming in and a say card for each wire going out.

lacks.zh: 线只有两头，一拍只送一位：第三个人没有地方接，整帧也只能一位一位地走，两块网卡之间也存不下一整帧来转发。第 2 代把线换成大家都挂在上面的总线，线两头装上网卡，一拍送一段。
lacks.en: A wire has two ends and carries a bit a tick: a third station has nowhere to plug in, a frame crawls along bit by bit, and nothing between two cards can hold a frame to pass it on. Era 2 turns it into a bus everyone hangs on, with a network card at each end and a chunk sent per tick.

about.zh: 世界按拍推进：每一拍，板读一次进来的线，说一次出去的线；一根线一拍只送一位。
about.en: The world advances in ticks: each tick the board reads its incoming wires once and says on its outgoing wires once; a wire carries one bit a tick.

wall.zh: 起点：没有它，线上什么也不会发生。
wall.en: The starting point: without it nothing happens on the wire.

about.zh: 按一个条件在两路之间选一路：非、与、或都由选择接出。
about.en: Picking one of two values by a condition: not, and, or are all wired from it.

wall.zh: 传话的板只能原样照搬，要把一位反过来、或按另一根线决定说什么，就做不到。
wall.en: A relay can only copy; it cannot flip a bit or let another wire decide what is said.

about.zh: 寄存卡把一个值留到下一拍。
about.en: A register keeps a value for the next tick.

wall.zh: 板每拍从头算，算完什么也不留：「说出上一拍听到的」这样的规格无从满足。
wall.en: The board starts afresh every tick and keeps nothing: “say what you heard the tick before” cannot be met.

about.zh: 寄存卡加上加法就是数拍的计数器，能清零重来。
about.en: A register and an adder make a counter of ticks, which can restart.

wall.zh: 要知道这一拍该发一个字节的第几位、已经收了几位，就得知道过了几拍；只记一拍的寄存卡不够。
wall.en: To know which bit of a byte is due, or how many bits have come in, the board must know how many ticks have passed; one remembered tick is not enough.

about.zh: 相等把一个数变成是或否：计数器数到几，选择就能据此行事。
about.en: Equal turns a number into a yes or no: once the counter reaches a value, select can act on it.

wall.zh: 计数器给出的是数，选择要的是是或否：「每到第 8 拍说一次 1」无从判断。
wall.en: The counter gives a number and select wants a yes or no: “say 1 every eighth tick” cannot be decided.

about.zh: 一个字节是 8 位二进制数，每一位的分量是后一位的两倍：从高位起逐位说出，收的一方每收一位就把已有的数翻倍再加上它。
about.en: A byte is an 8-bit binary number, each place worth twice the next: it is said from the top bit down, and the receiver doubles what it holds and adds each new bit.

wall.zh: 一根线一拍只能送一位，要送的却是 0 到 255 的数：数得先拆成位，到了再拼回去。
wall.en: A wire carries one bit a tick, but what must go across is a number from 0 to 255: it has to be taken apart into bits and put back together.

about.zh: 线空着时是 0；发送方先说一个 1（起始位）宣布字节开始，每个字节后跟一个 0（停止位）。
about.en: An idle wire reads 0; the sender says a 1 (the start bit) to announce a byte, and ends each byte with a 0 (the stop bit).

wall.zh: 发送方随时可能开口，以 0 开头的字节和空着的线分不出来：收的一方不知道从哪一拍开始数。
wall.en: The sender may begin at any tick, and a byte that starts with 0s looks like an idle wire: the receiver cannot tell where to start counting.

about.zh: 旗标 01111110 标出一帧的开头和结尾，收的一方在任何时候都能从位流里认出它。
about.en: The flag 01111110 marks where a frame begins and ends, and the receiver can spot it in the bit stream at any point.

wall.zh: 一帧有几个字节事先不知道：起始位分得出一个个字节，分不出哪几个字节是一帧。
wall.en: How many bytes a frame holds is not known in advance: start bits separate bytes but not frames.

about.zh: 停一拍：「暂停」为 1 的拍，计数和手上的字节都停在原处，下一拍接着走。
about.en: Standing still: on a tick hold is 1, the count and the byte in hand stay where they are, and go on the tick after.

wall.zh: 内容里有 01111110 时帧被从中间切断；要在内容里多塞一位把它拆开，别的都得等一拍，可计数器每拍都往前走，正在发的字节也跟着走了一位。
wall.en: A frame whose content holds 01111110 is cut in two; slipping an extra bit in to break it up means everything else must wait a tick, but the counter moves on every tick and the byte being sent moves on with it.

about.zh: 位填充：帧的内容里每连着 5 个 1，发送方就多说一个 0，收的一方再把它去掉，内容里就不会出现旗标。多说的那一拍，内容停一拍不走。
about.en: Bit stuffing: after every five 1s in a frame's content the sender adds a 0 and the receiver takes it out again, so the content never looks like a flag. On that extra tick the content stands still.

wall.zh: 内容里本身就有 01111110 时，收的一方把它当成旗标，一帧被从中间切断。
wall.en: When the content itself holds 01111110, the receiver takes it for a flag and the frame is cut in two.

about.zh: 发送方按约好的规则多送几位（最笨的办法是整份再送一遍），收的一方按同一规则核对，就知道数据在线上有没有被改。
about.en: The sender adds a few bits by an agreed rule (at its crudest, a second copy) and the receiver checks them by the same rule, so it can tell whether the data changed on the way.

wall.zh: 线开始翻位以后，收到的位错了，收的一方却毫不知情，照样交出去。
wall.en: Once the wire flips bits, what arrives is wrong and the receiver hands it on without knowing.

about.zh: 把一串位当作一个大数，后面补上几个 0，用不进位的除法（每一步是异或）除以约好的生成式，余数就是校验码；逐拍做时，寄存卡里的几位就是到这一拍为止该跟的校验码（CRC）。
about.en: A run of bits is read as one big number, a few 0s are appended, and it is divided, without carries (each step an XOR), by an agreed generator; the remainder is the check. Done tick by tick, the bits in the registers are the check due after the bits so far (CRC).

wall.zh: 奇偶校验位只查得出奇数个错位：恰好翻两位时，校验照样相符。
wall.en: A parity bit catches only an odd number of flipped bits: with exactly two flipped, it still checks out.

about.zh: 分层：网卡对上面只收发整帧的字节，对下面只收发位；上面不必知道旗标、填充和校验字节。
about.en: Layering: the card deals in the bytes of whole frames with the layer above and in bits with the wire below; the layer above never sees flags, stuffing or the check byte.

wall.zh: 发帧、收帧、查错分在几块板上，每一个要用线的节点都得把它们重新接一遍。
wall.en: Sending frames, receiving them and checking them sit on separate boards, and every node that uses a wire must wire them up again.

about.zh: 选择：条件为是取一路，否则取另一路。
about.en: Select: one value when the condition holds, the other otherwise.

why.zh: 传话的板只有线和说；没有任何元件能按条件改变一个值，选择是所有逻辑的起点。
why.en: A relay board has only the line and the say card; nothing can change a value by a condition, and select is where all logic starts.

about.zh: 常数：给出设定的数。
about.en: Constant: the number it is set to.

why.zh: 线上和输入只给出变化的值；要说一个固定的 0 或 1，只能由常数给出。
why.en: Wires and inputs give only changing values; a fixed 0 or 1 can come only from a constant.

about.zh: 读寄存卡：同名寄存卡里存的值，存入之前给初值。
about.en: Register: what the register of the same name holds, its start value before.

why.zh: 板每拍从头算；跨拍的状态只能由寄存卡这一对元件保存，任何组合都接不出来。
why.en: The board starts afresh each tick; state across ticks can be held only by the register pair, and no wiring makes it.

about.zh: 存寄存卡：把接入的值存进同名寄存卡，下一拍读得出。
about.en: Keep: stores its input in the register of the same name, readable from the next tick.

why.zh: 同上：它和读寄存卡是一对，写入跨拍的状态。
why.en: As for the register: it is the other half of the pair, writing state across ticks.

about.zh: 相加：两个数之和（加一就是加上常数 1）。
about.en: Add: the sum of two numbers (adding one is adding the constant 1).

why.zh: 手上的元件只能选、只能存，不能让一个数变大；数拍、把收到的位拼成数都要它。
why.en: The parts in hand can only pick and store; none makes a number grow, and both counting and assembling bits into a number need it.

about.zh: 相等：两个数相等为是，否则为否。
about.en: Equal: yes when two numbers are the same, no otherwise.

why.zh: 它来的那一关手上只有选择、常数、寄存卡和相加，没有一样能把一个数拆开，两个数是否相同无从比较。取位到 1-7 才来；那以后虽然能用 16 张取位、8 个异或和 7 个或接出 8 位的相等，可在那之前的每一次比较都已经离不开它，那样重搭一遍只是拼装，没有新想法。
why.en: Where it arrives the parts in hand are select, const, the registers and add, and none can take a number apart, so two numbers cannot be compared. Bit-of comes only at 1-7; an 8-bit equal could be wired after that from 16 bit-of cards, 8 XORs and 7 ORs, but every comparison before then already needs it, and rebuilding it that way would be assembly with no new idea.

about.zh: 取位：一个 8 位数从最高位数起的第 i 位。
about.en: Bit of: bit i of an 8-bit number, counted from the top.

why.zh: 加法和相等只能把数变大、比是否相同，不能从一个数里取出某一位；发送一个字节必须一位一位地取。
why.en: Adding and comparing can make a number grow and test sameness, but not reach into a number for one bit; sending a byte means taking it bit by bit.

about.zh: 计数器：自「重来」上一次为 1 起过了几拍（那一拍为 0）。
about.en: Counter: how many ticks since restart was last 1 (0 on that tick).

about.zh: 移位发送：从「开始」那一拍起，用 8 拍把那一拍的字节从最高位起逐位说出，送完时报一声。
about.en: Shift out: from the start tick, says the byte it had then bit by bit from the top over 8 ticks, and signals when done.

about.zh: 按字节收：从「开始」那一拍起收进线上的 8 位，收满的那一拍给出这个字节。
about.en: Shift in: from the start tick, takes in 8 bits off the wire and gives the byte on the tick the eighth comes in.

about.zh: 认旗标：最近收到的 8 位正好是 01111110 的那一拍为 1。
about.en: Flag spotter: 1 on each tick at which the last 8 bits read 01111110.

about.zh: 能停的计数器：同计数器，只是「暂停」为 1 的拍不算，计数停在原处；它取代计数器。
about.en: Pausable counter: a counter whose count stands still on ticks hold is 1; it replaces the counter.

about.zh: 能停的移位发送：同移位发送，只是「暂停」为 1 的拍字节停住，该说的那一位留到下一拍；它取代移位发送。
about.en: Pausable shift out: shift out whose byte stands still on ticks hold is 1, the bit due waiting a tick; it replaces shift out.

about.zh: 成帧器：从交来的字节里取出一帧送出，前后加旗标，内容里做位填充。
about.en: Framer: takes a frame from the bytes handed down and sends it with a flag at each end and its content bit-stuffed.

about.zh: 能停的按字节收：同按字节收，只是「暂停」为 1 的拍那一位不收；它取代按字节收。
about.en: Pausable shift in: shift in that leaves out the bit of every tick hold is 1; it replaces shift in.

about.zh: 拆帧器：在位流里认出旗标之间的帧，去掉填充的 0，逐个给出内容字节，帧结束时报一声。
about.en: Deframer: finds the frame between flags in the bit stream, takes out the stuffed 0s, gives the content bytes one by one and signals the frame's end.

about.zh: 异或：两位不同为 1，相同为 0。
about.en: XOR: 1 when two bits differ, 0 when they agree.

about.zh: CRC：到这一拍为止收进的位该跟的校验码（补上 0 后不进位地除以 1011 的余数）；能清零重来。
about.en: CRC: the check due after the bits taken in so far (their carry-less remainder by 1011 with 0s appended); it can restart.

about.zh: 能停的 CRC：同 CRC，只是「暂停」为 1 的拍那一位不收进去；它取代 CRC。
about.en: Pausable CRC: a CRC that leaves out the bit of every tick hold is 1; it replaces the CRC.

about.zh: 收帧器：从线上拆出每一帧，交出内容字节，扣下最后的校验字节和它核对，帧尾说出是否完好。
about.en: Receiver: unwraps each frame off the wire, gives up its content bytes, holds back the closing check byte to check it, and says at the frame's end whether it is intact.

about.zh: 网卡：上面交来的帧带上校验字节成帧送到线上；线上收到的帧拆开、核对，逐个字节交给上面，帧尾报好坏。
about.en: Network card: frames handed down go on the wire framed with their check byte; frames off the wire are unwrapped and checked, going up byte by byte with word at each end of whether they are intact.

question.zh: 一根一拍只送一位、还会出错的线，两头怎样互相送出一帧，并知道它完好？
question.en: Over a wire that carries a bit a tick and gets some wrong, how do two ends send each other a frame and know it arrived intact?

why.zh: 起点是一根线：两头约好 0 和 1，什么格式都还没有。这一代从照搬一位开始，一层层装出能发能收、能查错的网卡。纸笔一代教的几件事并进第一次用得着它们的关：两种状态在传话，二进制数在逐位发送和接收。
why.en: It starts from one wire: the ends agree on 0 and 1 and nothing else. The era begins by copying a bit and builds up, layer by layer, a card that sends, receives and checks. What the paper era taught goes into the first levels that need it: two states into passing a bit on, binary numbers into sending and gathering a byte.

task.zh: 每一拍把左边线上听到的位说到右边的线上。
task.en: Every tick, say on the right-hand wire the bit heard on the left-hand wire.

task.zh: 每一拍把听到的位反过来说出去：听到 1 说 0，听到 0 说 1。
task.en: Every tick, say the opposite of the bit you hear: 0 for 1, 1 for 0.

task.zh: 听两根线：两根线上都是 1 时说 1，否则说 0。
task.en: Listen to two wires: say 1 when both carry a 1, and 0 otherwise.

task.zh: 每一拍说出上一拍听到的位；第一拍说 0。
task.en: Every tick, say the bit heard the tick before; say 0 on the first tick.

task.zh: 线上出现 1 之前一直说 0；出现过 1 以后，每一拍都说 1。
task.en: Say 0 until a 1 has come down the wire, and 1 on every tick after that.

task.zh: 输出自「重来」上一次为 1 起已经过了几拍。
task.en: Output how many ticks have passed since restart was last 1.

task.zh: 每一拍输出线上已经连着来了几个 1；来的是 0 时输出 0。
task.en: Every tick, output how many 1s in a row have come down the wire; output 0 on a tick a 0 arrives.

task.zh: 在第 7、15、23……拍说 1，其余各拍说 0。
task.en: Say 1 on ticks 7, 15, 23 and so on, and 0 on every other tick.

task.zh: 线上连着来到第 5 个 1 的那一拍说 1，其余各拍说 0。
task.en: Say 1 on the tick that brings the fifth 1 in a row, and 0 on every other tick.

task.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起，用 8 拍把那一拍输入的字节从最高位起逐位说到线上，之后说 0。
task.en: From the tick start is 1, say the byte input then on the wire bit by bit from the top over 8 ticks, then say 0.

task.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起，收进线上的 8 位（最高位在前），收满 8 位的那一拍输出这个字节。
task.en: From the tick start is 1, take in 8 bits off the wire, top bit first, and output the byte on the tick the eighth comes in.

task.zh: 对方随时可能先说一个 1，再送 8 位；每收到一个字节就输出它。
task.en: At any tick the far end may say a 1 and then 8 bits; output each byte as it arrives.

task.zh: 把交来的几个字节依次送出，每个字节前加起始位 1，后加停止位 0。
task.en: Send the bytes handed to you one after another, each with a start bit 1 before it and a stop bit 0 after.

task.zh: 线上连续送来位；每当最近收到的 8 位是 01111110，就在那一拍说 1。
