task.en: Bits keep coming down the wire; say 1 on every tick at which the last 8 bits read 01111110.

task.zh: 每一拍输出上一个旗标结束以后线上又来了几位。
task.en: Every tick, output how many bits have come down the wire since the last flag ended.

task.zh: 把交来的每一帧字节送出，前后各加一个旗标 01111110。
task.en: Send each frame of bytes handed to you with a flag 01111110 before and after it.

task.zh: 从线上认出旗标之间的每一帧，逐个输出内容字节，帧结束的那一拍报一声。
task.en: Find each frame between flags on the wire, output its content bytes one by one, and signal on the tick it ends.

task.zh: 像数拍一样输出自「重来」起过了几拍，只是「暂停」为 1 的拍不算。
task.en: Count the ticks since restart as before, except that ticks on which hold is 1 do not count.

task.zh: 像一位一位地发一样送出字节，只是「暂停」为 1 的拍字节停住，该说的那一位留到下一拍。
task.en: Send a byte bit by bit as before, except that on a tick hold is 1 the byte stands still and the bit due waits for the next tick.

task.zh: 像夹在旗标之间那样送出每一帧，只是内容里每连着 5 个 1 就多说一个 0。
task.en: Send each frame between flags as before, except that after every five 1s in a row in the content you add a 0.

task.zh: 像一位一位地收一样收一个字节，只是「暂停」为 1 的拍线上那一位不收。
task.en: Gather a byte as before, except that the bit on a tick hold is 1 is not taken in.

task.zh: 像拆帧一样逐个输出每帧的内容字节，只是内容里每连着 5 个 1 后面塞进的那个 0 要去掉。
task.en: Unwrap each frame as before, except that the 0 slipped in after every five 1s in a row must be taken out.

task.zh: 对方把每一位同时说在两根线上，线会翻位；两根线上的位不同时说 1，相同时说 0。
task.en: The far end says every bit on two wires at once and the wires flip bits; say 1 when the two disagree and 0 when they agree.

task.zh: 把交来的字节逐个送出，每个字节后面跟一个奇偶校验位：字节里有奇数个 1 时为 1。
task.en: Send the bytes handed to you one by one, each followed by a parity bit that is 1 when the byte holds an odd number of 1s.

task.zh: 每个字节后面跟一个奇偶校验位，线会翻位：输出收到的每个字节，并说出它的校验是否相符。
task.en: Each byte is followed by a parity bit and the wire flips bits; output each byte received and say whether its parity checks out.

task.zh: 每一拍输出到这一拍为止收到的位该跟的 3 位校验码（这些位后面补上三个 0、不进位地除以 1011 的余数）；「重来」为 1 时从头算起。
task.en: Every tick, output the 3 check bits due after the bits received so far (their carry-less remainder by 1011 with three 0s appended); start over when restart is 1.

task.zh: 把交来的字节送出，紧接着送出它的 3 位校验码。
task.en: Send the byte handed to you, followed at once by its 3 check bits.

task.zh: 每个字节后面跟它的 3 位校验码，线在一个字节里可能翻两位：输出收到的每个字节，并说出它是否完好。
task.en: Each byte is followed by its 3 check bits and the wire may flip two bits in one: output each byte received and say whether it arrived intact.

task.zh: 像边收边除一样输出该跟的校验码，只是「暂停」为 1 的拍线上那一位不收进去。
task.en: Give the check due as in dividing as it comes, except that the bit on a tick hold is 1 is not taken in.

task.zh: 线会翻位，每帧内容后面跟一个校验字节（5 个 0 加 3 位校验码）：逐个输出每帧的内容字节，帧结束时说出它是否完好。
task.en: The wire flips bits, and each frame's content is followed by a check byte (five 0s, then the 3 check bits): output each frame's content bytes one by one and say at its end whether it arrived intact.

task.zh: 搭一块网卡：上面交来的帧带上校验字节送到出去的线上，进来的线上的帧逐个字节交给上面，帧尾说出是否完好；两个方向同时在走。
task.en: Build a network card: frames handed down go out on the outgoing wire with their check byte, and frames off the incoming wire go up byte by byte with word at each end of whether they arrived intact; both directions run at once.

task.zh: 装上网卡：进来的线上每到一帧，就在出去的线上回一个只有一个字节的帧，完好回 1，坏了回 0。
task.en: Fit a network card and, for every frame that arrives on the incoming wire, send back a one-byte frame on the outgoing wire: 1 if it arrived intact, 0 if broken.

task.zh: 每块 4 位数据后面跟 3 位校验码（生成式 1011），线在一块里最多翻一位；每块最后一位到达的那一拍，输出这块的第几位翻了（1 到 7），没翻就输出 0。
task.en: Each block is 4 data bits followed by 3 check bits (generator 1011), and the wire flips at most one bit in a block; on each block's last tick, output which of its 7 bits flipped (1 to 7), or 0 if none did.

naive.zh: 把余数直接当成位置输出：没有翻位时余数是 0，看起来对；可翻一位留下的余数并不是那一位的编号（翻第 1 位留下 4）。要看出的是 7 个位置留下 7 个各不相同的余数，再一一对上。
naive.en: Output the remainder itself as the position: it is 0 when nothing flipped, so it looks right, but the remainder a flip leaves is not that bit's number (flipping bit 1 leaves 4). The leap is that the seven positions leave seven different remainders, to be matched one by one.

why.zh: 分帧和查错都只建在字节上，互不依赖：一路从起始位走到旗标和位填充，分出一个个字节和一整帧；一路从送两份走到 CRC，查出线上改了什么。网卡建在两路上。
why.en: Framing and checking each stand only on the byte and not on each other: one branch goes from start bits to flags and stuffing, marking single bytes and then whole frames; the other goes from sending twice to the CRC, catching what the wire changed. The card stands on both.

about.zh: 点对点的线：每根线把一头说的位过 d 拍送到另一头，没人说时为 0；关卡写出拓扑（几根线、板在哪一头听或说），世界的节点在线的另一头按测试说位或听位，板上每根进来的线一个线元件、每根出去的线一个说元件。
about.en: Point-to-point wires: each carries the bits one end says to the other end d ticks later, 0 when nobody speaks; a level names its wires and which end the board hears or says on, world nodes at the far ends say or hear the test's bits, and the board has a line card per incoming wire and a say card per outgoing one.

note.zh: 做成了：关卡写 wires.in 和 wires.out，每根线一张进线、出线元件，带 delay；进线上到达的位由测试定（线那头不回听），所以板这一拍可以说它这一拍听到的。
note.en: Done: a level writes wires.in and wires.out, a wire-in or wire-out card each, with a delay; what arrives on a wire in is fixed by the test (the far end does not listen back), so a board may say this tick what it hears this tick.

about.zh: 原始元件选择、相加、相等、取位（8 位数从最高位起的第 i 位），碰到「—」给「—」。
about.en: The primitives select, add, equal and bit-of (bit i of an 8-bit number from the top), giving 「—」 for 「—」.

note.zh: 做成了：select、add、equal、bit（取位），加上 reg、keep、const。
note.en: Done: select, add, equal and bit (bit of), with reg, keep and const.

about.zh: 输出的要求：逐拍写定的值（含「—」）；只比非「—」值的先后、不比时刻的值序列；以及线另一头的世界节点按约定的格式（裸位、起止位、旗标、旗标加 CRC）解出收到的字节，必须等于要送的内容。
about.en: What outputs must be: values fixed tick by tick (「—」 included); the order of the non-「—」 values, timing aside; and what a world node at the far end decodes by an agreed format (raw bits, start/stop, flags, flags with CRC), which must equal what was to be sent.

note.zh: 做成了：每一拍的项（echo、opposite、differ、late、heard、count、serial、pattern、remainder、decoded、intact，以及测试里写定的 given）、不论时机的项（bytes、ends）和线那头的项（sent、relayed）；格式有 bytes、startstop、parity、check、blocks、flag、flagcheck。
note.en: Done: items checked tick by tick (echo, opposite, differ, late, heard, count, serial, pattern, remainder, decoded, intact, and given for values a test writes out), items checked in order timing aside (bytes, ends), and the far end's (sent, relayed); the formats are bytes, startstop, parity, check, blocks, flag and flagcheck.

about.zh: 可以拉取的输入：关卡给一列字节（可分成几帧），板在一拍里说「下一个」，下一拍这一项出现在输入上，取完给「—」，帧与帧之间给出帧界。
about.en: An input the board pulls from: the level gives a list of bytes (possibly in frames); when the board asks for the next one, it appears on the input the following tick, 「—」 once used up, with frame boundaries marked.

note.zh: 做成了：关卡的 pulls 说哪个输入是队首、哪个输入标出一帧的最后一个字节、哪个输出取走它；测试的 queue 是一列帧。
note.en: Done: a level's pulls names the input showing the head of the queue, the input marking a frame's last byte, and the output that takes it; a test's queue is a list of frames.

about.zh: 会翻位的线：测试可以写定在哪几拍翻位（给隐藏测试用），也可以按出错率带种子随机翻位，在几个种子下各跑一遍。
about.en: A wire that flips bits: a test may name the ticks at which it flips (for hidden tests) or flip at random by an error rate with a seed, run over several seeds.

note.zh: 按写定的拍做成了（测试的 flips）；随机的错误率和种子不做：隐藏测试里写定的翻转已经能抓住 naive 解，种子只会让一关的结果不可复现。
note.en: Done for scripted ticks (a test's flips); a random error rate with seeds is declined: flips written into the hidden tests already catch the naive answers, and seeds would only make a level's result harder to reproduce.

about.zh: 搭出元件的板把它的线元件和说元件也作为元件的口，一个节点可以放几块；关卡可以让玩家的同一块板跑在一根线的两头，各有各的寄存卡。
about.en: A board that builds a part exposes its line and say cards as the part's ports, so one node can hold several; a level may run the player's board at both ends of a wire, each copy with its own registers.

note.zh: 线就是板的口：搭出的元件把它那一关的进线、出线当作自己的输入、输出，一块板上放几个，各有各的寄存卡。两项不做：在线的两头各跑一份玩家的板（一关同时测两个方向——队列里的帧从出线发出，进线上的帧交到输出——已经测到它，不另跑一份）；把一帧整个存下再转发（第一代没有能存下一帧的元件，队列是第二代的事）：一关不能要求两块网卡之间存下一整帧再转发。
note.en: Wires are the board's ports: a built part takes the wires of its level as inputs and outputs of its own, and several on one board each keep their own registers. Two things are declined: running a copy of the player's board at the far end (a level that tests both directions at once — frames from the queue out on the wire out, frames on the wire in up to the outputs — already covers it); and holding a whole frame between two cards to forward it (no part in era 1 holds a frame; the queue belongs to era 2): no level may need two cards to store a whole frame and forward it.

about.zh: want「count」和「remainder」各加一个可选的输入 hold：hold 为 1 的拍不算——计数停在原处，这一拍的位不收进余数。
about.en: The wants count and remainder each take an optional input `hold`: a tick on which it is 1 does not count — the count stands still, and that tick's bit is not taken into the remainder.

note.zh: 做成了：count 和 remainder 都可以带输入 hold，为 1 的拍不算。
note.en: Done: count and remainder both take an input hold; a tick it is 1 does not count.

about.zh: 一种帧格式，像 flagcheck，只是校验码作为内容后面的一个整字节送出（前面补 0 凑满 8 位），一起做位填充；帧完好要求内容是整字节、最后一个字节等于内容的校验码。bytes、ends、sent、relayed 都按它解。
about.en: A frame format like flagcheck, except that the check bits go as one whole byte after the content (0s before them to make 8), stuffed with it; a frame is intact when its content is whole bytes and its last byte equals the content's check. bytes, ends, sent and relayed decode it.

note.zh: 做成了：格式 flagbyte，校验位前面补 0 凑成一个字节，和内容一起填充；bytes、ends、sent、relayed 都按它解。
note.en: Done: the format flagbyte, its check bits padded with 0s in front to a whole byte and stuffed with the content; bytes, ends, sent and relayed decode it.

about.zh: 接着上一关的板做，新元件取代旧元件：关卡可以写 carry（打开时板上是玩家在那个先修关留下的电路，没通过就用它的参考解），搭出的元件可以声明 replaces（它取代的元件：从此先修关系往下的关，托盘给新的、不再给旧的），交给内核 defineCourse 已有的 replaces 和 carry-unseen 审计。
about.en: Going on from an earlier board, a new part taking an old one's place: a level may name `carry` (it opens on the board the player left at that prerequisite, or its reference if not passed), and a built part may declare `replaces` (the part it supersedes: from there on down the prerequisites the tray offers the new one, not the old), wired to the kernel's existing defineCourse `replaces` and the carry-unseen audit.

about.zh: 线那头的一种要求：按格式解出这根出线上说的帧，应当是那根进线上每到一帧就回一帧，帧里只有一个字节，到的帧完好为 1，坏了为 0。
about.en: A far-end want: the frames it decodes in the format from this wire out must be one reply per frame that arrived on the given wire in, each holding a single byte, 1 if that frame was intact and 0 if broken.

about.zh: 第 0 代「纸笔」的四关手做关
about.en: Era 0, “Paper and pencil”, four manual levels

why.zh: 逐拍总线领域和盲玩 harness 都不支持手动关。两种状态并进 1-1，二进制数并进逐位发送和接收；字符对照表推迟到第 9 代的文本协议，那里第一次非它不可；长度前缀推迟到第 5 代的字节流分帧，理由同上。
why.en: Neither the tick-bus domain nor the blind-play harness supports manual levels. Two states go into 1-1, binary numbers into sending and gathering a byte; the character table waits for era 9's text protocols, where it is first indispensable, and the length prefix for era 5's framing on a byte stream, for the same reason.

about.zh: 设计稿里的机关台「晚到」（传播时间和发送时间）
about.en: The design sketch's bench “Arriving late” (propagation and transmission time)

why.zh: 这一代一拍送一位，发送时间还不是一回事，晚到在 1-1 的时序图里就看得见；它放到第 2 代整帧占线若干拍时。参数台盲玩也还不支持。
why.en: With a bit a tick, transmission time does not yet matter, and arriving late shows in 1-1's timeline; it goes to era 2, where a frame holds the wire for several ticks. Blind play does not support benches yet either.

about.zh: 设计稿的挑战「数据里正好有旗标」和网卡系列的前三关
about.en: The sketch's challenge “The data holds a flag” and the card series' first three levels

why.zh: 内容里出现旗标正是位填充撞上的墙，做成挑战就成了新机制；送一句话、送几句话、线会出错只是重做前面的关，没有新维度，网卡一关直接站在已搭出的元件上。
why.en: A flag inside the content is the very wall stuffing meets, so as a challenge it would bring a new mechanism; sending one message, several, and over a noisy wire only redo earlier levels with no new dimension, so the card level stands directly on the parts already built.

about.zh: 8 位生成式（校验码本身就是一个字节）和「改回来」的纠错挑战
about.en: An 8-bit generator (a check that is a byte by itself), and the error-correcting challenge “Put it right”

why.zh: 8 位的 CRC 要 8 张寄存卡，一块板只有 6 张；拿整字节的算术去凑，教的就不再是除法。所以生成式留在 1-15 搭出的 1011，校验码补成一个整字节送出（请求 check-byte）。纠错要把 7 位的块拼回 4 位数据，又和 8 位一收的按字节收对不上，难在拼凑；挑战改成找出翻的是哪一位，那个跳跃（余数认得出位置）原样保留，真正的纠错留到能存下一整块的第 2 代。
why.en: An 8-bit CRC needs eight registers and a board has six; faking it with byte arithmetic would no longer teach division. So the generator stays the 1011 that 1-15 builds, and the check is sent padded to a whole byte (request check-byte). Correcting means rebuilding 4 data bits from 7-bit blocks, which the 8-bit deserializer does not fit, and the work becomes assembly; the challenge instead finds which bit flipped, keeping the leap (the remainder names the position), and true correction waits for era 2, which can hold a whole block.

about.zh: 上一版的「接力」：两块网卡之间逐字节转发，坏帧送出去也不能是好的
about.en: The previous draft's “Relay”: two cards passing a frame on byte by byte, a broken frame never leaving intact

why.zh: 一关里有三件新事：不等整帧收完就转发、在两种步调之间存下几个字节、把坏帧的校验弄坏再送出。在两块网卡之间存字节正是请求 card-ports 推给第 2 代的事，转发帧也正是第 2 代交换机的事，在那里和队列一起讲。第 1 代改由「回一声」用上网卡。
why.en: It brought three new things in one level: forwarding before the whole frame is in, holding bytes between two paces, and spoiling the check of a broken frame on the way out. Holding bytes between two cards is what the card-ports request left to era 2, and forwarding frames is era 2's switch, taught there with the queue. In era 1 “Answer back” puts the card to use instead.

about.zh: 第 2 代 · 局域网
about.en: Era 2 · LAN

why.zh: 总线、地址、撞车与退避、交换机（转发帧在这里）、生成树；要整帧的线和网卡收进线里，等第 1 代上线后再写。
why.en: Bus, addresses, collisions and backoff, switches (forwarding frames lives here), spanning tree; needs whole-frame wires with the card folded into them, written once era 1 is live.

about.zh: 第 3 代 · 网际
about.en: Era 3 · Internetwork

why.zh: 分层地址、路由器、报头校验（重复框）、最长前缀、ARP、TTL；要重复框，后续再写。
why.en: Hierarchical addresses, routers, header checksum (repeat frame), longest prefix, ARP, TTL; needs the repeat frame, for later.

about.zh: 第 4 代 · 自己算路
about.en: Era 4 · Routing itself

why.zh: 距离向量和链路状态两路并行，再到路径向量；建在第 3 代的路由器上。
why.en: Distance vector and link state in parallel, then path vector; builds on era 3's router.

about.zh: 第 5 代 · 端到端
about.en: Era 5 · End to end

why.zh: 端口、停等、滑动窗口、RTT 估计、握手、字节流分帧（长度前缀在这里）；兑现第 1 代「只查不补」和「回一声」。
why.en: Ports, stop-and-wait, sliding window, RTT estimation, handshake, framing a byte stream (the length prefix lives here); it cashes in era 1's detect-but-do-not-resend and its “Answer back”.

about.zh: 第 6 代 · 拥挤
about.en: Era 6 · Congestion

why.zh: AIMD、拥塞窗口、慢启动、快重传、队列管理；要曲线视图和代价度量。
why.en: AIMD, congestion window, slow start, fast retransmit, queue management; needs curve views and cost measures.

about.zh: 第 7 代 · 地址
about.en: Era 7 · Addresses

why.zh: DHCP、NAT，可选的 IPv6；建在第 3、5 代上。
why.en: DHCP, NAT, optional IPv6; builds on eras 3 and 5.

about.zh: 第 8 代 · 名字
about.en: Era 8 · Names

why.zh: 分层的名字、逐步解析、缓存与否定缓存，搭出解析器；建在第 5 代上。
why.en: Hierarchical names, iterative resolution, caching and negative caching, building a resolver; builds on era 5.

about.zh: 第 9 代 · 网页
about.en: Era 9 · The web

why.zh: 文本请求与响应（字符表在这里）、长度与分块、持久连接、Cookie、缓存；建在第 5、8 代上。
why.en: Text requests and responses (the character table lives here), length and chunking, persistent connections, cookies, caching; builds on eras 5 and 8.

about.zh: 第 10 代 · 保密
about.en: Era 10 · Secrecy

why.zh: 一次一密、Diffie–Hellman（模幂）、签名、证书、消息认证、TLS；要乘法与取模。
why.en: One-time pad, Diffie–Hellman (modular power), signatures, certificates, message authentication, TLS; needs multiply and modulo.

about.zh: 第 11 代 · 现代
about.en: Era 11 · Modern

why.zh: 多路复用、队头阻塞、QUIC、任播；全书终点，几乎只用前面搭出的元件。
why.en: Multiplexing, head-of-line blocking, QUIC, anycast; the course's endpoint, standing almost only on parts built before.

topic.zh: 计算机网络：从一根会出错的线搭到今天的互联网
topic.en: Computer networks: from one faulty wire up to today's internet

learner.zh: 不假设任何 IT 基础：比特、二进制数、「协议」这个词都在游戏里从头讲起。
learner.en: No IT background assumed: bits, binary numbers and the word “protocol” are all taught from scratch.

endpoint.zh: 在模拟世界里打开一个网页，跑的全是自己搭的东西：网卡、交换机、路由器、路由协议、可靠传输、拥塞控制、解析器、HTTP、TLS、QUIC，并能看清每一层在每一拍做了什么。
endpoint.en: Open a web page in the simulated world running only what the player built: network card, switch, router, routing protocol, reliable transport, congestion control, resolver, HTTP, TLS and QUIC, and see what every layer does at every tick.

scope.zh: 这份蓝图只写第 1 代「一根线」：两头之间一根逐拍送位、会翻位的线，从传一位走到一块能装到线两头的网卡。第 0 代（纸笔）的内容并进第 1 代用得着它的关，或推迟到用得着它的那一代；第 2–11 代只记一句，留待后续。
scope.en: This blueprint covers era 1, “One wire”: one wire between two ends carrying a bit a tick and flipping some, from passing on a bit to a network card that sits at both ends. What era 0 (paper and pencil) teaches is folded into the era-1 levels that need it, or deferred to the era that first needs it; eras 2–11 get one line each, for later.

why.zh: 这一代的内容全是时间里的事：位一拍一拍地到，晚到，要数拍、记住前几拍、在一串位里找开头。板每拍跑一遍，寄存卡跨拍保存，正好就是真实网卡里的移位寄存器和计数器。
why.en: Everything in this era happens in time: bits arrive one a tick and late, and the board must count ticks, remember earlier ones and find where a run begins. A board run every tick with registers across ticks is exactly the shift register and counter inside a real network card.

about.zh: 节点接在点对点的线上：每根线从一头把位逐拍送到另一头，过若干拍才到；没人说话时线上是 0。板上每根进来的线一个「线」元件，每根出去的线一个「说」元件。
about.en: A node sits on point-to-point wires: each wire carries one end's bits, a tick at a time, to the other end some ticks later; a wire nobody drives reads 0. A board has a line card for each wire coming in and a say card for each wire going out.

lacks.zh: 线只有两头，一拍只送一位：第三个人没有地方接，整帧也只能一位一位地走。第 2 代把线换成大家都挂在上面的总线，线两头装上网卡，一拍送一段。
lacks.en: A wire has two ends and carries a bit a tick: a third station has nowhere to plug in, and a frame crawls along bit by bit. Era 2 turns it into a bus everyone hangs on, with a network card at each end and a chunk sent per tick.

about.zh: 世界按拍推进：每一拍，板读一次进来的线，说一次出去的线；一根线一拍只送一位。
about.en: The world advances in ticks: each tick the board reads its incoming wires once and says on its outgoing wires once; a wire carries one bit a tick.

wall.zh: 起点：没有它，线上什么也不会发生。
wall.en: The starting point: without it nothing happens on the wire.

about.zh: 按一个条件在两路之间选一路：非、与、或都由选择接出。
about.en: Picking one of two values by a condition: not, and, or are all wired from it.

wall.zh: 传话的板只能原样照搬，要把一位反过来、或按另一根线决定说什么，就做不到。
wall.en: A relay can only copy; it cannot flip a bit or let another wire decide what is said.

about.zh: 寄存卡把一个值留到下一拍。
about.en: A register keeps a value for the next tick.

wall.zh: 板每拍从头算，算完什么也不留：「说出上一拍听到的」这样的规格无从满足。
wall.en: The board starts afresh every tick and keeps nothing: “say what you heard the tick before” cannot be met.

about.zh: 寄存卡加上加法就是数拍的计数器：能清零重来，也能在不该算的拍停住不数。
about.en: A register and an adder make a counter of ticks: it can restart, and it can stand still on ticks that should not count.

wall.zh: 要知道这一拍该发一个字节的第几位、已经收了几位，就得知道过了几拍；只记一拍的寄存卡不够。
wall.en: To know which bit of a byte is due, or how many bits have come in, the board must know how many ticks have passed; one remembered tick is not enough.

about.zh: 一个字节是 8 位二进制数，每一位的分量是后一位的两倍：从高位起逐位说出，收的一方每收一位就把已有的数翻倍再加上它。
about.en: A byte is an 8-bit binary number, each place worth twice the next: it is said from the top bit down, and the receiver doubles what it holds and adds each new bit.

wall.zh: 一根线一拍只能送一位，要送的却是 0 到 255 的数：数得先拆成位，到了再拼回去。
wall.en: A wire carries one bit a tick, but what must go across is a number from 0 to 255: it has to be taken apart into bits and put back together.

about.zh: 线空着时是 0；发送方先说一个 1（起始位）宣布字节开始，每个字节后跟一个 0（停止位）。
about.en: An idle wire reads 0; the sender says a 1 (the start bit) to announce a byte, and ends each byte with a 0 (the stop bit).

wall.zh: 发送方随时可能开口，以 0 开头的字节和空着的线分不出来：收的一方不知道从哪一拍开始数。
wall.en: The sender may begin at any tick, and a byte that starts with 0s looks like an idle wire: the receiver cannot tell where to start counting.

about.zh: 旗标 01111110 标出一帧的开头和结尾，收的一方在任何时候都能从位流里认出它。
about.en: The flag 01111110 marks where a frame begins and ends, and the receiver can spot it in the bit stream at any point.

wall.zh: 一帧有几个字节事先不知道：只靠起始位，收的一方分得出字节，分不出哪几个字节是一帧。
wall.en: How many bytes a frame holds is not known in advance: start bits separate bytes but not frames.

about.zh: 位填充：帧的内容里每连着 5 个 1，发送方就多说一个 0，收的一方再把它去掉，内容里就不会出现旗标。多说的那一拍，内容停一拍不走。
about.en: Bit stuffing: after every five 1s in a frame's content the sender adds a 0 and the receiver takes it out again, so the content never looks like a flag. On that extra tick the content stands still.

wall.zh: 内容里本身就有 01111110 时，收的一方把它当成旗标，一帧被从中间切断。
wall.en: When the content itself holds 01111110, the receiver takes it for a flag and the frame is cut in two.

about.zh: 发送方按约好的规则在数据后面附几位校验位，收的一方按同一规则核对，就知道数据在线上有没有被改。
about.en: The sender appends a few check bits by an agreed rule and the receiver checks them by the same rule, so it can tell whether the data changed on the way.

wall.zh: 线开始翻位以后，收到的字节错了，收的一方却毫不知情，照样交出去。
wall.en: Once the wire flips bits, a byte arrives wrong and the receiver hands it on without knowing.

about.zh: 把一串位当作一个大数，后面补上几个 0，用不进位的除法（每一步是异或）除以约好的生成式，余数就是校验码；逐拍做时，寄存卡里的几位就是到这一拍为止该跟的校验码（CRC）。
about.en: A run of bits is read as one big number, a few 0s are appended, and it is divided, without carries (each step an XOR), by an agreed generator; the remainder is the check. Done tick by tick, the bits in the registers are the check due after the bits so far (CRC).

wall.zh: 奇偶校验位只查得出奇数个错位：恰好翻两位时，校验照样相符。
wall.en: A parity bit catches only an odd number of flipped bits: with exactly two flipped, it still checks out.

about.zh: 分层：网卡对上面只收发整帧的字节，对下面只收发位；上面不必知道旗标、填充和校验字节。
about.en: Layering: the card deals in the bytes of whole frames with the layer above and in bits with the wire below; the layer above never sees flags, stuffing or the check byte.

wall.zh: 发帧、收帧、查错分在几块板上，每一个要用线的节点都得把它们重新接一遍。
wall.en: Sending frames, receiving them and checking them sit on separate boards, and every node that uses a wire must wire them up again.

about.zh: 选择：条件为是取一路，否则取另一路。
about.en: Select: one value when the condition holds, the other otherwise.

why.zh: 传话的板只有线和说；没有任何元件能按条件改变一个值，选择是所有逻辑的起点。
why.en: A relay board has only the line and the say card; nothing can change a value by a condition, and select is where all logic starts.

about.zh: 常数：给出设定的数。
about.en: Constant: the number it is set to.

why.zh: 线上和输入只给出变化的值；要说一个固定的 0 或 1，只能由常数给出。
why.en: Wires and inputs give only changing values; a fixed 0 or 1 can come only from a constant.

about.zh: 读寄存卡：同名寄存卡里存的值，存入之前给初值。
about.en: Register: what the register of the same name holds, its start value before.

why.zh: 板每拍从头算；跨拍的状态只能由寄存卡这一对元件保存，任何组合都接不出来。
why.en: The board starts afresh each tick; state across ticks can be held only by the register pair, and no wiring makes it.

about.zh: 存寄存卡：把接入的值存进同名寄存卡，下一拍读得出。
about.en: Keep: stores its input in the register of the same name, readable from the next tick.

why.zh: 同上：它和读寄存卡是一对，写入跨拍的状态。
why.en: As for the register: it is the other half of the pair, writing state across ticks.

about.zh: 相加：两个数之和（加一就是加上常数 1）。
about.en: Add: the sum of two numbers (adding one is adding the constant 1).

why.zh: 手上的元件只能选、只能存，不能让一个数变大；数拍、把收到的位拼成数都要它。
why.en: The parts in hand can only pick and store; none makes a number grow, and both counting and assembling bits into a number need it.

about.zh: 相等：两个数相等为是，否则为否。
about.en: Equal: yes when two numbers are the same, no otherwise.

why.zh: 计数器给出的是数，选择要的是是或否；用手上的元件比较两个多位的数，要把每一位拆出来逐位比，拆位的元件这时还没有。
why.en: A counter gives a number and select wants yes or no; comparing two multi-bit numbers from the parts in hand would need taking them apart bit by bit, which nothing in hand can do.

about.zh: 取位：一个 8 位数从最高位数起的第 i 位。
about.en: Bit of: bit i of an 8-bit number, counted from the top.

why.zh: 加法和相等只能把数变大、比是否相同，不能从一个数里取出某一位；发送一个字节必须一位一位地取。
why.en: Adding and comparing can make a number grow and test sameness, but not reach into a number for one bit; sending a byte means taking it bit by bit.

about.zh: 异或：两位不同为 1，相同为 0。
about.en: XOR: 1 when two bits differ, 0 when they agree.

about.zh: 计数器：自「重来」上一次为 1 起过了几拍，「暂停」为 1 的拍不算。
about.en: Counter: how many ticks since restart was last 1, the ticks hold is 1 left out.

about.zh: 移位发送：从「开始」那一拍起，用 8 拍把那一拍的字节从最高位起逐位说出，送完时报一声。
about.en: Shift out: from the start tick, says the byte it had then bit by bit from the top over 8 ticks, and signals when done.

about.zh: 按字节收：从「开始」那一拍起，每逢「暂停」为 0 收进一位，收满 8 位的那一拍给出这个字节。
about.en: Shift in: from the start tick, takes in a bit on every tick hold is 0 and gives the byte on the tick the eighth is taken.

about.zh: 成帧器：从交来的字节里取出一帧送出，前后加旗标，内容里做位填充。
about.en: Framer: takes a frame from the bytes handed down and sends it with a flag at each end and its content bit-stuffed.

about.zh: 拆帧器：在位流里认出旗标之间的帧，去掉填充的 0，逐个给出内容字节，帧结束时报一声。
about.en: Deframer: finds the frame between flags in the bit stream, takes out the stuffed 0s, gives the content bytes one by one and signals the frame's end.

about.zh: CRC：到这一拍为止收进的位该跟的校验码（补上 0 后不进位地除以 1011 的余数）；能清零重来，「暂停」的拍不收。
about.en: CRC: the check due after the bits taken in so far (their carry-less remainder by 1011 with 0s appended); it can restart, and skips the ticks on hold.

about.zh: 收帧器：从线上拆出每一帧，交出内容字节，扣下最后的校验字节和它核对，帧尾说出是否完好。
about.en: Receiver: unwraps each frame off the wire, gives up its content bytes, holds back the closing check byte to check it, and says at the frame's end whether it is intact.

about.zh: 网卡：上面交来的帧带上校验字节成帧送到线上；线上收到的帧拆开、核对，逐个字节交给上面，帧尾报好坏。
about.en: Network card: frames handed down go on the wire framed with their check byte; frames off the wire are unwrapped and checked, going up byte by byte with word at each end of whether they are intact.

question.zh: 一根一拍只送一位、还会出错的线，两头怎样互相送出一帧，并知道它完好？
question.en: Over a wire that carries a bit a tick and gets some wrong, how do two ends send each other a frame and know it arrived intact?

why.zh: 起点是一根线：两头约好 0 和 1，什么格式都还没有。这一代从照搬一位开始，一层层装出能发能收、能查错的网卡。纸笔一代教的几件事并进第一次用得着它们的关：两种状态在传话，二进制数在逐位发送和接收。
why.en: It starts from one wire: the ends agree on 0 and 1 and nothing else. The era begins by copying a bit and builds up, layer by layer, a card that sends, receives and checks. What the paper era taught goes into the first levels that need it: two states into passing a bit on, binary numbers into sending and gathering a byte.

task.zh: 每一拍把左边线上听到的位说到右边的线上。
task.en: Every tick, say on the right-hand wire the bit heard on the left-hand wire.

task.zh: 每一拍把听到的位反过来说出去：听到 1 说 0，听到 0 说 1。
task.en: Every tick, say the opposite of the bit you hear: 0 for 1, 1 for 0.

task.zh: 听两根线：两根线上的位不同时说 1，相同时说 0。
task.en: Listen to two wires: say 1 when their bits differ and 0 when they agree.

task.zh: 每一拍说出上一拍听到的位；第一拍说 0。
task.en: Every tick, say the bit heard the tick before; say 0 on the first tick.

task.zh: 线上出现 1 之前一直说 0；出现过 1 以后，每一拍都说 1。
task.en: Say 0 until a 1 has come down the wire, and 1 on every tick after that.

task.zh: 输出自「重来」上一次为 1 起已经过了几拍，「暂停」为 1 的拍不算。
task.en: Output how many ticks have passed since restart was last 1, leaving out the ticks on which hold is 1.

task.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起，用 8 拍把那一拍输入的字节从最高位起逐位说到线上，之后说 0。
task.en: From the tick start is 1, say the byte input then on the wire bit by bit from the top over 8 ticks, then say 0.

task.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起，每逢「暂停」为 0 就收进线上的一位（最高位在前），收满 8 位的那一拍输出这个字节。
task.en: From the tick start is 1, take in the bit on the wire on every tick hold is 0, top bit first, and output the byte on the tick the eighth is taken.

task.zh: 对方随时可能先说一个 1，再送 8 位；每收到一个字节就输出它。
task.en: At any tick the far end may say a 1 and then 8 bits; output each byte as it arrives.

task.zh: 把交来的几个字节依次送出，每个字节前加起始位 1，后加停止位 0。
task.en: Send the bytes handed to you one after another, each with a start bit 1 before it and a stop bit 0 after.

task.zh: 线上连续送来位；每当最近收到的 8 位是 01111110，就在那一拍说 1。
task.en: Bits keep coming down the wire; say 1 on every tick at which the last 8 bits read 01111110.

task.zh: 把交来的每一帧字节送出：前后各加旗标 01111110，内容里每连着 5 个 1 就多说一个 0。
task.en: Send each frame of bytes handed to you with a flag 01111110 at each end, adding a 0 after every five 1s in the content.

task.zh: 从线上认出旗标之间的每一帧，去掉塞进的 0，逐个输出内容字节，帧结束的那一拍报一声。
task.en: Find each frame between flags on the wire, take out the stuffed 0s, output the content bytes one by one and signal on the tick the frame ends.

task.zh: 每个字节后面跟一个奇偶校验位，线会翻位；输出收到的每个字节，并说出它的校验是否相符。
task.en: Each byte is followed by a parity bit and the wire flips bits; output each byte received and say whether its parity checks out.

task.zh: 每一拍输出到这一拍为止收到的位该跟的 3 位校验码（这些位后面补上三个 0、不进位地除以 1011 的余数）；「重来」为 1 时从头算起，「暂停」为 1 的拍不收。
task.en: Every tick, output the 3 check bits due after the bits received so far (their carry-less remainder by 1011 with three 0s appended); start over when restart is 1, and skip the bit on ticks hold is 1.

task.zh: 把交来的字节送出，紧接着送出它的 3 位校验码。
task.en: Send the byte handed to you, followed at once by its 3 check bits.

task.zh: 线会翻位，每帧内容后面跟一个校验字节（5 个 0 加 3 位校验码）：逐个输出每帧的内容字节，帧结束时说出它是否完好。
task.en: The wire flips bits, and each frame's content is followed by a check byte (five 0s, then the 3 check bits): output each frame's content bytes one by one and say at its end whether it arrived intact.

task.zh: 搭一块网卡：上面交来的帧带上校验字节送到出去的线上，进来的线上的帧逐个字节交给上面，帧尾说出是否完好；两个方向同时在走。
task.en: Build a network card: frames handed down go out on the outgoing wire with their check byte, and frames off the incoming wire go up byte by byte with word at each end of whether they arrived intact; both directions run at once.

task.zh: 两根线之间装两块网卡：左边线上来的帧，一个字节一个字节地交给右边的网卡送出去，不等整帧收完；到时是坏的帧，送出去也不能是好的。
task.en: Put two network cards between two wires and pass each frame from the left wire on to the right one byte at a time, without waiting for the whole frame; a frame that arrived broken must not leave intact.

task.zh: 每块 4 位数据后面跟 3 位校验码（生成式 1011），线在一块里最多翻一位；每块最后一位到达的那一拍，输出这块的第几位翻了（1 到 7），没翻就输出 0。
task.en: Each block is 4 data bits followed by 3 check bits (generator 1011), and the wire flips at most one bit in a block; on each block's last tick, output which of its 7 bits flipped (1 to 7), or 0 if none did.

naive.zh: 把余数直接当成位置输出：没有翻位时余数是 0，看起来对；可翻一位留下的余数并不是那一位的编号（翻第 1 位留下 4）。要看出的是 7 个位置留下 7 个各不相同的余数，再一一对上。
naive.en: Output the remainder itself as the position: it is 0 when nothing flipped, so it looks right, but the remainder a flip leaves is not that bit's number (flipping bit 1 leaves 4). The leap is that the seven positions leave seven different remainders, to be matched one by one.

why.zh: 起始位、旗标和校验都只建在字节上，互不依赖：起始位分出单个字节，旗标分出整帧，校验查出线上改了什么。网卡建在旗标和校验两路上；起始位是这一代对「从哪开始」的第一个回答。
why.en: Start bits, flags and checks each stand only on the byte and not on each other: start bits mark single bytes, flags whole frames, and checks catch what the wire changed. The card stands on flags and checks together; start bits are the era's first answer to where a byte starts.

about.zh: 点对点的线：每根线把一头说的位过 d 拍送到另一头，没人说时为 0；关卡写出拓扑（几根线、板在哪一头听或说），世界的节点在线的另一头按测试说位或听位，板上每根进来的线一个线元件、每根出去的线一个说元件。
about.en: Point-to-point wires: each carries the bits one end says to the other end d ticks later, 0 when nobody speaks; a level names its wires and which end the board hears or says on, world nodes at the far ends say or hear the test's bits, and the board has a line card per incoming wire and a say card per outgoing one.

note.zh: 做成了：关卡写 wires.in 和 wires.out，每根线一张进线、出线元件，带 delay；进线上到达的位由测试定（线那头不回听），所以板这一拍可以说它这一拍听到的。
note.en: Done: a level writes wires.in and wires.out, a wire-in or wire-out card each, with a delay; what arrives on a wire in is fixed by the test (the far end does not listen back), so a board may say this tick what it hears this tick.

about.zh: 原始元件选择、相加、相等、取位（8 位数从最高位起的第 i 位），碰到「—」给「—」。
about.en: The primitives select, add, equal and bit-of (bit i of an 8-bit number from the top), giving 「—」 for 「—」.

note.zh: 做成了：select、add、equal、bit（取位），加上 reg、keep、const。
note.en: Done: select, add, equal and bit (bit of), with reg, keep and const.

about.zh: 输出的要求：逐拍写定的值（含「—」）；只比非「—」值的先后、不比时刻的值序列；以及线另一头的世界节点按约定的格式（裸位、起止位、旗标、旗标加 CRC）解出收到的字节，必须等于要送的内容。
about.en: What outputs must be: values fixed tick by tick (「—」 included); the order of the non-「—」 values, timing aside; and what a world node at the far end decodes by an agreed format (raw bits, start/stop, flags, flags with CRC), which must equal what was to be sent.

note.zh: 做成了：每一拍的项（echo、opposite、differ、late、heard、count、serial、pattern、remainder、decoded、intact，以及测试里写定的 given）、不论时机的项（bytes、ends）和线那头的项（sent、relayed）；格式有 bytes、startstop、parity、check、blocks、flag、flagcheck。
note.en: Done: items checked tick by tick (echo, opposite, differ, late, heard, count, serial, pattern, remainder, decoded, intact, and given for values a test writes out), items checked in order timing aside (bytes, ends), and the far end's (sent, relayed); the formats are bytes, startstop, parity, check, blocks, flag and flagcheck.

about.zh: 可以拉取的输入：关卡给一列字节（可分成几帧），板在一拍里说「下一个」，下一拍这一项出现在输入上，取完给「—」，帧与帧之间给出帧界。
about.en: An input the board pulls from: the level gives a list of bytes (possibly in frames); when the board asks for the next one, it appears on the input the following tick, 「—」 once used up, with frame boundaries marked.

note.zh: 做成了：关卡的 pulls 说哪个输入是队首、哪个输入标出一帧的最后一个字节、哪个输出取走它；测试的 queue 是一列帧。
note.en: Done: a level's pulls names the input showing the head of the queue, the input marking a frame's last byte, and the output that takes it; a test's queue is a list of frames.

about.zh: 会翻位的线：测试可以写定在哪几拍翻位（给隐藏测试用），也可以按出错率带种子随机翻位，在几个种子下各跑一遍。
about.en: A wire that flips bits: a test may name the ticks at which it flips (for hidden tests) or flip at random by an error rate with a seed, run over several seeds.

note.zh: 按写定的拍做成了（测试的 flips）；随机的错误率和种子不做：隐藏测试里写定的翻转已经能抓住 naive 解，种子只会让一关的结果不可复现。
note.en: Done for scripted ticks (a test's flips); a random error rate with seeds is declined: flips written into the hidden tests already catch the naive answers, and seeds would only make a level's result harder to reproduce.

about.zh: 搭出元件的板把它的线元件和说元件也作为元件的口，一个节点可以放几块（中继里的两块网卡）；关卡可以让玩家的同一块板跑在一根线的两头，各有各的寄存卡。
about.en: A board that builds a part exposes its line and say cards as the part's ports, so one node can hold several (two cards in a relay); a level may run the player's board at both ends of a wire, each copy with its own registers.

note.zh: 线就是板的口：搭出的元件把它那一关的进线、出线当作自己的输入、输出，一块板上放几个，各有各的寄存卡。两项不做：在线的两头各跑一份玩家的板（一关同时测两个方向——队列里的帧从出线发出，进线上的帧交到输出——已经测到它，不另跑一份）；把一帧整个存下再转发（第一代没有能存下一帧的元件，队列是第二代的事）：一关不能要求两块网卡之间存下一整帧再转发。
note.en: Wires are the board's ports: a built part takes the wires of its level as inputs and outputs of its own, and several on one board each keep their own registers. Two things are declined: running a copy of the player's board at the far end (a level that tests both directions at once — frames from the queue out on the wire out, frames on the wire in up to the outputs — already covers it); and holding a whole frame between two cards to forward it (no part in era 1 holds a frame; the queue belongs to era 2): no level may need two cards to store a whole frame and forward it.

about.zh: want「count」和「remainder」各加一个可选的输入 hold：hold 为 1 的拍不算——计数停在原处，这一拍的位不收进余数。
about.en: The wants count and remainder each take an optional input `hold`: a tick on which it is 1 does not count — the count stands still, and that tick's bit is not taken into the remainder.

note.zh: 做成了：count 和 remainder 都可以带输入 hold，为 1 的拍不算。
note.en: Done: count and remainder both take an input hold; a tick it is 1 does not count.

about.zh: 一种帧格式，像 flagcheck，只是校验码作为内容后面的一个整字节送出（前面补 0 凑满 8 位），一起做位填充；帧完好要求内容是整字节、最后一个字节等于内容的校验码。bytes、ends、sent、relayed 都按它解。
about.en: A frame format like flagcheck, except that the check bits go as one whole byte after the content (0s before them to make 8), stuffed with it; a frame is intact when its content is whole bytes and its last byte equals the content's check. bytes, ends, sent and relayed decode it.

note.zh: 做成了：格式 flagbyte，校验位前面补 0 凑成一个字节，和内容一起填充；bytes、ends、sent、relayed 都按它解。
note.en: Done: the format flagbyte, its check bits padded with 0s in front to a whole byte and stuffed with the content; bytes, ends, sent and relayed decode it.

about.zh: 第 0 代「纸笔」的四关手做关
about.en: Era 0, “Paper and pencil”, four manual levels

why.zh: 逐拍总线领域和盲玩 harness 都不支持手动关。两种状态并进 1-1，二进制数并进逐位发送和接收；字符对照表推迟到第 9 代的文本协议，那里第一次非它不可；长度前缀推迟到第 5 代的字节流分帧，理由同上。
why.en: Neither the tick-bus domain nor the blind-play harness supports manual levels. Two states go into 1-1, binary numbers into sending and gathering a byte; the character table waits for era 9's text protocols, where it is first indispensable, and the length prefix for era 5's framing on a byte stream, for the same reason.

about.zh: 设计稿里的机关台「晚到」（传播时间和发送时间）
about.en: The design sketch's bench “Arriving late” (propagation and transmission time)

why.zh: 这一代一拍送一位，发送时间还不是一回事，晚到在 1-1 的时序图里就看得见；它放到第 2 代整帧占线若干拍时。参数台盲玩也还不支持。
why.en: With a bit a tick, transmission time does not yet matter, and arriving late shows in 1-1's timeline; it goes to era 2, where a frame holds the wire for several ticks. Blind play does not support benches yet either.

about.zh: 设计稿的挑战「数据里正好有旗标」和网卡系列的前三关
about.en: The sketch's challenge “The data holds a flag” and the card series' first three levels

why.zh: 内容里出现旗标正是位填充那一关撞上的墙，做成挑战就成了新机制；送一句话、送几句话、线会出错只是重做 1-7 到 1-17，没有新维度，网卡一关直接站在已搭出的元件上。
why.en: A flag inside the content is the very wall of the stuffing level, so as a challenge it would bring a new mechanism; sending one message, several, and over a noisy wire only redo 1-7 to 1-17 with no new dimension, so the card level stands directly on the parts already built.

about.zh: 8 位生成式（校验码本身就是一个字节）和「改回来」的纠错挑战
about.en: An 8-bit generator (a check that is a byte by itself), and the error-correcting challenge “Put it right”

why.zh: 8 位的 CRC 要 8 张寄存卡，一块板只有 6 张；拿整字节的算术去凑，教的就不再是除法。所以生成式留在 1-15 搭出的 1011，校验码补成一个整字节送出（请求 check-byte）。纠错要把 7 位的块拼回 4 位数据，又和 8 位一收的按字节收对不上，难在拼凑；挑战改成找出翻的是哪一位，那个跳跃（余数认得出位置）原样保留，真正的纠错留到能存下一整块的第 2 代。
why.en: An 8-bit CRC needs eight registers and a board has six; faking it with byte arithmetic would no longer teach division. So the generator stays the 1011 that 1-15 builds, and the check is sent padded to a whole byte (request check-byte). Correcting means rebuilding 4 data bits from 7-bit blocks, which the 8-bit deserializer does not fit, and the work becomes assembly; the challenge instead finds which bit flipped, keeping the leap (the remainder names the position), and true correction waits for era 2, which can hold a whole block.

about.zh: 第 2 代 · 局域网
about.en: Era 2 · LAN

why.zh: 总线、地址、撞车与退避、交换机、生成树；要整帧的线和网卡收进线里，等第 1 代上线后再写。
why.en: Bus, addresses, collisions and backoff, switches, spanning tree; needs whole-frame wires with the card folded into them, written once era 1 is live.

about.zh: 第 3 代 · 网际
about.en: Era 3 · Internetwork

why.zh: 分层地址、路由器、报头校验（重复框）、最长前缀、ARP、TTL；要重复框，后续再写。
why.en: Hierarchical addresses, routers, header checksum (repeat frame), longest prefix, ARP, TTL; needs the repeat frame, for later.

about.zh: 第 4 代 · 自己算路
about.en: Era 4 · Routing itself

why.zh: 距离向量和链路状态两路并行，再到路径向量；建在第 3 代的路由器上。
why.en: Distance vector and link state in parallel, then path vector; builds on era 3's router.

about.zh: 第 5 代 · 端到端
about.en: Era 5 · End to end

why.zh: 端口、停等、滑动窗口、RTT 估计、握手、字节流分帧（长度前缀在这里）；兑现第 1 代「只查不补」。
why.en: Ports, stop-and-wait, sliding window, RTT estimation, handshake, framing a byte stream (the length prefix lives here); it cashes in era 1's detect-but-do-not-resend.

about.zh: 第 6 代 · 拥挤
about.en: Era 6 · Congestion

why.zh: AIMD、拥塞窗口、慢启动、快重传、队列管理；要曲线视图和代价度量。
why.en: AIMD, congestion window, slow start, fast retransmit, queue management; needs curve views and cost measures.

about.zh: 第 7 代 · 地址
about.en: Era 7 · Addresses

why.zh: DHCP、NAT，可选的 IPv6；建在第 3、5 代上。
why.en: DHCP, NAT, optional IPv6; builds on eras 3 and 5.

about.zh: 第 8 代 · 名字
about.en: Era 8 · Names

why.zh: 分层的名字、逐步解析、缓存与否定缓存，搭出解析器；建在第 5 代上。
why.en: Hierarchical names, iterative resolution, caching and negative caching, building a resolver; builds on era 5.

about.zh: 第 9 代 · 网页
about.en: Era 9 · The web

why.zh: 文本请求与响应（字符表在这里）、长度与分块、持久连接、Cookie、缓存；建在第 5、8 代上。
why.en: Text requests and responses (the character table lives here), length and chunking, persistent connections, cookies, caching; builds on eras 5 and 8.

about.zh: 第 10 代 · 保密
about.en: Era 10 · Secrecy

why.zh: 一次一密、Diffie–Hellman（模幂）、签名、证书、消息认证、TLS；要乘法与取模。
why.en: One-time pad, Diffie–Hellman (modular power), signatures, certificates, message authentication, TLS; needs multiply and modulo.

about.zh: 第 11 代 · 现代
about.en: Era 11 · Modern

why.zh: 多路复用、队头阻塞、QUIC、任播；全书终点，几乎只用前面搭出的元件。
why.en: Multiplexing, head-of-line blocking, QUIC, anycast; the course's endpoint, standing almost only on parts built before.

why: the domain step: carry and replaces, the answers want

value.zh: 做成了：关卡可以写 carry（从那一关的板开始：玩家通过时的板，没通过就用参考解，换上这一关的进线、输入、出线和输出；审计 carry-unseen 查它是先修），builds 可以写 replaces（往后托盘里给新的、不给旧的）。
value.en: Done: a level may write carry (it opens on that level’s board: the one the player passed it with, else its reference, with this level’s wires, inputs and outputs swapped in; the carry-unseen audit checks it is a prerequisite), and builds may write replaces (from there on the tray offers the new part instead of the old).

value.zh: 做成了：answers，线那头按格式解出的回帧，每到一帧回一帧，只装一个字节，完好为 1、坏了为 0。
value.en: Done: answers, the replies the far end decodes in the format, one a frame that arrived, each holding one byte, 1 when intact and 0 when broken.

why: Era 1 brought in line with the revised blueprint (33 slots): 1-19 removed; XOR built at 1-31 (the old 1-3), the stuffing framer at 1-40 (the old 1-12) and the deframer at 1-30 (the old 1-13), whose meanings moved there; counter, deserializer and CRC lose hold, which comes back as pausable successors that replace them (1-27, 1-28, 1-29, 1-36, opened on the old boards by carry); equal gets its own slot (1-21); new practice levels for counting, compare, flags, parity and the CRC; the card answers back (1-37).

brief.zh: 听两根线：两根线上都是 1 时说 1，否则说 0。
brief.en: Listen to two wires: say 1 when both carry a 1, and 0 otherwise.

t.zh: 到这里为止，说什么只取决于一根线。这一次板同时听两根线，说出的位由两根线一起决定。
t.en: So far what the board says has depended on one wire. Now it listens to two, and what it says depends on both.

hint.zh: 先固定线 A 的值，看线 B 该怎样决定输出。
hint.en: Hold wire A still and see how wire B should decide the output.

hint.zh: 线 A 为 0 时，输出是什么？线 A 为 1 时呢？
hint.en: When wire A is 0, what is the output? And when A is 1?

brief.zh: 输出自「重来」上一次为 1 起已经过了几拍：那一拍为 0；「重来」还没为 1 过时，从第一拍数起。
brief.en: Output how many ticks have passed since restart was last 1: 0 on that tick, counted from the first tick before restart is ever 1.

hint.zh: 先不管「重来」，只让输出每拍大一。
hint.en: Leave restart aside at first, and just make the output grow by one each tick.

hint.zh: 「重来」那一拍的数是 0：这是一个选择。
hint.en: On a restart tick the number is 0: that is a choice.

desc.zh: 自「重来」上一次为 1 起过了几拍：那一拍为 0；「重来」还没为 1 过时从第一拍数起。
desc.en: How many ticks since restart was last 1: 0 on that tick, counted from the first tick before restart is ever 1.

brief.zh: 每一拍输出线上已经连着来了几个 1；来的是 0 的那一拍输出 0。
brief.en: Every tick, output how many 1s in a row have come down the wire; output 0 on a tick a 0 arrives.

t.zh: <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref>数的是过了几拍。这一次要数的是线上连着来的 1。
t.en: <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref> counts the ticks that pass. This time what must be counted is the 1s in a row on the wire.

hint.zh: 什么时候该从 0 数起？
hint.en: When should the count start again from 0?

brief.zh: 在第 7、15、23……拍说 1，其余各拍说 0（第一拍是第 0 拍）。
brief.en: Say 1 on ticks 7, 15, 23 and so on, and 0 on every other tick (the first tick is tick 0).

t.zh: <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref>给出的是一个数，<part-ref to="part:select"></part-ref>要的却是是或否：数到几的时候该做什么，还无从判断。新元件<part-ref to="part:equal"></part-ref>说出两个数是否相同。
t.en: <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref> gives a number, but <part-ref to="part:select"></part-ref> wants a yes or no: what to do once the count reaches a value cannot yet be decided. The new part <part-ref to="part:equal"></part-ref> says whether two numbers are the same.

hint.zh: 数到 7 以后，计数要从 0 重新开始。
hint.en: After 7, the count must start again from 0.

hint.zh: 数到 7 的那一拍发生的事，要到下一拍才能让计数重来。
hint.en: What happens on the tick the count reaches 7 can restart it only on the tick after.

brief.zh: 线上连着来到第 5 个 1 的那一拍说 1，其余各拍说 0。
brief.en: Say 1 on the tick that brings the fifth 1 in a row, and 0 on every other tick.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-22"></level-ref>数出了连着来的 1，<part-ref to="part:equal"></part-ref>能把一个数变成是或否。这一次两件事合在一起。
t.en: <level-ref to="1-22"></level-ref> counts the 1s in a row, and <part-ref to="part:equal"></part-ref> turns a number into a yes or no. This time the two go together.

hint.zh: 第 6 个、第 10 个 1 都不是第 5 个。
hint.en: The sixth 1 is not the fifth, and neither is the tenth.

t.zh: 要送过去的是 0 到 255 的数，线一拍却只送一位。一个<wiki-ref to="byte"></wiki-ref>是 8 位的<wiki-ref to="binary"></wiki-ref>，每一位的分量是后一位的两倍；把它拆成位，一拍一位地说出去，叫<wiki-ref to="serial"></wiki-ref>。新元件<part-ref to="part:bit"></part-ref>从一个数里取出指定的一位。
t.en: What must go across is a number from 0 to 255, but the wire carries one bit a tick. A <wiki-ref to="byte"></wiki-ref> is an 8-bit <wiki-ref to="binary"></wiki-ref>, each place worth twice the next; taking it apart and saying it a bit a tick is <wiki-ref to="serial"></wiki-ref>. The new part <part-ref to="part:bit"></part-ref> takes a given bit out of a number.

brief.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起收进线上的 8 位，最高位在前；收满 8 位的那一拍输出这个字节，「收完」为 1，其余各拍为 0。
brief.en: From the tick start is 1, take in the wire's 8 bits, top bit first; on the tick the eighth comes in, output the byte and make done 1, and 0 on every other tick.

hint.zh: 每收进一位，已经攒下的数要怎样变，才能让先到的位分量更大？
hint.en: With each new bit, what must happen to the number held so far, so that earlier bits end up worth more?

hint.zh: 已经收了几位，<part-ref to="counter"></part-ref>数得出来。
hint.en: <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref> can count the bits taken in.

hint.zh: 「开始」那一拍收进的就是第一位，之前攒下的都不算。
hint.en: The bit on the start tick is the first one; whatever was gathered before it does not count.

desc.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起收进线上的 8 位，最高位在前；收满的那一拍给出这个字节，「收完」为 1；其余各拍字节是「—」，「收完」为 0。
desc.en: From the tick start is 1, takes in 8 bits off its wire in, top bit first; on the tick the eighth comes in gives the byte with done 1; on every other tick the byte is 「—」 and done 0.

desc.zh: 进线上最近收到的 8 位正好是 01111110 的那一拍为 1，其余各拍为 0。
desc.en: 1 on each tick at which the last 8 bits on its wire in read 01111110, 0 on every other.

brief.zh: 每一拍输出上一个旗标结束以后线上又来了几位：旗标结束的那一拍为 0；还没来过旗标时也输出 0。
brief.en: Every tick, output how many bits have come since the last flag ended: 0 on the tick it ends, and 0 before any flag has come.

t.zh: <part-ref to="flagspot"></part-ref>在旗标结束的那一拍说 1。旗标标出的是位流里的一个位置，从那里数起，就知道一帧的位走到了哪里。
t.en: <part-ref to="flagspot"></part-ref> says 1 on the tick a flag ends. A flag marks a place in the bit stream, and counting from there tells how far a frame's bits have got.

hint.zh: 旗标还没来过的时候，输出要停在 0。
hint.en: Until a flag has come, the output must stay at 0.

brief.zh: 把交来的每一帧送出，前后各加一个旗标 01111110，只在「发送」为 1 时开始新的一帧。「下一个」取走队首，「末字节」标出帧尾。
brief.en: Send each frame handed to you with a flag 01111110 before and after it, starting a new frame only while send is 1. Next takes the byte in front; last marks a frame's final byte.

t.zh: <part-ref to="flagspot"></part-ref>在位流里认得出旗标。这一次换到发送的一方：一帧有几个字节，看队首的「末字节」就知道。
t.en: <part-ref to="flagspot"></part-ref> spots flags in the bit stream. Now the board is the sender: how many bytes a frame holds shows in the last-byte mark at the head of the queue.

hint.zh: 旗标就是字节 126。
hint.en: A flag is the byte 126.

hint.zh: 一帧的结尾旗标不能兼作下一帧的开头。
hint.en: A frame's closing flag cannot double as the next frame's opening one.

hint.zh: 没有帧要送的时候，线上可以一直说旗标。
hint.en: While there is no frame to send, the wire may keep saying flags.

brief.zh: 认出线上旗标之间的每一帧，逐个给出内容字节：字节收全的那一拍输出它，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完的那一拍「帧尾」为 1；其余各拍两个信号为 0。
brief.en: Find each frame between flags on the wire and give its content bytes one by one: output each on the tick it is complete, with got 1; end is 1 on the tick the closing flag is complete; otherwise both are 0.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-12"></level-ref>送出的帧到了线的另一头。这一次在收的一方：认出旗标，把旗标之间的位拼回字节。
t.en: Frames like those of <level-ref to="1-12"></level-ref> reach the other end of the wire. Now the board is the receiver: spotting flags and putting the bits between them back into bytes.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="deserializer"></part-ref>要从旗标后面的第一位收起。
hint.en: <part-ref to="deserializer"></part-ref> must start at the first bit after a flag.

hint.zh: 结尾旗标的 8 位收齐时，看起来也像收满了一个字节。
hint.en: When the 8 bits of the closing flag are in, they look like a full byte too.

brief.zh: 像数拍一样输出自「重来」起过了几拍，只是「暂停」为 1 的拍不算：那一拍的数和上一拍相同。
brief.en: Count the ticks since restart as before, except that ticks on which hold is 1 do not count: on them the number stays as it was.

t.zh: 内容里有 01111110 时，帧会被从中间切断；要在内容里多塞一位把它拆开，别的都得等一拍。可<part-ref to="counter"></part-ref>每拍都往前走。
t.en: When the content holds 01111110 the frame is cut in two, and slipping in an extra bit to break it up means everything else must wait a tick. But <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref> moves on every tick.

hint.zh: 「重来」和「暂停」同时为 1 时，「重来」优先。
hint.en: When restart and hold are both 1, restart wins.

hint.zh: 要留到下一拍的值不止一个时，就用几个名字不同的寄存卡。
hint.en: When more than one value has to last until the next tick, use registers with different names.

desc.zh: 自「重来」上一次为 1 起过了几拍：那一拍为 0，「重来」还没为 1 过时从第一拍数起；「暂停」为 1 的拍不算，数停在原处。
desc.en: How many ticks since restart was last 1: 0 on that tick, counted from the first tick before restart is ever 1; ticks on which hold is 1 do not count, and the number stands still.

brief.zh: 像一位一位地发一样送出字节，只是「暂停」为 1 的拍说 0，该说的那一位留到下一拍；说出最后一位的那一拍「送完」为 1。
brief.en: Send a byte bit by bit as before, except that on a tick hold is 1 you say 0 and the bit due waits for the next; done is 1 on the tick the last bit is said.

t.zh: <part-ref to="counterhold"></part-ref>会停了。正在发的字节也要能停：多塞一位的那一拍，字节里该说的那一位留到下一拍。
t.en: <part-ref to="counterhold"></part-ref> can stand still now. The byte being sent must too: on the tick an extra bit goes in, the bit of the byte that was due waits for the next tick.

hint.zh: 「开始」那一拍也可能是「暂停」的拍。
hint.en: The start tick may be a hold tick too.

desc.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起，把那一拍的字节从最高位起逐位说出；「暂停」为 1 的拍说 0，该说的那一位留到下一拍；说出最后一位的那一拍「送完」为 1。
desc.en: From the tick start is 1, says the byte of that tick bit by bit from the top; on a tick hold is 1 it says 0 and the bit due waits a tick; done is 1 on the tick the last bit is said.

brief.zh: 像夹在旗标之间那样一帧一帧送出交来的字节，只是内容里每连着 5 个 1 就多说一个 0。
brief.en: Send the frames handed to you between flags as before, except that after every five 1s in a row in the content you add a 0.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-13"></level-ref>里，内容本身含有 01111110 时，收的一方会把它当成旗标，一帧被从中间切断。两头于是再约好：内容里每连着 5 个 1，发送方就多说一个 0，收的一方再把它去掉。这叫<wiki-ref to="stuffing"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: In <level-ref to="1-13"></level-ref>, content that itself holds 01111110 is taken for a flag and the frame is cut in two. So the ends agree on one more rule: after every five 1s in a row in the content the sender says an extra 0, and the receiver takes it out again. This is <wiki-ref to="stuffing"></wiki-ref>.

desc.zh: 把交来的字节一帧一帧地送出：「发送」为 1 时开始新的一帧，前后各加旗标 01111110，内容里每连着 5 个 1 多说一个 0；没有开始新帧时线上说旗标。「下一个」为 1 的那一拍取走眼前的字节。
desc.en: Sends the bytes handed to it frame by frame: a new frame begins while send is 1, with the flag 01111110 at each end and a 0 added after every five 1s in its content; flags fill the wire between frames. Next is 1 on the tick it takes the byte in front of it.

brief.zh: 像一位一位地收一样收一个字节，只是「暂停」为 1 的拍线上那一位不收；收满 8 位的那一拍输出字节，「收完」为 1。
brief.en: Gather a byte as before, except that the bit on a tick hold is 1 is not taken in; on the tick the eighth is taken, output the byte and make done 1.

t.zh: 发送方多塞了一个 0，内容停了一拍。收的一方也要能停：那一拍线上的位不是内容，不收进来。
t.en: The sender slipped in an extra 0 and the content stood still a tick. The receiver must be able to stand still too: that tick's bit on the wire is not content and is not taken in.

hint.zh: 「开始」那一拍也可能是「暂停」的拍。
hint.en: The start tick may be a hold tick too.

desc.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起收进线上的 8 位，最高位在前，「暂停」为 1 的拍那一位不收；收满的那一拍给出这个字节，「收完」为 1；其余各拍字节是「—」，「收完」为 0。
desc.en: From the tick start is 1, takes in 8 bits off its wire in, top bit first, leaving out the bit of every tick hold is 1; on the tick the eighth comes in gives the byte with done 1; on every other tick the byte is 「—」 and done 0.

hint.zh: 连着五个 1 之后来的 0 是塞进去的，不算内容。
hint.en: A 0 that comes after five 1s in a row was stuffed in and is not content.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="deserializerhold"></part-ref>在「暂停」的拍不收线上的位。
hint.en: <part-ref to="deserializerhold"></part-ref> leaves out the wire's bit on hold ticks.

hint.zh: 一个 0 是不是塞进去的，要看它前面连着几个 1。
hint.en: Whether a 0 was stuffed in depends on how many 1s came just before it.

brief.zh: 对方把每一位同时说在两根线上，线会翻位：两根线上的位不同时说 1，相同时说 0。
brief.en: The far end says every bit on two wires at once and the wires flip bits: say 1 when the two disagree and 0 when they agree.

t.zh: 从这里起，线会把个别的位翻过来，收到的位错了，收的一方却毫不知情。最笨的办法是同一份话送两遍：两份不一样，就知道出了错。这叫<wiki-ref to="error-detection"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: From here on the wire flips the odd bit, and a bit that arrives wrong gives no sign of it. The crudest remedy is to say everything twice: when the two copies disagree, something went wrong. This is <wiki-ref to="error-detection"></wiki-ref>.

brief.zh: 从第一拍起把交来的字节一个接一个送出，中间不留空：每个字节后面跟一个校验位，字节里有奇数个 1 时为 1。
brief.en: From the first tick, send the bytes handed to you back to back, each followed by a parity bit that is 1 when the byte holds an odd number of 1s.

t.zh: 送两份要把线占去一倍。省得多的办法只附一位：让连它在内的 1 的个数凑成偶数，叫<wiki-ref to="parity"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: Sending twice takes up the wire twice over. A far cheaper rule appends a single bit that makes the count of 1s, itself included, even: a <wiki-ref to="parity"></wiki-ref>.

hint.zh: 1 的个数是奇是偶，可以一位一位地跟着记。
hint.en: Whether the count of 1s is odd or even can be tracked bit by bit.

hint.zh: 一个字节连同校验位占 9 拍。
hint.en: A byte with its parity bit takes 9 ticks.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-32"></level-ref>在发送的一方附上校验位。这一次换到收的一方：线照样会翻位，每个字节都要核对。
t.en: <level-ref to="1-32"></level-ref> appends the parity bit at the sending end. Now the board is the receiver: the wire still flips bits, and every byte must be checked.

brief.zh: 每一拍输出到这一拍为止收到的位该跟的 3 位校验码，即这些位补上三个 0 后不进位地除以 1011 的余数；「重来」为 1 的拍从这一位重新算起。
brief.en: Every tick, output the 3 check bits due after the bits received so far: their carry-less remainder by 1011 with three 0s appended, as a number. On a tick restart is 1, start over from that bit.

desc.zh: 到这一拍为止收进的位该跟的 3 位校验码（补上三个 0 后不进位地除以 1011 的余数，0 到 7 的数）；「重来」为 1 的那一拍从这一位重新算起。
desc.en: The 3 check bits due after the bits taken in so far (their carry-less remainder by 1011 with three 0s appended, a number from 0 to 7); on a tick restart is 1 it starts over from that bit.

hint.zh: 说到线上的每一位，也要同时交给<part-ref to="crc"></part-ref>。
hint.en: Every bit said on the wire should also go to <part-ref to="crc"></part-ref>.

hint.zh: 字节说完的那一拍，校验码就定了；之后线上的位不该再改变它。
hint.en: The check is settled on the tick the byte is out; the bits on the wire after that must not change it.

hint.zh: 校验码是 0 到 7 的数：它的 3 位排在一个 8 位数的最后。
hint.en: The check is a number from 0 to 7: its 3 bits are the last three of an 8-bit number.

brief.zh: 从第一拍起，每个字节后面紧跟它的 3 位校验码，线在一个字节里可能翻两位：每个字节的校验码到齐的那一拍，输出这个字节和它是否完好。
brief.en: From the first tick, each byte comes followed by its 3 check bits, and the wire may flip two bits in one: on the tick a byte's check is all in, output the byte and whether it arrived intact.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-14"></level-ref>的校验位只查得出奇数个错位：恰好翻两位时，校验照样相符。<level-ref to="1-16"></level-ref>送出的校验码查不查得出？
t.en: The parity bit of <level-ref to="1-14"></level-ref> catches only an odd number of flips: with two flipped it still checks out. Does the check sent in <level-ref to="1-16"></level-ref> catch them?

hint.zh: 一个字节连同校验码占 11 拍。
hint.en: A byte with its check takes 11 ticks.

hint.zh: 完好的字节连同它的校验码一起除，余数是多少？
hint.en: Divide an intact byte together with its check: what remainder is left?

after.zh: 相隔正好 7 位的两处翻位，生成式 1011 照样查不出。
after.en: Two flips exactly 7 bits apart still slip past the generator 1011.

brief.zh: 像边收边除一样输出该跟的校验码，只是「暂停」为 1 的拍线上那一位不收进去。
brief.en: Give the check due as in dividing as it comes, except that the bit on a tick hold is 1 is not taken in.

t.zh: 塞进去的 0 不是内容，收的一方算校验码时也不能把它算进去：<part-ref to="crc"></part-ref>也要能停一拍。
t.en: A stuffed 0 is not content, and the receiver must leave it out of the check as well: <part-ref to="crc"></part-ref> must be able to stand still for a tick.

hint.zh: 「暂停」那一拍，记下的余数一位也不变。
hint.en: On a hold tick, the remainder held does not change at all.

desc.zh: 到这一拍为止收进的位该跟的 3 位校验码（补上三个 0 后不进位地除以 1011 的余数，0 到 7 的数）；「重来」为 1 的那一拍从这一位重新算起，「暂停」为 1 的拍不收这一位。
desc.en: The 3 check bits due after the bits taken in so far (their carry-less remainder by 1011 with three 0s appended, a number from 0 to 7); on a tick restart is 1 it starts over from that bit, and on a tick hold is 1 it leaves that bit out.

brief.zh: 进线上每到一帧，就从出线回一个只有一个字节的帧：完好回 1，坏了回 0。
brief.en: For every frame that arrives on the wire in, send back a one-byte frame on the wire out: 1 if it arrived intact, 0 if broken.

t.zh: <part-ref to="nic"></part-ref>收得到帧，也查得出它好不好，发帧的一方却还不知道。线那头要听到回话。
t.en: <part-ref to="nic"></part-ref> receives frames and can tell whether they are intact, but the sender does not know it yet. The far end needs an answer.

hint.zh: 一帧结束、知道它好坏以后，才有回话可说。
hint.en: There is an answer to give only once a frame has ended and its state is known.

hint.zh: 回话要先留住，等网卡取走。
hint.en: Hold the answer until the adapter takes it.

question.zh: 一根一拍只送一位、还会出错的线，两头怎样互相送出一帧，并知道它完好？
question.en: Over a wire that carries a bit a tick and gets some wrong, how do two ends send each other a frame and know it arrived intact?

question.zh: 一根一拍只送一位、还会出错的线，两头怎样互相送出一帧，并知道它完好？
question.en: Over a wire that carries a bit a tick and gets some wrong, how do two ends send each other a frame and know it arrived intact?

brief.zh: 线上从第一拍起接连送来 7 位码字：4 位数据加 3 位校验码（生成式 1011），每个最多翻一位。码字最后一位到达的那一拍，输出翻的是第几位（先到的为第 1 位），没翻输出 0。
brief.en: From the first tick, 7-bit codewords come down the wire back to back: 4 data bits, then 3 check bits (generator 1011), with at most one bit flipped in each. On the tick a codeword's last bit arrives, output which bit flipped (the first to arrive is 1), or 0 if none.

t.zh: 到这里为止，校验码只用来判断收到的东西是好是坏。这一次每个<wiki-ref to="codeword"></wiki-ref>只有 4 位数据，却带着 3 位校验码。
t.en: So far check bits have only judged whether something arrived intact. This time each <wiki-ref to="codeword"></wiki-ref> carries just 4 data bits, and 3 check bits.

hint.zh: 先在纸上算：没有翻位时余数是多少？只翻第 1 位时呢？
hint.en: Work it out on paper first: what is the remainder when nothing flipped? When only bit 1 flipped?

after.zh: 余数不只说出有没有错，还说得出错在哪里：校验码从此也能用来<wiki-ref to="error-correction"></wiki-ref>。
after.en: A remainder says not only whether something went wrong but where: from here a check can also serve for <wiki-ref to="error-correction"></wiki-ref>.

brief.zh: 搭一块网卡，两个方向同时工作。往下：交来的帧带上校验字节成帧，从出线送出，「发送」为 1 时开始，「下一个」取走队首。往上：进线上的帧拆开、核对，输出的时机同<part-ref to="receiver"></part-ref>。
brief.en: Build a network adapter working both ways at once. Down: frames handed to it go out framed on the wire out with their check byte, starting on a tick send is 1, next taking the byte in front. Up: frames off the wire in are unwrapped and checked, timed as in <part-ref to="receiver"></part-ref>.

t.zh: 发帧和收帧各是一个元件，查错的校验码又要另外算：每一个要用线的节点，都得把它们重新接一遍。把它们装进一块网卡：对上面只收发整帧的字节，对下面只收发线上的位，上面不必知道旗标、填充和校验字节。这叫<wiki-ref to="layering"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: Sending frames and receiving them are separate parts, and the check is worked out apart from both: every node that uses a wire would have to wire them up again. Put them into one network adapter: it deals in the bytes of whole frames with the layer above and in bits on the wire below, and the layer above never sees flags, stuffing or the check byte. This is <wiki-ref to="layering"></wiki-ref>.

hint.zh: 两个方向互不相干；往上的一半，手上已经有现成的元件。
hint.en: The two directions do not touch each other, and a part in hand already does the upward half.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="framer"></part-ref>只送交给它的字节：校验字节要在最后一个内容字节之后交给它。
hint.en: <part-ref to="framer"></part-ref> sends only the bytes it is given: the check byte has to be given to it after the last content byte.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="crc"></part-ref>要收的是内容字节本身的位，不是线上带着旗标和填充的位；整帧内容收完时的结果要留住。
hint.en: <part-ref to="crc"></part-ref> must take in the bits of the content bytes, not the wire's bits with flags and stuffing; keep its result from the moment the whole content is in.

after.zh: 从这里起，用线的节点只和网卡打交道：每一层只管自己的事。
after.en: From here on a node that uses a wire deals only with its adapter: each layer minds its own business.

desc.zh: 往下：交来的帧带上校验字节成帧送到出线上，「发送」为 1 的拍开始一帧，「下一个」为 1 的那一拍取走眼前的字节。往上：进线上来的帧拆开、核对，每个内容字节在它后面那个字节收全的那一拍给出，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完的那一拍「帧尾」为 1，「完好」说出这一帧是否完好。
desc.en: Down: frames handed to it go out on its wire out, framed with their check byte; a frame begins on a tick send is 1, and next is 1 on the tick it takes the byte in front of it. Up: frames off its wire in are unwrapped and checked, each content byte given on the tick the byte after it is complete, with got 1; on the tick the closing flag is complete, end is 1 and intact says whether the frame arrived intact.

brief.zh: 逐个给出每帧的内容字节（校验字节除外）：每个在后一个字节收全的那一拍给出，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完时「帧尾」为 1，「完好」说出这帧是否完好；其余各拍为「—」或 0。
brief.en: Give each frame's content bytes, the check byte aside: each on the tick the byte after it is complete, with got 1. When the closing flag is complete, end is 1 and intact says whether the frame arrived intact. On every other tick, 「—」 or 0.

t.zh: 到这里为止，校验码护着的只是一个字节，线照样会翻位。一帧有几个字节事先不知道，校验码于是放在整帧内容的后面：前面补 5 个 0 凑成一个校验字节，和内容一起做位填充。收的一方要等这一帧结束，才知道最后收到的是校验字节。
t.en: So far a check has guarded a single byte, and the wire still flips bits. A frame's length is not known in advance, so its check goes after the whole content: five 0s in front make it a check byte, stuffed along with the content. Only when the frame ends does the receiver know the last byte was the check.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="deframer"></part-ref>交出的每个字节，都可能是最后那个校验字节。
hint.en: Any byte <part-ref to="deframer"></part-ref> gives could be the closing check byte.

hint.zh: 一个字节先留住，等下一个字节收全时再交出去。
hint.en: Hold each byte back until the next one is complete, then pass it on.

hint.zh: 帧尾那一拍，<part-ref to="crc"></part-ref>收进的应当只有内容字节的位。
hint.en: By the frame's end, <part-ref to="crc"></part-ref> should have taken in the bits of the content bytes and nothing else.

desc.zh: 从进线上拆出每一帧，扣下最后的校验字节：每个内容字节在它后面那个字节收全的那一拍给出，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完的那一拍「帧尾」为 1，「完好」说出这一帧是否完好。其余各拍字节和「完好」是「—」，「收到」「帧尾」为 0。
desc.en: Unwraps each frame off its wire in and holds back the closing check byte: gives each content byte on the tick the byte after it is complete, with got 1; on the tick the closing flag is complete, end is 1 and intact says whether the frame arrived intact. On every other tick the byte and intact are 「—」, got and end 0.

brief.zh: 把交来的字节从第一拍起逐位送出（最高位在前），紧接着送出它的 3 位校验码。
brief.en: Send the byte handed to you bit by bit from the first tick, top bit first, followed at once by its 3 check bits.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-15"></level-ref>在收的一方算出校验码。这一次换到发送的一方：校验码要紧跟在数据后面送出去。
t.en: <level-ref to="1-15"></level-ref> works out the check at the receiving end. Now the board is the sender, and the check has to follow the data onto the wire.

hint.zh: 说到线上的每一位，也要同时交给<part-ref to="crc"></part-ref>。
hint.en: Every bit said on the wire should also go to <part-ref to="crc"></part-ref>.

hint.zh: 字节说完以后，<part-ref to="crc"></part-ref>不该再收位，不然校验码会跟着变。
hint.en: Once the byte is out, <part-ref to="crc"></part-ref> must take in no more bits, or the check moves.

hint.zh: 校验码是 0 到 7 的数：它的 3 位排在一个 8 位数的最后。
hint.en: The check is a number from 0 to 7: its 3 bits are the last three of an 8-bit number.

brief.zh: 每一拍输出到这一拍为止收到的位该跟的 3 位校验码，即这些位补上三个 0 后不进位地除以 1011 的余数；「重来」为 1 的拍从这一位重新算起，「暂停」为 1 的拍不收这一位。
brief.en: Every tick, output the 3 check bits due after the bits received so far: their carry-less remainder by 1011 with three 0s appended, as a number. On a tick restart is 1, start over from that bit; on a tick hold is 1, leave that bit out.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-14"></level-ref>的校验位只查得出奇数个错位：恰好翻两位时，校验照样相符。
t.en: The parity bit of <level-ref to="1-14"></level-ref> catches only an odd number of flips: with exactly two flipped, it still checks out.

t.zh: 更强的校验把一串位当作一个大数，后面补上几个 0，用<wiki-ref to="carryless"></wiki-ref>除以约好的除数，这个除数叫<wiki-ref to="generator"></wiki-ref>；余数就是跟在数据后面的校验码。这种校验叫<wiki-ref to="crc"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: A stronger check reads a run of bits as one big number, appends a few 0s and divides it by <wiki-ref to="carryless"></wiki-ref> by an agreed divisor, the <wiki-ref to="generator"></wiki-ref>; the remainder is the check sent after the data. This check is a <wiki-ref to="crc"></wiki-ref>.

hint.zh: 先在纸上把 1101 补上 000，不进位地除以 1011，看每一步余数怎样变。
hint.en: On paper, append 000 to 1101 and divide it by 1011 without carries, watching the remainder at each step.

hint.zh: 三个寄存卡各记一位，就记得下除到这一拍为止的结果。
hint.en: Three registers, a bit each, are enough to hold where the division stands.

hint.zh: 要的是补上三个 0 以后的余数：新来的一位先和结果的最高位比一比，再决定这一步减不减生成式。
hint.en: What is wanted is the remainder with three 0s appended: compare each new bit with the top bit held before deciding whether this step subtracts the generator.

desc.zh: 到这一拍为止收进的位该跟的 3 位校验码（补上三个 0 后不进位地除以 1011 的余数，0 到 7 的数）；「重来」为 1 的那一拍从这一位重新算起，「暂停」为 1 的拍不收这一位。
desc.en: The 3 check bits due after the bits taken in so far (their carry-less remainder by 1011 with three 0s appended, a number from 0 to 7); on a tick restart is 1 it starts over from that bit, and on a tick hold is 1 it leaves that bit out.

brief.zh: 从第一拍起，线上接连送来字节，每个后跟一个校验位，使这 9 位里 1 的个数为偶数；线会翻位。每个校验位到达的那一拍，输出收到的字节和校验是否相符，其余各拍为「—」。
brief.en: From the first tick, bytes come down the wire back to back, each followed by a bit that makes the count of 1s in the nine even; the wire flips bits. On the tick each such bit arrives, output the byte received and whether it checks out; 「—」 on every other tick.

t.zh: 从这里起，线会把个别的位翻过来。收到的字节错了，收的一方却毫不知情，照样把它交出去。两头于是约好一条规则：发送方在数据后面附几位，收的一方按同一规则核对，就知道数据在线上有没有被改。这叫<wiki-ref to="error-detection"></wiki-ref>。最简单的规则只附一位，让 1 的个数凑成偶数，叫<wiki-ref to="parity"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: From here on, the wire flips the odd bit. A byte arrives wrong and the receiver hands it on without knowing. So the ends agree on a rule: the sender appends a few bits to the data, and the receiver checks them by the same rule to tell whether the data changed on the way. This is <wiki-ref to="error-detection"></wiki-ref>. The simplest rule appends one bit that makes the count of 1s even: a <wiki-ref to="parity"></wiki-ref>.

hint.zh: 1 的个数是奇是偶，可以一位一位地跟着记。
hint.en: Whether the count of 1s is odd or even can be tracked bit by bit.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="xor"></part-ref>把记下的奇偶和新来的一位合成新的奇偶。
hint.en: <part-ref to="xor"></part-ref> folds a new bit into the parity kept so far.

hint.zh: 字节一个接一个，中间没有空拍：每 9 拍从头算起。
hint.en: The bytes come back to back with no gap: start afresh every 9 ticks.

brief.zh: 听两根线：两根线上的位不同时说 1，相同时说 0。
brief.en: Listen to two wires: say 1 when their bits differ and 0 when they agree.

t.zh: 到这里为止，说什么只取决于一根线。这一次板要同时听两根线，说出的位由两根线一起决定。
t.en: So far what the board says has depended on one wire. Now it listens to two, and what it says depends on both.

hint.zh: 先固定一根线的值，看另一根线该怎样决定输出。
hint.en: Hold one wire still and see how the other should decide the output.

hint.zh: 线 A 为 0 时，输出和线 B 是什么关系？线 A 为 1 时呢？
hint.en: When wire A is 0, how does the output relate to wire B? And when A is 1?

desc.zh: 两位不同为 1，相同为 0；碰到「—」给「—」。
desc.en: 1 when two bits differ, 0 when they agree; 「—」 for 「—」.

brief.zh: 认出线上旗标之间的每一帧，去掉塞进的 0，逐个给出内容字节：字节收全的那一拍输出它，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完的那一拍「帧尾」为 1。其余各拍字节为「—」，两个信号为 0。
brief.en: Find each frame between flags on the wire, take out the stuffed 0s and give the content bytes one by one: output each on the tick it is complete, with got 1; end is 1 on the tick the closing flag is complete. Otherwise the byte is 「—」 and both signals 0.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-40"></level-ref>送出的帧到了线的另一头。这一次在收的一方：认出旗标，去掉塞进的 0，把位拼回字节。
t.en: Frames like those of <level-ref to="1-40"></level-ref> reach the other end of the wire. Now the board is the receiver: spotting flags, taking out the stuffed 0s and putting the bits back into bytes.

hint.zh: 连着五个 1 之后来的 0 是塞进去的，不算内容。
hint.en: A 0 that comes after five 1s in a row was stuffed in and is not content.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="deserializer"></part-ref>在「暂停」的拍不收线上的位。
hint.en: <part-ref to="deserializer"></part-ref> leaves out the wire's bit on hold ticks.

hint.zh: 结尾旗标的 8 位收齐时，看起来也像收满了一个字节。
hint.en: When the 8 bits of the closing flag are in, they look like a full byte too.

desc.zh: 在进线的位流里认出旗标之间的每一帧，去掉塞进的 0：一个内容字节收全的那一拍给出它，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完的那一拍「帧尾」为 1；其余各拍字节是「—」，「收到」「帧尾」为 0。
desc.en: Finds each frame between flags in the bits on its wire in and takes out the stuffed 0s: gives each content byte on the tick it is complete, with got 1, and makes end 1 on the tick the closing flag is complete; on every other tick the byte is 「—」 and got and end are 0.

brief.zh: 一帧一帧送出交来的字节：前后加旗标 01111110，内容里每连着 5 个 1 多说一个 0。帧只在「发送」为 1 时开始，帧间线上为 0；「下一个」取走队首，「末字节」标出帧尾。
brief.en: Send the bytes handed to you frame by frame: the flag 01111110 at each end, and a 0 added after every five 1s in the content. A frame starts only on a tick send is 1, and the wire is 0 between frames. Next takes the byte in front; last marks a frame's final byte.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-11"></level-ref>里，旗标标出一帧的开头和结尾。可帧的内容本身也可能含有 01111110：收的一方会把它当成旗标，一帧被从中间切断。两头于是再约好一条：内容里每连着 5 个 1，发送方就多说一个 0，收的一方再把它去掉。这叫<wiki-ref to="stuffing"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: In <level-ref to="1-11"></level-ref> flags mark where a frame begins and ends. But the content itself may hold 01111110: the receiver takes it for a flag and the frame is cut in two. So the ends agree on one more rule: after every five 1s in a row in the content the sender says an extra 0, and the receiver takes it out again. This is <wiki-ref to="stuffing"></wiki-ref>.

hint.zh: 旗标原样说出，不做填充；填充只管内容。
hint.en: Flags go out as they are, unstuffed; only the content is stuffed.

hint.zh: 多说 0 的那一拍，内容停一拍不走：正在说的那一位留到下一拍。
hint.en: On the tick of the extra 0 the content stands still: the bit that was due waits a tick.

hint.zh: 该不该多说一个 0，要看刚说出去的内容里连着几个 1。
hint.en: Whether an extra 0 is due depends on how many 1s in a row the content has just put on the wire.

desc.zh: 把交来的字节一帧一帧地送出：「发送」为 1 的拍开始一帧，前后各加旗标 01111110，内容里每连着 5 个 1 多说一个 0；两帧之间线上是 0。「下一个」为 1 的那一拍取走眼前的字节。
desc.en: Sends the bytes handed to it frame by frame: a frame begins on a tick send is 1, with the flag 01111110 at each end and a 0 added after every five 1s in its content; the wire is 0 between frames. Next is 1 on the tick it takes the byte in front of it.

brief.zh: 线上连续送来位；每当到这一拍为止最近 8 位是 01111110，就在那一拍输出 1，其余各拍输出 0。
brief.en: Bits keep coming down the wire; output 1 on every tick at which the last 8 bits read 01111110, and 0 on every other.

t.zh: 要送的往往不止一个字节，而是一串字节合成的一<wiki-ref to="frame"></wiki-ref>，有几个字节事先不知道。收的一方只看见不停到来的位，分不出一帧从哪里开始、到哪里结束。两头于是约好一个记号 01111110，叫<wiki-ref to="flag"></wiki-ref>，放在每一帧的开头和结尾；收的一方要在位流里随时认出它。
t.en: What goes across is often not one byte but a <wiki-ref to="frame"></wiki-ref>, a run of bytes whose length is not known in advance. The receiver sees only bits that keep coming, and cannot tell where a frame begins or ends. So the ends agree on a mark, 01111110, the <wiki-ref to="flag"></wiki-ref>, at each end of every frame; the receiver must spot it anywhere in the stream.

hint.zh: 旗标是一个 0，接着六个 1，再接一个 0。
hint.en: A flag is a 0, then six 1s, then a 0.

hint.zh: 数一数到这一拍为止连着来了几个 1，来了 0 就从头数。
hint.en: Count how many 1s in a row have come so far, starting over at each 0.

hint.zh: 那六个 1 前面必须真有一个 0：线一开始就来的 1 不算。
hint.en: The six 1s must really follow a 0: 1s from the very first tick do not count.

brief.zh: 把交来的字节依次送出，每个字节前加起始位 1，后加停止位 0；字节送完以后线上一直是 0。说「下一个」为 1 的那一拍取走眼前的字节，下一拍换上后一个。
brief.en: Send the bytes handed to you one after another, each with a start bit 1 before it and a stop bit 0 after; once they are all sent the wire stays 0. Saying next takes the byte in front of you that tick, and the following one shows the tick after.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-9"></level-ref>收的是这样的字节，这一次换到发送的一方。要送的字节排成一队，板只看得见排在最前面的那一个；队伍空了，看到的是「—」。
t.en: <level-ref to="1-9"></level-ref> received bytes like these; now the board is the sender. The bytes to send wait in a queue, and only the one in front can be seen; once the queue is empty, it shows 「—」.

hint.zh: 一个字节连同起始位和停止位，一共占 10 拍。
hint.en: A byte with its start and stop bits takes 10 ticks.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="serializer"></part-ref>只说那 8 位，起始位那一拍要另外说。
hint.en: <part-ref to="serializer"></part-ref> says only the 8 bits; the start bit's tick is up to you.

hint.zh: 队伍空了以后，也不能再说起始位。
hint.en: Once the queue is empty, no more start bits either.

brief.zh: 对方随时可能先说一个 1，再送 8 位，最后说一个 0；每收到一个字节，就在它最后一位到达的那一拍输出它，其余各拍输出「—」。
brief.en: At any tick the far end may say a 1, then 8 bits, then a 0; output each byte on the tick its last bit arrives, and 「—」 on every other tick.

t.zh: 发送方随时可能开口，而空着的线读出来是 0：一个以 0 开头的字节和安静的线分不出来，收的一方不知道从哪一拍数起。于是两头约好：字节之前先说一个 1，叫<wiki-ref to="start-bit"></wiki-ref>；字节之后说一个 0，叫<wiki-ref to="stop-bit"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: The sender may begin at any tick, and an idle wire reads 0: a byte that begins with 0s looks just like a quiet wire, and the receiver cannot tell where to start counting. So the ends agree that a 1, the <wiki-ref to="start-bit"></wiki-ref>, comes before each byte, and a 0, the <wiki-ref to="stop-bit"></wiki-ref>, after it.

hint.zh: 线空着的时候，来的第一个 1 就是起始位。
hint.en: While the wire is idle, the first 1 to come is a start bit.

hint.zh: 正在收一个字节时，线上的 1 是数据，不是起始位。
hint.en: While a byte is coming in, a 1 on the wire is data, not a start bit.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="deserializer"></part-ref>从「开始」那一拍收进第一位。
hint.en: <part-ref to="deserializer"></part-ref> takes in its first bit on the start tick.

brief.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起（还没为 1 过时从第一拍起），「暂停」为 0 的拍收进线上的一位，最高位在前；收满 8 位的那一拍输出这个字节，「收完」为 1，其余各拍为 0。
brief.en: From the tick start is 1 (from the first tick, before it ever is), take in the wire's bit on each tick hold is 0, top bit first; on the tick the eighth comes in, output the byte and make done 1, and 0 on every other tick.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-7"></level-ref>把一个字节拆成位送了出去。这一次换到线的另一头：把一位一位到来的位拼回一个数。
t.en: <level-ref to="1-7"></level-ref> takes a byte apart into bits and sends them. Now the board is at the other end of the wire, putting the bits back into a number as they come.

hint.zh: 每收进一位，已经攒下的数要怎样变，才能让先到的位分量更大？
hint.en: With each new bit, what must happen to the number held so far, so that earlier bits end up worth more?

hint.zh: 已经收了几位，<part-ref to="counter"></part-ref>数得出来；「暂停」的拍它也不数。
hint.en: <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref> can count the bits taken in, and it skips the hold ticks too.

hint.zh: 「开始」那一拍收进的就是第一位，之前攒下的都不算。
hint.en: The bit on the start tick is the first one; whatever was gathered before it does not count.

desc.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起（还没为 1 过时从第一拍起），每逢「暂停」为 0 收进一位，最高位在前；收满 8 位的那一拍给出这个字节，「收完」为 1；其余各拍字节是「—」，「收完」为 0。
desc.en: From the tick start is 1 (from the first tick, before it ever is), takes in a bit on every tick hold is 0, top bit first; on the tick the eighth is taken gives the byte with done 1; on every other tick the byte is 「—」 and done 0.

brief.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起，用 8 拍把那一拍输入的字节从最高位起逐位说到线上，之后说 0；最后一位说出的那一拍，「送完」为 1，其余各拍为 0。
brief.en: From the tick start is 1, say the byte input then on the wire bit by bit from the top over 8 ticks, then say 0; done is 1 on the tick the last bit is said and 0 on every other.

t.zh: 要送过去的是 0 到 255 的数，线一拍却只送一位。一个<wiki-ref to="byte"></wiki-ref>是 8 位的<wiki-ref to="binary"></wiki-ref>，每一位的分量是后一位的两倍；把它拆成位，一拍一位地说出去，叫<wiki-ref to="serial"></wiki-ref>。新元件<part-ref to="part:bit"></part-ref>从一个数里取出指定的一位，<part-ref to="part:equal"></part-ref>说两个数是否相同。
t.en: What must go across is a number from 0 to 255, but the wire carries one bit a tick. A <wiki-ref to="byte"></wiki-ref> is an 8-bit <wiki-ref to="binary"></wiki-ref>, each place worth twice the next; taking it apart and saying it a bit a tick is <wiki-ref to="serial"></wiki-ref>. The new part <part-ref to="part:bit"></part-ref> takes a given bit out of a number, and <part-ref to="part:equal"></part-ref> says whether two numbers are the same.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref>说得出从「开始」起过了几拍。
hint.en: <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref> can tell how many ticks have passed since start.

hint.zh: 「开始」之前和 8 位说完以后，线上都要是 0。
hint.en: The wire must be 0 before start and after the eighth bit.

hint.zh: 说到一半时，输入上的字节可能已经换了。
hint.en: Halfway through, the byte on the input may already have changed.

desc.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起，用 8 拍把那一拍的字节从最高位起逐位说出，之后说「—」（线上是 0）；说出最后一位的那一拍「送完」为 1。「开始」再为 1 时重新送。
desc.en: From the tick start is 1, says the byte of that tick bit by bit from the top over 8 ticks, then 「—」 (0 on a wire); done is 1 on the tick the last bit is said. Start again sends anew.

brief.zh: 输出自「重来」上一次为 1 起已经过了几拍（那一拍为 0；「重来」还没为 1 过时，从第一拍数起）；「暂停」为 1 的拍不算，那一拍的数和上一拍相同。
brief.en: Output how many ticks have passed since restart was last 1 (0 on that tick; counted from the first tick before restart is ever 1); ticks on which hold is 1 do not count, and on them the number stays as it was.

t.zh: 要知道一个字节该发到第几位、已经收了几位，板得知道过了几拍。寄存卡只记得住一个值，手上的元件又都不能让一个数变大。新元件<part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref>给出两个数之和。
t.en: To know which bit of a byte is due, or how many have come in, a board must know how many ticks have passed. A register holds a single value, and nothing in hand can make a number grow. The new part <part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref> gives the sum of two numbers.

hint.zh: 先不管「重来」和「暂停」，只让输出每拍大一。
hint.en: Leave restart and hold aside at first, and just make the output grow by one each tick.

hint.zh: 「重来」那一拍的数是 0；「暂停」那一拍的数和上一拍一样。两种情况各由一个选择决定。
hint.en: On a restart tick the number is 0; on a hold tick it is what it was. Each case is a choice of its own.

hint.zh: 要留到下一拍的值不止一个时，就用几个名字不同的寄存卡。
hint.en: When more than one value has to last until the next tick, use registers with different names.

desc.zh: 自「重来」上一次为 1 起过了几拍：那一拍为 0；「重来」还没为 1 过时从第一拍数起；「暂停」为 1 的拍不算，数停在原处。
desc.en: How many ticks since restart was last 1: 0 on that tick; counted from the first tick before restart is ever 1; ticks on which hold is 1 do not count, and the number stands still.

body.zh: 发送方在帧的内容里每连着 5 个 1 之后多说一个 0，收的一方再把它去掉。这样内容里永远不会连着出现 6 个 1，也就不会被误认成旗标。代价是帧变长了一点，长多少取决于内容。
body.en: After every five 1s in a row in a frame's content the sender adds a 0, and the receiver takes it out again. The content then never holds six 1s in a row, so it cannot be mistaken for a flag. The price is a slightly longer frame, by an amount that depends on the content.

body.zh: 附在数据后面的一位，使连它在内的 1 的个数为偶数（偶校验）或奇数（奇校验）。这里用偶校验。
body.en: A bit appended to data so that the count of 1s, itself included, is even (even parity) or odd (odd parity). Even parity is used here.

body.zh: 发送方按约好的规则在数据后面附上几位校验位，收的一方按同一规则核对，以此判断数据在路上有没有被改。查出错只说明数据坏了，并不能把它改回来。
body.en: The sender appends a few check bits to the data by an agreed rule, and the receiver checks them by the same rule to tell whether the data changed on the way. Detecting an error says only that the data is damaged; it does not put it right.

body.zh: 没有一种校验查得出所有错误：线恰好把数据改成另一份校验也相符的数据时，就查不出来。校验位越多、规则越好，这种情况越少。
body.en: No check catches every error: if the wire happens to turn the data into other data whose check also matches, nothing shows. More check bits and a better rule make this rarer.
