brief.zh: 在两根线之间转发：左边进线上来的帧，一个字节一个字节地交给右边的网卡，从右边的出线送出，不等整帧收完。左边到时是坏的帧，从右边出去也不能是完好的。
brief.en: Forward between two wires: pass each frame from the left wire in to an adapter on the right wire out, byte by byte, without waiting for the whole frame. A frame that arrived broken on the left must not leave intact on the right.

t.zh: 一根线只连着两头。要让帧走得更远，中间的节点得把一根线上收到的帧，转到另一根线上去。不等整帧收完就往外转，叫<wiki-ref to="cut-through"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: A wire joins only two ends. For a frame to travel further, a node in the middle must pass what it receives on one wire on to another. Passing it on before the whole frame is in is <wiki-ref to="cut-through"></wiki-ref>.

hint.zh: 左边的网卡往上交字节，右边的网卡从上面取字节，两边的快慢并不一样。
hint.en: The left adapter hands bytes up and the right one takes them from above, and the two do not keep the same pace.

hint.zh: 右边要取字节的时候，左边未必刚好交来一个：中间要存得下几个字节。
hint.en: When the right side wants a byte, the left may not have one just then: the middle must hold a few.

hint.zh: 坏帧到帧尾才认得出，那时它的大部分已经送了出去；能动的只剩还没送出的那几位。
hint.en: A bad frame shows only at its end, when most of it has already gone out; all that can still change is the bits not yet sent.

question.zh: 一根一拍只送一位、还会出错的线，两头怎样互相送出一帧，并知道它完好？
question.en: Over a wire that carries a bit a tick and gets some wrong, how do two ends send each other a frame and know it arrived intact?

body.zh: 转发的节点不等一帧全部收完，收到开头就往下一根线上送。帧走得更快，代价是帧尾的校验到达之前，它已经送出去了大半。与它相对的是先把整帧存下、核对完再转发的存储转发。
body.en: A forwarding node sends a frame on to the next wire as soon as its start is in, without waiting for the whole of it. Frames move faster, at the price that most of a frame has gone on before its check arrives. The alternative is store-and-forward: hold the whole frame, check it, then send it on.

why: Undo what the level renames of the previous changeset wrote into the blueprint: the rename followed every reference, and the blueprint's slots 1-3, 1-12, 1-13 (and the wants and pull requests naming 1-12 and 1-13) were renamed with the levels. The blueprint is restored to its own ids; nothing else in it changes.
Copy left over from the restructuring: 1-30 (the old 1-13) still had 1-13's title; the hints of 1-17 and 1-18 named the CRC their answers no longer use (the pausable CRC replaces it there).

ops.zh: 去掉塞进的 0
ops.en: Take the 0 out

ops.zh: 帧尾那一拍，<part-ref to="crchold"></part-ref>收进的应当只有内容字节的位。
ops.en: By the frame's end, <part-ref to="crchold"></part-ref> should have taken in the bits of the content bytes and nothing else.

ops.zh: <part-ref to="crchold"></part-ref>要收的是内容字节本身的位，不是线上带着旗标和填充的位。
ops.en: <part-ref to="crchold"></part-ref> must take in the bits of the content bytes, not the wire's bits with flags and stuffing.

value.zh: <part-ref to="crc"></part-ref>要收的是内容字节本身的位，不是线上带着旗标和填充的位；整帧内容收完时的结果要留住。
value.en: <part-ref to="crc"></part-ref> must take in the bits of the content bytes, not the wire's bits with flags and stuffing; keep its result from the moment the whole content is in.

value.zh: 帧尾那一拍，<part-ref to="crc"></part-ref>收进的应当只有内容字节的位。
value.en: By the frame's end, <part-ref to="crc"></part-ref> should have taken in the bits of the content bytes and nothing else.

value.zh: 拆帧
value.en: Unwrap the frame

why: copy, second run: the restructured era read against its tests; review findings 11, 13, 14, 15 fixed; briefs of the hold levels stated on their own; the hold parts named and described by what they add; entries for framing and acknowledgement

ops.zh: 这一关不必放任何元件。
ops.en: No parts are needed here.

ops.zh: 寄存卡能把一个值留到下一拍，板却还不知道已经过了几拍：手上的元件只能选、只能存，没有一样能让一个数变大。新元件<part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref>给出两个数之和。
ops.en: A register keeps a value for the next tick, but the board still cannot tell how many ticks have passed: the parts in hand can only pick and store, and none makes a number grow. The new part <part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref> gives the sum of two numbers.

value.zh: <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref>的「重来」也可以由板自己说了算。
value.en: The board itself can decide when <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref> restarts.

value.zh: 数到 7 以后，计数要从 0 重新开始。
value.en: After 7, the count must start again from 0.

value.zh: 数到 7 的那一拍发生的事，要到下一拍才能让计数重来。
value.en: What happens on the tick the count reaches 7 can restart it only on the tick after.

t.zh: <part-ref to="flagspot"></part-ref>在位流里认得出旗标。这一次换到发送的一方：给每一帧前后加上旗标再送出去，这叫<wiki-ref to="framing"></wiki-ref>。一帧有几个字节，看队首的「末字节」就知道。
t.en: <part-ref to="flagspot"></part-ref> spots flags in the bit stream. Now the board is the sender, putting a flag at each end of every frame it sends: this is <wiki-ref to="framing"></wiki-ref>. How many bytes a frame holds shows in the last-byte mark at the head of the queue.

brief.zh: 输出自「重来」上一次为 1 起过了几拍：那一拍为 0，「重来」还没为 1 过时从第一拍数起；「暂停」为 1 的拍不算，那一拍的数和上一拍相同。
brief.en: Output how many ticks have passed since restart was last 1: 0 on that tick, counted from the first tick before restart is ever 1; ticks on which hold is 1 do not count, and on them the number stays as it was.

t.zh: 帧的内容里要是本身就有 01111110，<level-ref to="1-13"></level-ref>里收的一方会把它当成旗标，一帧从中间被切断。要把它拆开，就得在内容里多塞一位；多塞的那一拍，别的都得停下等一拍，可<part-ref to="counter"></part-ref>每拍都往前走。这一关先让计数器能停。
t.en: If a frame's content itself holds 01111110, the receiver of <level-ref to="1-13"></level-ref> takes it for a flag and cuts the frame in two. Breaking it up means slipping an extra bit into the content, and on that tick everything else must wait; but <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref> moves on every tick. This level first makes the counter able to stand still.

desc.zh: 比计数器多一个「暂停」：给出自「重来」上一次为 1 起过了几拍，那一拍为 0，「重来」还没为 1 过时从第一拍数起；「暂停」为 1 的拍不算，数停在原处，「重来」同时为 1 时仍为 0。
desc.en: A counter with a hold input: how many ticks since restart was last 1, 0 on that tick and counted from the first tick before restart is ever 1; ticks on which hold is 1 do not count and the number stands still, though it is 0 if restart is 1 as well.

brief.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起，把那一拍输入的字节从最高位起逐位说到线上；「暂停」为 1 的拍说 0，该说的那一位留到下一拍；8 位说完以后说 0。说出最后一位的那一拍「送完」为 1，其余各拍为 0。
brief.en: From the tick start is 1, say the byte input then on the wire bit by bit from the top; on a tick hold is 1 say 0 and let the bit due wait for the next tick; after the eighth bit, say 0. Done is 1 on the tick the last bit is said and 0 on every other.

desc.zh: 比移位发送多一个「暂停」：从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起，把那一拍的字节从最高位起逐位说出，「暂停」为 1 的拍说 0，该说的那一位留到下一拍；8 位说完以后说「—」（线上是 0）。说出最后一位的那一拍「送完」为 1。「开始」再为 1 时重新送。
desc.en: Shift out with a hold input: from the tick start is 1, says the byte of that tick bit by bit from the top; on a tick hold is 1 it says 0 and the bit due waits a tick; after the eighth bit it says 「—」 (0 on a wire). Done is 1 on the tick the last bit is said. Start again sends anew.

brief.zh: 把交来的每一帧送出，前后各加一个旗标 01111110，只在「发送」为 1 时开始新的一帧；内容里每连着 5 个 1，就多说一个 0。「下一个」取走队首，「末字节」标出帧尾。
brief.en: Send each frame handed to you with a flag 01111110 before and after it, starting a new frame only while send is 1, and add a 0 after every five 1s in a row in the content. Next takes the byte in front; last marks a frame's final byte.

t.zh: <part-ref to="counterhold"></part-ref>和<part-ref to="serializerhold"></part-ref>都能停一拍了。两头再约好塞哪一位、塞在哪里：内容里每连着 5 个 1，发送方就多说一个 0，收的一方再把它去掉，内容里就不会出现旗标。这叫<wiki-ref to="stuffing"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: <part-ref to="counterhold"></part-ref> and <part-ref to="serializerhold"></part-ref> can both stand still for a tick. Now the ends agree on what to slip in and where: after every five 1s in a row in the content the sender says an extra 0, and the receiver takes it out again, so the content never looks like a flag. This is <wiki-ref to="stuffing"></wiki-ref>.

brief.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起收进线上的 8 位，最高位在前，「暂停」为 1 的拍那一位不收；收满 8 位的那一拍输出这个字节，「收完」为 1，其余各拍为 0。
brief.en: From the tick start is 1, take in 8 bits off the wire, top bit first, leaving out the bit of any tick hold is 1; on the tick the eighth is taken in, output the byte and make done 1, and 0 on every other tick.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-40"></level-ref>多塞的 0 不是内容。收的一方也要能停：<part-ref to="deserializer"></part-ref>在那一拍不能收线上的位。
t.en: The 0 slipped in by <level-ref to="1-40"></level-ref> is not content. The receiver must be able to stand still too: on that tick <part-ref to="deserializer"></part-ref> must not take in the wire's bit.

desc.zh: 比按字节收多一个「暂停」：从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起收进线上的 8 位，最高位在前，「暂停」为 1 的拍那一位不收；收满的那一拍给出这个字节，「收完」为 1；其余各拍字节是「—」，「收完」为 0。
desc.en: Shift in with a hold input: from the tick start is 1, takes in 8 bits off its wire in, top bit first, leaving out the bit of every tick hold is 1; on the tick the eighth comes in it gives the byte with done 1; on every other tick the byte is 「—」 and done 0.

value.zh: <part-ref to="deserializerhold"></part-ref>在「暂停」的拍不收线上的位。
value.en: <part-ref to="deserializerhold"></part-ref> leaves out the wire's bit on hold ticks.

value.zh: 一个 0 是不是塞进去的，要看它前面连着几个 1。
value.en: Whether a 0 was stuffed in depends on how many 1s came just before it.

value.zh: 该停的是第五个 1 后面的那一拍，不是第五个 1 到达的那一拍。
value.en: The tick to leave out is the one after the fifth 1, not the tick the fifth 1 arrives.

t.zh: 这根线会翻位：收到的位错了，收的一方却毫不知情。最笨的办法是同一份话送两遍，两份不一样，就知道出了错。这叫<wiki-ref to="error-detection"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: This wire flips bits, and a bit that arrives wrong gives no sign of it. The crudest remedy is to say everything twice: when the copies disagree, something went wrong. This is <wiki-ref to="error-detection"></wiki-ref>.

hint.zh: <level-ref to="1-2"></level-ref>和<level-ref to="1-3"></level-ref>的做法，这里都用得上。
hint.en: What worked in <level-ref to="1-2"></level-ref> and <level-ref to="1-3"></level-ref> both help here.

hint.zh: 线 A 为 0 时，输出和线 B 是什么关系？线 A 为 1 时呢？
hint.en: When wire A is 0, how does the output relate to wire B? And when A is 1?

ops.zh: <level-ref to="1-32"></level-ref>里跟着记奇偶的办法，收的一方也用得上。
ops.en: The way <level-ref to="1-32"></level-ref> keeps track of parity works at the receiving end too.

ops.zh: 更强的校验把一串位当作一个大数，后面补上几个 0，用<wiki-ref to="carryless"></wiki-ref>除以约好的除数，这个除数叫<wiki-ref to="generator"></wiki-ref>；余数就是跟在数据后面的校验码。这种校验叫<wiki-ref to="crc"></wiki-ref>。
ops.en: A stronger check reads a run of bits as one big number, appends a few 0s and divides it, using <wiki-ref to="carryless"></wiki-ref>, by an agreed divisor, the <wiki-ref to="generator"></wiki-ref>; the remainder is the check sent after the data. This check is a <wiki-ref to="crc"></wiki-ref>.

ops.zh: 这一次线在一个字节里可能翻两位，正是<level-ref to="1-14"></level-ref>的校验位漏掉的情形。<level-ref to="1-16"></level-ref>送出的校验码查不查得出？
ops.en: This time the wire may flip two bits in one byte, just what the parity bit of <level-ref to="1-14"></level-ref> misses. Does the check sent in <level-ref to="1-16"></level-ref> catch it?

brief.zh: 每一拍输出到这一拍为止收到的位该跟的 3 位校验码（补上三个 0 后不进位地除以 1011 的余数）；「重来」为 1 的拍从这一位重新算起，「暂停」为 1 的拍那一位不收进去。
brief.en: Every tick, output the 3 check bits due after the bits received so far (their carry-less remainder by 1011 with three 0s appended); on a tick restart is 1, start over from that bit, and leave out the bit of any tick hold is 1.

desc.zh: 比 CRC 多一个「暂停」：到这一拍为止收进的位该跟的 3 位校验码（补上三个 0 后不进位地除以 1011 的余数，0 到 7 的数）；「重来」为 1 的那一拍从这一位重新算起，「暂停」为 1 的拍不收这一位，校验码停在原处。
desc.en: A CRC with a hold input: the 3 check bits due after the bits taken in so far (their carry-less remainder by 1011 with three 0s appended, a number from 0 to 7); on a tick restart is 1 it starts over from that bit, and on a tick hold is 1 it leaves that bit out and the check stands still.

ops.zh: 到这里为止，校验码护着的只是一个字节。一帧有几个字节事先不知道，校验码于是放在整帧内容的后面：前面补 5 个 0 凑成一个校验字节，和内容一起做位填充。这一关把拆帧和查错合在一起。
ops.en: So far a check has guarded a single byte. A frame's length is not known in advance, so its check goes after the whole content: five 0s in front make it a check byte, stuffed along with the content. This level puts unwrapping and checking together.

ops.zh: <part-ref to="nic"></part-ref>收得到帧，也查得出它好不好，发帧的一方却还不知道。线那头要听到回话，这叫<wiki-ref to="ack"></wiki-ref>。
ops.en: <part-ref to="nic"></part-ref> receives frames and can tell whether they are intact, but the sender does not know it yet. The far end needs an answer: an <wiki-ref to="ack"></wiki-ref>.

hint.zh: 先在纸上算：没有翻位时余数是多少？只翻第 1 位时呢？
hint.en: Work it out on paper first: what is the remainder when nothing flipped? When only bit 1 flipped?

hint.zh: 7 个位置各翻一位，各留下什么余数？
hint.en: Flip each of the 7 positions in turn: what remainder does each leave?

after.zh: 找得出哪一位错了，就改得回来，不必请对方重发：这叫<wiki-ref to="error-correction"></wiki-ref>。
after.en: Knowing which bit is wrong is enough to put it right without asking for it again: this is <wiki-ref to="error-correction"></wiki-ref>.

body.zh: 一种差错检测：把数据当作一个大数，后面补上和校验码一样多的 0，不进位地除以生成式，余数就是校验码，跟在数据后面送出。简称 CRC。
body.en: A kind of error detection: the data is read as one big number, as many 0s as the check has bits are appended, and it is divided without carries by the generator; the remainder is the check, sent after the data. It is known as CRC.

body.zh: 它查得出奇偶校验漏掉的许多错误，硬件上又便宜，所以几乎每一种链路都用它。这里的生成式 1011 只有 4 位：任何一处翻位都查得出，两处翻位却只在相距不到 7 位时才一定查得出；正好相距 7 位或 7 的倍数时，余数仍是 0。一帧有几十位长，这样的两处翻位就可能漏掉。以太网的 32 位 CRC 在正常长度的帧里查得出任何两处翻位。
body.en: It catches many errors that parity misses and is cheap in hardware, so nearly every kind of link uses it. The generator here, 1011, has only 4 bits: it catches any single flip, but two flips only when they are less than 7 bits apart; two flips exactly 7 bits apart, or any multiple of 7, leave a remainder of 0. In a frame dozens of bits long such a pair can slip through. Ethernet's 32-bit CRC catches any two flips in a frame of normal length.

body.zh: 把要送的数据分成一帧一帧，并标出每一帧的边界，让收的一方能从位流里把它们分出来。这里用旗标标出边界；也有协议在帧头写明帧有多长。
body.en: Dividing the data to be sent into frames and marking where each begins and ends, so the receiver can pick them out of the stream of bits. Here flags mark the edges; other protocols state a frame's length in its header.

body.zh: 收的一方回给发送方的一句话，说一帧到了，好不好。说「好」叫确认（ACK），说「坏」叫否认（NAK）。发送方靠它才知道对方收到了什么。
body.en: A message the receiver sends back to say that a frame arrived, and whether it was intact. A positive answer is an ACK, a negative one a NAK. Only through it does the sender learn what the other end received.

body.zh: 一种差错检测：把数据当作一个大数，后面补上和校验码一样多的 0，不进位地除以生成式，余数就是校验码，跟在数据后面送出。简称 CRC。
body.en: A kind of error detection: the data is read as one big number, as many 0s as the check has bits are appended, and it is divided without carries by the generator; the remainder is the check, sent after the data. It is known as CRC.

body.zh: 它查得出奇偶校验漏掉的许多错误，硬件上又便宜，所以几乎每一种链路都用它。这里的生成式只有 4 位，查错能力远不如真实的 CRC。
body.en: It catches many errors that parity misses and is cheap in hardware, so nearly every kind of link uses it. The generator here has only 4 bits and catches far less than a real CRC.

brief.zh: 线上从第一拍起接连送来 7 位码字：4 位数据加 3 位校验码（生成式 1011），每个最多翻一位。码字最后一位到达的那一拍，输出翻的是第几位（先到的为第 1 位），没翻输出 0。
brief.en: From the first tick, 7-bit codewords come down the wire back to back: 4 data bits, then 3 check bits (generator 1011), with at most one bit flipped in each. On the tick a codeword's last bit arrives, output which bit flipped (the first to arrive is 1), or 0 if none.

t.zh: 到这里为止，校验码只用来判断收到的东西是好是坏。这一次每个<wiki-ref to="codeword"></wiki-ref>只有 4 位数据，却带着 3 位校验码。
t.en: So far check bits have only judged whether something arrived intact. This time each <wiki-ref to="codeword"></wiki-ref> carries just 4 data bits, and 3 check bits.

hint.zh: 先在纸上算：没有翻位时余数是多少？只翻第 1 位时呢？
hint.en: Work it out on paper first: what is the remainder when nothing flipped? When only bit 1 flipped?

after.zh: 余数不只说出有没有错，还说得出错在哪里：校验码从此也能用来<wiki-ref to="error-correction"></wiki-ref>。
after.en: A remainder says not only whether something went wrong but where: from here a check can also serve for <wiki-ref to="error-correction"></wiki-ref>.

value.zh: <part-ref to="nic"></part-ref>收得到帧，也查得出它好不好，发帧的一方却还不知道。线那头要听到回话。
value.en: <part-ref to="nic"></part-ref> receives frames and can tell whether they are intact, but the sender does not know it yet. The far end needs an answer.

value.zh: 从这里起，用线的节点只和网卡打交道：每一层只管自己的事。
value.en: From here on a node that uses a wire deals only with its adapter: each layer minds its own business.

value.zh: 到这里为止，校验码护着的只是一个字节，线照样会翻位。一帧有几个字节事先不知道，校验码于是放在整帧内容的后面：前面补 5 个 0 凑成一个校验字节，和内容一起做位填充。收的一方要等这一帧结束，才知道最后收到的是校验字节。
value.en: So far a check has guarded a single byte, and the wire still flips bits. A frame's length is not known in advance, so its check goes after the whole content: five 0s in front make it a check byte, stuffed along with the content. Only when the frame ends does the receiver know the last byte was the check.

brief.zh: 像边收边除一样输出该跟的校验码，只是「暂停」为 1 的拍线上那一位不收进去。
brief.en: Give the check due as in dividing as it comes, except that the bit on a tick hold is 1 is not taken in.

t.zh: 塞进去的 0 不是内容，收的一方算校验码时也不能把它算进去：<part-ref to="crc"></part-ref>也要能停一拍。
t.en: A stuffed 0 is not content, and the receiver must leave it out of the check as well: <part-ref to="crc"></part-ref> must be able to stand still for a tick.

hint.zh: 「暂停」那一拍，记下的余数一位也不变。
hint.en: On a hold tick, the remainder held does not change at all.

desc.zh: 到这一拍为止收进的位该跟的 3 位校验码（补上三个 0 后不进位地除以 1011 的余数，0 到 7 的数）；「重来」为 1 的那一拍从这一位重新算起，「暂停」为 1 的拍不收这一位。
desc.en: The 3 check bits due after the bits taken in so far (their carry-less remainder by 1011 with three 0s appended, a number from 0 to 7); on a tick restart is 1 it starts over from that bit, and on a tick hold is 1 it leaves that bit out.

value.zh: <level-ref to="1-14"></level-ref>的校验位只查得出奇数个错位：恰好翻两位时，校验照样相符。<level-ref to="1-16"></level-ref>送出的校验码查不查得出？
value.en: The parity bit of <level-ref to="1-14"></level-ref> catches only an odd number of flips: with two flipped it still checks out. Does the check sent in <level-ref to="1-16"></level-ref> catch them?

value.zh: 更强的校验把一串位当作一个大数，后面补上几个 0，用<wiki-ref to="carryless"></wiki-ref>除以约好的除数，这个除数叫<wiki-ref to="generator"></wiki-ref>；余数就是跟在数据后面的校验码。这种校验叫<wiki-ref to="crc"></wiki-ref>。
value.en: A stronger check reads a run of bits as one big number, appends a few 0s and divides it by <wiki-ref to="carryless"></wiki-ref> by an agreed divisor, the <wiki-ref to="generator"></wiki-ref>; the remainder is the check sent after the data. This check is a <wiki-ref to="crc"></wiki-ref>.

value.zh: 1 的个数是奇是偶，可以一位一位地跟着记。
value.en: Whether the count of 1s is odd or even can be tracked bit by bit.

brief.zh: 对方把每一位同时说在两根线上，线会翻位：两根线上的位不同时说 1，相同时说 0。
brief.en: The far end says every bit on two wires at once and the wires flip bits: say 1 when the two disagree and 0 when they agree.

t.zh: 从这里起，线会把个别的位翻过来，收到的位错了，收的一方却毫不知情。最笨的办法是同一份话送两遍：两份不一样，就知道出了错。这叫<wiki-ref to="error-detection"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: From here on the wire flips the odd bit, and a bit that arrives wrong gives no sign of it. The crudest remedy is to say everything twice: when the two copies disagree, something went wrong. This is <wiki-ref to="error-detection"></wiki-ref>.

hint.zh: 先固定一根线的值，看另一根线该怎样决定输出。
hint.en: Hold one wire still and see how the other should decide the output.

hint.zh: 线 A 为 0 时，输出和线 B 是什么关系？线 A 为 1 时呢？
hint.en: When wire A is 0, how does the output relate to wire B? And when A is 1?

desc.zh: 两位不同为 1，相同为 0；碰到「—」给「—」。
desc.en: 1 when two bits differ, 0 when they agree; 「—」 for 「—」.

value.zh: 连着五个 1 之后来的 0 是塞进去的，不算内容。
value.en: A 0 that comes after five 1s in a row was stuffed in and is not content.

value.zh: <part-ref to="deserializerhold"></part-ref>在「暂停」的拍不收线上的位。
value.en: <part-ref to="deserializerhold"></part-ref> leaves out the wire's bit on hold ticks.

value.zh: 一个 0 是不是塞进去的，要看它前面连着几个 1。
value.en: Whether a 0 was stuffed in depends on how many 1s came just before it.

brief.zh: 像一位一位地收一样收一个字节，只是「暂停」为 1 的拍线上那一位不收；收满 8 位的那一拍输出字节，「收完」为 1。
brief.en: Gather a byte as before, except that the bit on a tick hold is 1 is not taken in; on the tick the eighth is taken, output the byte and make done 1.

t.zh: 发送方多塞了一个 0，内容停了一拍。收的一方也要能停：那一拍线上的位不是内容，不收进来。
t.en: The sender slipped in an extra 0 and the content stood still a tick. The receiver must be able to stand still too: that tick's bit on the wire is not content and is not taken in.

hint.zh: 「开始」那一拍也可能是「暂停」的拍。
hint.en: The start tick may be a hold tick too.

desc.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起收进线上的 8 位，最高位在前，「暂停」为 1 的拍那一位不收；收满的那一拍给出这个字节，「收完」为 1；其余各拍字节是「—」，「收完」为 0。
desc.en: From the tick start is 1, takes in 8 bits off its wire in, top bit first, leaving out the bit of every tick hold is 1; on the tick the eighth comes in gives the byte with done 1; on every other tick the byte is 「—」 and done 0.

brief.zh: 像夹在旗标之间那样一帧一帧送出交来的字节，只是内容里每连着 5 个 1 就多说一个 0。
brief.en: Send the frames handed to you between flags as before, except that after every five 1s in a row in the content you add a 0.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-13"></level-ref>里，内容本身含有 01111110 时，收的一方会把它当成旗标，一帧被从中间切断。两头于是再约好：内容里每连着 5 个 1，发送方就多说一个 0，收的一方再把它去掉。这叫<wiki-ref to="stuffing"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: In <level-ref to="1-13"></level-ref>, content that itself holds 01111110 is taken for a flag and the frame is cut in two. So the ends agree on one more rule: after every five 1s in a row in the content the sender says an extra 0, and the receiver takes it out again. This is <wiki-ref to="stuffing"></wiki-ref>.

hint.zh: 旗标原样说出，不做填充；填充只管内容。
hint.en: Flags go out as they are, unstuffed; only the content is stuffed.

hint.zh: 多说 0 的那一拍，内容停一拍不走：正在说的那一位留到下一拍。
hint.en: On the tick of the extra 0 the content stands still: the bit that was due waits a tick.

hint.zh: 该不该多说一个 0，要看刚说出去的内容里连着几个 1。
hint.en: Whether an extra 0 is due depends on how many 1s in a row the content has just put on the wire.

desc.zh: 把交来的字节一帧一帧地送出：「发送」为 1 时开始新的一帧，前后各加旗标 01111110，内容里每连着 5 个 1 多说一个 0；没有开始新帧时线上说旗标。「下一个」为 1 的那一拍取走眼前的字节。
desc.en: Sends the bytes handed to it frame by frame: a new frame begins while send is 1, with the flag 01111110 at each end and a 0 added after every five 1s in its content; flags fill the wire between frames. Next is 1 on the tick it takes the byte in front of it.

brief.zh: 像一位一位地发一样送出字节，只是「暂停」为 1 的拍说 0，该说的那一位留到下一拍；说出最后一位的那一拍「送完」为 1。
brief.en: Send a byte bit by bit as before, except that on a tick hold is 1 you say 0 and the bit due waits for the next; done is 1 on the tick the last bit is said.

t.zh: <part-ref to="counterhold"></part-ref>会停了。正在发的字节也要能停：多塞一位的那一拍，字节里该说的那一位留到下一拍。
t.en: <part-ref to="counterhold"></part-ref> can stand still now. The byte being sent must too: on the tick an extra bit goes in, the bit of the byte that was due waits for the next tick.

hint.zh: 「开始」那一拍也可能是「暂停」的拍。
hint.en: The start tick may be a hold tick too.

desc.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起，把那一拍的字节从最高位起逐位说出；「暂停」为 1 的拍说 0，该说的那一位留到下一拍；说出最后一位的那一拍「送完」为 1。
desc.en: From the tick start is 1, says the byte of that tick bit by bit from the top; on a tick hold is 1 it says 0 and the bit due waits a tick; done is 1 on the tick the last bit is said.

brief.zh: 像数拍一样输出自「重来」起过了几拍，只是「暂停」为 1 的拍不算：那一拍的数和上一拍相同。
brief.en: Count the ticks since restart as before, except that ticks on which hold is 1 do not count: on them the number stays as it was.

t.zh: 内容里有 01111110 时，帧会被从中间切断；要在内容里多塞一位把它拆开，别的都得等一拍。可<part-ref to="counter"></part-ref>每拍都往前走。
t.en: When the content holds 01111110 the frame is cut in two, and slipping in an extra bit to break it up means everything else must wait a tick. But <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref> moves on every tick.

hint.zh: 「重来」和「暂停」同时为 1 时，「重来」优先。
hint.en: When restart and hold are both 1, restart wins.

hint.zh: 要留到下一拍的值不止一个时，就用几个名字不同的寄存卡。
hint.en: When more than one value has to last until the next tick, use registers with different names.

desc.zh: 自「重来」上一次为 1 起过了几拍：那一拍为 0，「重来」还没为 1 过时从第一拍数起；「暂停」为 1 的拍不算，数停在原处。
desc.en: How many ticks since restart was last 1: 0 on that tick, counted from the first tick before restart is ever 1; ticks on which hold is 1 do not count, and the number stands still.

t.zh: <part-ref to="flagspot"></part-ref>在位流里认得出旗标。这一次换到发送的一方：一帧有几个字节，看队首的「末字节」就知道。
t.en: <part-ref to="flagspot"></part-ref> spots flags in the bit stream. Now the board is the sender: how many bytes a frame holds shows in the last-byte mark at the head of the queue.

value.zh: 数到 7 以后，计数要从 0 重新开始。
value.en: After 7, the count must start again from 0.

value.zh: 数到 7 的那一拍发生的事，要到下一拍才能让计数重来。
value.en: What happens on the tick the count reaches 7 can restart it only on the tick after.

value.zh: 要知道一个字节该发到第几位、已经收了几位，板得知道过了几拍。寄存卡只记得住一个值，手上的元件又都不能让一个数变大。新元件<part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref>给出两个数之和。
value.en: To know which bit of a byte is due, or how many have come in, a board must know how many ticks have passed. A register holds a single value, and nothing in hand can make a number grow. The new part <part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref> gives the sum of two numbers.

value.zh: 这一关不必再放元件。
value.en: No more parts are needed here.

why: copy: 1-28's brief within length

ops.zh: <part-ref to="flagspot"></part-ref>在位流里认得出旗标。这一次换到发送的一方：给每一帧前后加上旗标再送出去，这叫<wiki-ref to="framing"></wiki-ref>。一帧有几个字节，看队首的「末字节」就知道。上面交下一整帧时才让「发送」为 1；为 0 时队首还没有可送的帧，线上只说旗标。
ops.en: <part-ref to="flagspot"></part-ref> spots flags in the bit stream. Now the board is the sender, putting a flag at each end of every frame it sends: this is <wiki-ref to="framing"></wiki-ref>. How many bytes a frame holds shows in the last-byte mark at the head of the queue. The layer above sets send to 1 only once it has handed down a whole frame; while send is 0 there is no frame to send yet, and the wire says only flags.

question.zh: 一根一拍只送一位、还会出错的线，两头怎样互相送出一帧，并知道它完好？
question.en: Over a wire that carries a bit a tick and gets some wrong, how do two ends send each other a frame and know it arrived intact?

brief.zh: 像塞一个 0 那样把交来的每一帧送出，只是内容后面多跟一个校验字节：5 个 0，再加内容的 3 位校验码，和内容一起做位填充。只在「发送」为 1 时开始新的一帧。「下一个」取走队首，「末字节」标出帧尾。
brief.en: Send each frame handed to you as in slipping in a 0, except that its content is followed by a check byte: five 0s, then the content's 3 check bits, stuffed along with the content. Start a new frame only while send is 1. Next takes the byte in front; last marks a frame's final byte.

t.zh: <part-ref to="crchold"></part-ref>能停一拍了。一帧有几个字节事先不知道，校验码就放在整帧内容后面：前面补 5 个 0，凑成一个校验字节。收的一方拿它核对整帧，这是<wiki-ref to="error-detection"></wiki-ref>；这一关先做发的一方。
t.en: <part-ref to="crchold"></part-ref> can stand still for a tick now. A frame's length is not known in advance, so its check goes after the whole content, with five 0s in front to make a check byte. The receiver checks the whole frame by it: this is <wiki-ref to="error-detection"></wiki-ref>. This level builds the sending end.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="framer"></part-ref>只送交给它的字节：校验字节要在最后一个内容字节之后交给它。
hint.en: <part-ref to="framer"></part-ref> sends only the bytes it is given: the check byte has to be given to it after the last content byte.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="crchold"></part-ref>要收的是内容字节本身的位，不是线上带着旗标和填充的位。
hint.en: <part-ref to="crchold"></part-ref> must take in the bits of the content bytes, not the wire's bits with flags and stuffing.

hint.zh: 每一帧的校验码只算这一帧的内容。
hint.en: Each frame's check covers that frame's content only.

desc.zh: 把交来的字节一帧一帧地送出：「发送」为 1 时开始新的一帧，内容后面跟一个校验字节（5 个 0 加内容的 3 位校验码），前后各加旗标 01111110，内容和校验字节里每连着 5 个 1 多说一个 0；没有开始新帧时线上说旗标。「下一个」为 1 的那一拍取走眼前的字节。
desc.en: Sends the bytes handed to it frame by frame: a new frame begins while send is 1, its content followed by a check byte (five 0s, then the content's 3 check bits), with the flag 01111110 at each end and a 0 added after every five 1s in the content and check byte; flags fill the wire between frames. Next is 1 on the tick it takes the byte in front of it.

value.zh: 两个方向互不相干；每一半，手上都已经有现成的元件。
value.en: The two directions do not touch each other, and a part in hand already does each half.

value.zh: 两个方向互不相干；往上的一半，手上已经有现成的元件。
value.en: The two directions do not touch each other, and a part in hand already does the upward half.

ops.en: Send each frame handed to you as in <level-ref to="1-40"></level-ref>, except that its content is followed by a check byte: five 0s, then the content's 3 check bits, stuffed along with the content. Start a new frame only while send is 1. Next takes the byte in front; last marks a frame's final byte.

ops.zh: 到这里为止，校验码护着的只是一个字节，<part-ref to="framer"></part-ref>送出的帧不带校验。一帧有几个字节事先不知道，校验码就放在整帧内容的后面：前面补 5 个 0，凑成一个校验字节。这一关先做发的一方。
ops.en: So far a check has guarded a single byte, and the frames <part-ref to="framer"></part-ref> sends carry none. A frame's length is not known in advance, so its check goes after the whole content, with five 0s in front to make a check byte. This level builds the sending end.

ops.zh: 把交来的字节一帧一帧地送出：「发送」为 1 时开始新的一帧，内容后面跟一个校验字节（5 个 0 加内容的 3 位校验码），前后各加旗标 01111110，内容和校验字节里每连着 5 个 1 多说一个 0；没有开始新帧时线上说旗标。「下一个」为 1 的那一拍取走眼前的字节，「末字节」为 1 的字节是一帧的最后一个。
ops.en: Sends the bytes handed to it frame by frame: a new frame begins while send is 1, its content followed by a check byte (five 0s, then the content's 3 check bits), with the flag 01111110 at each end and a 0 added after every five 1s in the content and check byte; flags fill the wire between frames. Next is 1 on the tick it takes the byte in front of it, and a byte with last 1 ends its frame.

ops.zh: 把交来的字节一帧一帧地送出：「发送」为 1 时开始新的一帧，前后各加旗标 01111110，内容里每连着 5 个 1 多说一个 0；没有开始新帧时线上说旗标。「下一个」为 1 的那一拍取走眼前的字节，「末字节」为 1 的字节是一帧的最后一个。
ops.en: Sends the bytes handed to it frame by frame: a new frame begins while send is 1, with the flag 01111110 at each end and a 0 added after every five 1s in its content; flags fill the wire between frames. Next is 1 on the tick it takes the byte in front of it, and a byte with last 1 ends its frame.

ops.zh: <part-ref to="sender"></part-ref>在每帧内容后面带上了校验字节，<part-ref to="deframer"></part-ref>却把它当成又一个内容字节交出去，坏了的帧照样往上送。这一关在收的一方把拆帧和查错合在一起。
ops.en: <part-ref to="sender"></part-ref> puts a check byte after each frame's content, but <part-ref to="deframer"></part-ref> hands it on as one more content byte, and broken frames go up all the same. This level puts unwrapping and checking together at the receiving end.

ops.zh: 逐个给出每帧的内容字节（校验字节除外）：每个在后一个字节收全的那一拍给出，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完时「帧尾」为 1，「相符」说出这帧的校验是否相符；其余各拍为「—」或 0。
ops.en: Give each frame's content bytes, the check byte aside: each on the tick the byte after it is complete, with got 1. When the closing flag is complete, end is 1 and fits says whether the frame's check fits. On every other tick, 「—」 or 0.

ops.zh: 相符
ops.en: Fits

ops.zh: 从进线上拆出每一帧，扣下最后的校验字节：每个内容字节在它后面那个字节收全的那一拍给出，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完的那一拍「帧尾」为 1，「相符」说出这一帧的校验是否相符。其余各拍字节和「相符」是「—」，「收到」「帧尾」为 0。
ops.en: Unwraps each frame off its wire in and holds back the closing check byte: gives each content byte on the tick the byte after it is complete, with got 1; on the tick the closing flag is complete, end is 1 and fits says whether the frame's check fits. On every other tick the byte and fits are 「—」, got and end 0.

ops.zh: <part-ref to="sender"></part-ref>和<part-ref to="receiver"></part-ref>各管一个方向，每一个要用线的节点都得把两者重新接一遍。把它们装进一块网卡：对上面只收发整帧的字节，对下面只收发线上的位，旗标、填充和校验字节都留在网卡里。这叫<wiki-ref to="layering"></wiki-ref>。
ops.en: <part-ref to="sender"></part-ref> and <part-ref to="receiver"></part-ref> each handle one direction, and every node that uses a wire would have to wire the two up again. Put them into one network adapter: it deals in the bytes of whole frames with the layer above and in bits on the wire below, and flags, stuffing and the check byte stay inside it. This is <wiki-ref to="layering"></wiki-ref>.

ops.zh: 两个方向互不相干，各接各的。
ops.en: The two directions do not touch each other.

ops.zh: 往下：交来的帧带上校验字节成帧送到出线上，「发送」为 1 的拍开始一帧，「下一个」为 1 的那一拍取走眼前的字节，「末字节」为 1 的字节是一帧的最后一个。往上：进线上来的帧拆开、核对，每个内容字节在它后面那个字节收全的那一拍给出，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完的那一拍「帧尾」为 1，「相符」说出这一帧的校验是否相符。

Up: frames off its wire in are unwrapped and checked, each content byte given on the tick the byte after it is complete, with got 1; on the tick the closing flag is complete, end is 1 and fits says whether the frame's check fits.

ops.zh: 进线上每到一帧，就从出线回一个只有一个字节的帧：校验相符回 1，不符回 0。<part-ref to="nic"></part-ref>在「发送」为 1 时取走输入上的字节，不论那是什么；没有回话等着时，「发送」为 0。
ops.en: For every frame that arrives on the wire in, send back a one-byte frame on the wire out: 1 if its check fits, 0 if not. <part-ref to="nic"></part-ref> takes whatever byte is at its input once send is 1, so keep send at 0 until a reply is waiting.

ops.zh: <part-ref to="nic"></part-ref>收得到帧，也核对得了每一帧，发帧的一方却还不知道结果。线那头要听到回话，这叫<wiki-ref to="ack"></wiki-ref>。
ops.en: <part-ref to="nic"></part-ref> receives frames and checks each one, but the sender does not know the result yet. The far end needs an answer: an <wiki-ref to="ack"></wiki-ref>.

ops.zh: 从第一拍起，每个字节后面紧跟它的 3 位校验码，线在一个字节里可能翻两位：每个字节的校验码到齐的那一拍，输出这个字节和校验是否相符。
ops.en: From the first tick, each byte comes followed by its 3 check bits, and the wire may flip two bits in one: on the tick a byte's check is all in, output the byte and whether its check fits.

value.zh: 发帧和收帧各是一个元件，查错的校验码又要另外算：每一个要用线的节点，都得把它们重新接一遍。把它们装进一块网卡：对上面只收发整帧的字节，对下面只收发线上的位，上面不必知道旗标、填充和校验字节。这叫<wiki-ref to="layering"></wiki-ref>。
value.en: Sending frames and receiving them are separate parts, and the check is worked out apart from both: every node that uses a wire would have to wire them up again. Put them into one network adapter: it deals in the bytes of whole frames with the layer above and in bits on the wire below, and the layer above never sees flags, stuffing or the check byte. This is <wiki-ref to="layering"></wiki-ref>.

value.zh: 从进线上拆出每一帧，扣下最后的校验字节：每个内容字节在它后面那个字节收全的那一拍给出，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完的那一拍「帧尾」为 1，「完好」说出这一帧是否完好。其余各拍字节和「完好」是「—」，「收到」「帧尾」为 0。
value.en: Unwraps each frame off its wire in and holds back the closing check byte: gives each content byte on the tick the byte after it is complete, with got 1; on the tick the closing flag is complete, end is 1 and intact says whether the frame arrived intact. On every other tick the byte and intact are 「—」, got and end 0.

value.zh: 完好
value.en: Intact

value.zh: 逐个给出每帧的内容字节（校验字节除外）：每个在后一个字节收全的那一拍给出，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完时「帧尾」为 1，「完好」说出这帧是否完好；其余各拍为「—」或 0。
value.en: Give each frame's content bytes, the check byte aside: each on the tick the byte after it is complete, with got 1. When the closing flag is complete, end is 1 and intact says whether the frame arrived intact. On every other tick, 「—」 or 0.

value.zh: 到这里为止，校验码护着的只是一个字节。一帧有几个字节事先不知道，校验码于是放在整帧内容的后面：前面补 5 个 0 凑成一个校验字节，和内容一起做位填充。这一关把拆帧和查错合在一起。
value.en: So far a check has guarded a single byte. A frame's length is not known in advance, so its check goes after the whole content: five 0s in front make it a check byte, stuffed along with the content. This level puts unwrapping and checking together.

value.zh: 把交来的字节一帧一帧地送出：「发送」为 1 时开始新的一帧，前后各加旗标 01111110，内容里每连着 5 个 1 多说一个 0；没有开始新帧时线上说旗标。「下一个」为 1 的那一拍取走眼前的字节。
value.en: Sends the bytes handed to it frame by frame: a new frame begins while send is 1, with the flag 01111110 at each end and a 0 added after every five 1s in its content; flags fill the wire between frames. Next is 1 on the tick it takes the byte in front of it.

value.zh: 把交来的字节一帧一帧地送出：「发送」为 1 时开始新的一帧，内容后面跟一个校验字节（5 个 0 加内容的 3 位校验码），前后各加旗标 01111110，内容和校验字节里每连着 5 个 1 多说一个 0；没有开始新帧时线上说旗标。「下一个」为 1 的那一拍取走眼前的字节。
value.en: Sends the bytes handed to it frame by frame: a new frame begins while send is 1, its content followed by a check byte (five 0s, then the content's 3 check bits), with the flag 01111110 at each end and a 0 added after every five 1s in the content and check byte; flags fill the wire between frames. Next is 1 on the tick it takes the byte in front of it.

value.zh: <part-ref to="crchold"></part-ref>能停一拍了。一帧有几个字节事先不知道，校验码就放在整帧内容后面：前面补 5 个 0，凑成一个校验字节。收的一方拿它核对整帧，这是<wiki-ref to="error-detection"></wiki-ref>；这一关先做发的一方。
value.en: <part-ref to="crchold"></part-ref> can stand still for a tick now. A frame's length is not known in advance, so its check goes after the whole content, with five 0s in front to make a check byte. The receiver checks the whole frame by it: this is <wiki-ref to="error-detection"></wiki-ref>. This level builds the sending end.

value.zh: 像塞一个 0 那样把交来的每一帧送出，只是内容后面多跟一个校验字节：5 个 0，再加内容的 3 位校验码，和内容一起做位填充。只在「发送」为 1 时开始新的一帧。「下一个」取走队首，「末字节」标出帧尾。
value.en: Send each frame handed to you as in slipping in a 0, except that its content is followed by a check byte: five 0s, then the content's 3 check bits, stuffed along with the content. Start a new frame only while send is 1. Next takes the byte in front; last marks a frame's final byte.

ops.zh: 像<level-ref to="1-40"></level-ref>那样送出每一帧，内容后面再跟一个校验字节：5 个 0 加内容的 3 位校验码，一起填充。只在「发送」为 1 时开始新帧。「下一个」取走队首，「末字节」标出帧尾。
ops.en: Send each frame as in <level-ref to="1-40"></level-ref>, its content now followed by a check byte: five 0s, then the content's 3 check bits, stuffed with the rest. Start a new frame only while send is 1. Next takes the byte in front; last marks a frame's final byte.

value.zh: 像<level-ref to="1-40"></level-ref>那样把交来的每一帧送出，只是内容后面多跟一个校验字节：5 个 0 加内容的 3 位校验码，和内容一起做位填充。只在「发送」为 1 时开始新的一帧。「下一个」取走队首，「末字节」标出帧尾。
value.en: Send each frame handed to you as in <level-ref to="1-40"></level-ref>, except that its content is followed by a check byte: five 0s, then the content's 3 check bits, stuffed along with the content. Start a new frame only while send is 1. Next takes the byte in front; last marks a frame's final byte.

why: A level is a list of tasks (vocabulary 2): every level becomes a level of one task.

t.zh: 两头之间只有一根线。线上分得出的只有两种状态，记作 0 和 1；两头对它们的约定，就是最初的<wiki-ref to="protocol"></wiki-ref>。线每<wiki-ref to="tick"></wiki-ref>送一<wiki-ref to="bit"></wiki-ref>，从一头说出，过几拍才到另一头，中间隔的拍数叫<wiki-ref to="delay"></wiki-ref>。这块板夹在两根线中间。
t.en: There is only a wire between the two ends. It shows just two states, written 0 and 1, and what the ends agree they mean is their first <wiki-ref to="protocol"></wiki-ref>. The wire carries one <wiki-ref to="bit"></wiki-ref> a <wiki-ref to="tick"></wiki-ref>: said at one end, it reaches the other some ticks later, and the ticks in between are the wire's <wiki-ref to="delay"></wiki-ref>. This board sits between two wires.

brief.zh: 每一拍把左线上听到的位说到右线上。
brief.en: Every tick, say on the right wire the bit heard on the left wire.

hint.zh: 这一关不必放任何元件。
hint.en: No parts are needed here.

hint.zh: 从左线的输出口拉一根连线，接到右线上。
hint.en: Draw a connection from the left wire's output to the right wire.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-9"></level-ref>收的是这样的字节，这一次换到发送的一方。要送的字节排成一队，板只看得见排在最前面的那一个；队伍空了，看到的是「—」。
t.en: <level-ref to="1-9"></level-ref> received bytes like these; now the board is the sender. The bytes to send wait in a queue, and only the one in front can be seen; once the queue is empty, it shows 「—」.

brief.zh: 把交来的字节依次送出，每个字节前加起始位 1，后加停止位 0；字节送完以后线上一直是 0。说「下一个」为 1 的那一拍取走眼前的字节，下一拍换上后一个。
brief.en: Send the bytes handed to you one after another, each with a start bit 1 before it and a stop bit 0 after; once they are all sent the wire stays 0. Saying next takes the byte in front of you that tick, and the following one shows the tick after.

hint.zh: 一个字节连同起始位和停止位，一共占 10 拍。
hint.en: A byte with its start and stop bits takes 10 ticks.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="serializer"></part-ref>只说那 8 位，起始位那一拍要另外说。
hint.en: <part-ref to="serializer"></part-ref> says only the 8 bits; the start bit's tick is up to you.

hint.zh: 队伍空了以后，也不能再说起始位。
hint.en: Once the queue is empty, no more start bits either.

t.zh: 要送的往往不止一个字节，而是一串字节合成的一<wiki-ref to="frame"></wiki-ref>，有几个字节事先不知道。收的一方只看见不停到来的位，分不出一帧从哪里开始、到哪里结束。两头于是约好一个记号 01111110，叫<wiki-ref to="flag"></wiki-ref>，放在每一帧的开头和结尾；收的一方要在位流里随时认出它。
t.en: What goes across is often not one byte but a <wiki-ref to="frame"></wiki-ref>, a run of bytes whose length is not known in advance. The receiver sees only bits that keep coming, and cannot tell where a frame begins or ends. So the ends agree on a mark, 01111110, the <wiki-ref to="flag"></wiki-ref>, at each end of every frame; the receiver must spot it anywhere in the stream.

desc.zh: 进线上最近收到的 8 位正好是 01111110 的那一拍为 1，其余各拍为 0。
desc.en: 1 on each tick at which the last 8 bits on its wire in read 01111110, 0 on every other.

brief.zh: 线上连续送来位；每当到这一拍为止最近 8 位是 01111110，就在那一拍输出 1，其余各拍输出 0。
brief.en: Bits keep coming down the wire; output 1 on every tick at which the last 8 bits read 01111110, and 0 on every other.

hint.zh: 旗标是一个 0，接着六个 1，再接一个 0。
hint.en: A flag is a 0, then six 1s, then a 0.

hint.zh: 数一数到这一拍为止连着来了几个 1，来了 0 就从头数。
hint.en: Count how many 1s in a row have come so far, starting over at each 0.

hint.zh: 那六个 1 前面必须真有一个 0：线一开始就来的 1 不算。
hint.en: The six 1s must really follow a 0: 1s from the very first tick do not count.

t.zh: <part-ref to="flagspot"></part-ref>在位流里认得出旗标。这一次换到发送的一方：给每一帧前后加上旗标再送出去，这叫<wiki-ref to="framing"></wiki-ref>。一帧有几个字节，看队首的「末字节」就知道。上面交下一整帧时才让「发送」为 1；为 0 时队首还没有可送的帧，线上只说旗标。
t.en: <part-ref to="flagspot"></part-ref> spots flags in the bit stream. Now the board is the sender, putting a flag at each end of every frame it sends: this is <wiki-ref to="framing"></wiki-ref>. How many bytes a frame holds shows in the last-byte mark at the head of the queue. The layer above sets send to 1 only once it has handed down a whole frame; while send is 0 there is no frame to send yet, and the wire says only flags.

brief.zh: 把交来的每一帧送出，前后各加一个旗标 01111110，只在「发送」为 1 时开始新的一帧。「下一个」取走队首，「末字节」标出帧尾。
brief.en: Send each frame handed to you with a flag 01111110 before and after it, starting a new frame only while send is 1. Next takes the byte in front; last marks a frame's final byte.

hint.zh: 旗标就是字节 126。
hint.en: A flag is the byte 126.

hint.zh: 一帧的结尾旗标不能兼作下一帧的开头。
hint.en: A frame's closing flag cannot double as the next frame's opening one.

hint.zh: 没有帧要送的时候，线上可以一直说旗标。
hint.en: While there is no frame to send, the wire may keep saying flags.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-12"></level-ref>送出的帧到了线的另一头。这一次在收的一方：认出旗标，把旗标之间的位拼回字节。
t.en: Frames like those of <level-ref to="1-12"></level-ref> reach the other end of the wire. Now the board is the receiver: spotting flags and putting the bits between them back into bytes.

brief.zh: 认出线上旗标之间的每一帧，逐个给出内容字节：字节收全的那一拍输出它，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完的那一拍「帧尾」为 1；其余各拍两个信号为 0。
brief.en: Find each frame between flags on the wire and give its content bytes one by one: output each on the tick it is complete, with got 1; end is 1 on the tick the closing flag is complete; otherwise both are 0.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="deserializer"></part-ref>要从旗标后面的第一位收起。
hint.en: <part-ref to="deserializer"></part-ref> must start at the first bit after a flag.

hint.zh: 结尾旗标的 8 位收齐时，看起来也像收满了一个字节。
hint.en: When the 8 bits of the closing flag are in, they look like a full byte too.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-32"></level-ref>在发送的一方附上校验位。这一次换到收的一方：线照样会翻位，每个字节都要核对。
t.en: <level-ref to="1-32"></level-ref> appends the parity bit at the sending end. Now the board is the receiver: the wire still flips bits, and every byte must be checked.

brief.zh: 从第一拍起，线上接连送来字节，每个后跟一个校验位，使这 9 位里 1 的个数为偶数；线会翻位。每个校验位到达的那一拍，输出收到的字节和校验是否相符，其余各拍为「—」。
brief.en: From the first tick, bytes come down the wire back to back, each followed by a bit that makes the count of 1s in the nine even; the wire flips bits. On the tick each such bit arrives, output the byte received and whether it checks out; 「—」 on every other tick.

hint.zh: <level-ref to="1-32"></level-ref>里跟着记奇偶的办法，收的一方也用得上。
hint.en: The way <level-ref to="1-32"></level-ref> keeps track of parity works at the receiving end too.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="xor"></part-ref>把记下的奇偶和新来的一位合成新的奇偶。
hint.en: <part-ref to="xor"></part-ref> folds a new bit into the parity kept so far.

hint.zh: 字节一个接一个，中间没有空拍：每 9 拍从头算起。
hint.en: The bytes come back to back with no gap: start afresh every 9 ticks.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-14"></level-ref>的校验位只查得出奇数个错位：恰好翻两位时，校验照样相符。
t.en: The parity bit of <level-ref to="1-14"></level-ref> catches only an odd number of flips: with exactly two flipped, it still checks out.

t.zh: 更强的校验把一串位当作一个大数，后面补上几个 0，用<wiki-ref to="carryless"></wiki-ref>除以约好的除数，这个除数叫<wiki-ref to="generator"></wiki-ref>；余数就是跟在数据后面的校验码。这种校验叫<wiki-ref to="crc"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: A stronger check reads a run of bits as one big number, appends a few 0s and divides it, using <wiki-ref to="carryless"></wiki-ref>, by an agreed divisor, the <wiki-ref to="generator"></wiki-ref>; the remainder is the check sent after the data. This check is a <wiki-ref to="crc"></wiki-ref>.

desc.zh: 到这一拍为止收进的位该跟的 3 位校验码（补上三个 0 后不进位地除以 1011 的余数，0 到 7 的数）；「重来」为 1 的那一拍从这一位重新算起。
desc.en: The 3 check bits due after the bits taken in so far (their carry-less remainder by 1011 with three 0s appended, a number from 0 to 7); on a tick restart is 1 it starts over from that bit.

brief.zh: 每一拍输出到这一拍为止收到的位该跟的 3 位校验码，即这些位补上三个 0 后不进位地除以 1011 的余数；「重来」为 1 的拍从这一位重新算起。
brief.en: Every tick, output the 3 check bits due after the bits received so far: their carry-less remainder by 1011 with three 0s appended, as a number. On a tick restart is 1, start over from that bit.

hint.zh: 先在纸上把 1101 补上 000，不进位地除以 1011，看每一步余数怎样变。
hint.en: On paper, append 000 to 1101 and divide it by 1011 without carries, watching the remainder at each step.

hint.zh: 三个寄存卡各记一位，就记得下除到这一拍为止的结果。
hint.en: Three registers, a bit each, are enough to hold where the division stands.

hint.zh: 要的是补上三个 0 以后的余数：新来的一位先和结果的最高位比一比，再决定这一步减不减生成式。
hint.en: What is wanted is the remainder with three 0s appended: compare each new bit with the top bit held before deciding whether this step subtracts the generator.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-15"></level-ref>在收的一方算出校验码。这一次换到发送的一方：校验码要紧跟在数据后面送出去。
t.en: <level-ref to="1-15"></level-ref> works out the check at the receiving end. Now the board is the sender, and the check has to follow the data onto the wire.

brief.zh: 把交来的字节从第一拍起逐位送出（最高位在前），紧接着送出它的 3 位校验码。
brief.en: Send the byte handed to you bit by bit from the first tick, top bit first, followed at once by its 3 check bits.

hint.zh: 说到线上的每一位，也要同时交给<part-ref to="crc"></part-ref>。
hint.en: Every bit said on the wire should also go to <part-ref to="crc"></part-ref>.

hint.zh: 字节说完的那一拍，校验码就定了；之后线上的位不该再改变它。
hint.en: The check is settled on the tick the byte is out; the bits on the wire after that must not change it.

hint.zh: 校验码是 0 到 7 的数：它的 3 位排在一个 8 位数的最后。
hint.en: The check is a number from 0 to 7: its 3 bits are the last three of an 8-bit number.

t.zh: <part-ref to="sender"></part-ref>在每帧内容后面带上了校验字节，<part-ref to="deframer"></part-ref>却把它当成又一个内容字节交出去，坏了的帧照样往上送。这一关在收的一方把拆帧和查错合在一起。
t.en: <part-ref to="sender"></part-ref> puts a check byte after each frame's content, but <part-ref to="deframer"></part-ref> hands it on as one more content byte, and broken frames go up all the same. This level puts unwrapping and checking together at the receiving end.

desc.zh: 从进线上拆出每一帧，扣下最后的校验字节：每个内容字节在它后面那个字节收全的那一拍给出，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完的那一拍「帧尾」为 1，「相符」说出这一帧的校验是否相符。其余各拍字节和「相符」是「—」，「收到」「帧尾」为 0。
desc.en: Unwraps each frame off its wire in and holds back the closing check byte: gives each content byte on the tick the byte after it is complete, with got 1; on the tick the closing flag is complete, end is 1 and fits says whether the frame's check fits. On every other tick the byte and fits are 「—」, got and end 0.

brief.zh: 逐个给出每帧的内容字节（校验字节除外）：每个在后一个字节收全的那一拍给出，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完时「帧尾」为 1，「相符」说出这帧的校验是否相符；其余各拍为「—」或 0。
brief.en: Give each frame's content bytes, the check byte aside: each on the tick the byte after it is complete, with got 1. When the closing flag is complete, end is 1 and fits says whether the frame's check fits. On every other tick, 「—」 or 0.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="deframer"></part-ref>交出的每个字节，都可能是最后那个校验字节。
hint.en: Any byte <part-ref to="deframer"></part-ref> gives could be the closing check byte.

hint.zh: 一个字节先留住，等下一个字节收全时再交出去。
hint.en: Hold each byte back until the next one is complete, then pass it on.

hint.zh: 帧尾那一拍，<part-ref to="crchold"></part-ref>收进的应当只有内容字节的位。
hint.en: By the frame's end, <part-ref to="crchold"></part-ref> should have taken in the bits of the content bytes and nothing else.

t.zh: <part-ref to="sender"></part-ref>和<part-ref to="receiver"></part-ref>各管一个方向，每一个要用线的节点都得把两者重新接一遍。把它们装进一块网卡：对上面只收发整帧的字节，对下面只收发线上的位，旗标、填充和校验字节都留在网卡里。这叫<wiki-ref to="layering"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: <part-ref to="sender"></part-ref> and <part-ref to="receiver"></part-ref> each handle one direction, and every node that uses a wire would have to wire the two up again. Put them into one network adapter: it deals in the bytes of whole frames with the layer above and in bits on the wire below, and flags, stuffing and the check byte stay inside it. This is <wiki-ref to="layering"></wiki-ref>.

desc.zh: 往下：交来的帧带上校验字节成帧送到出线上，「发送」为 1 的拍开始一帧，「下一个」为 1 的那一拍取走眼前的字节，「末字节」为 1 的字节是一帧的最后一个。往上：进线上来的帧拆开、核对，每个内容字节在它后面那个字节收全的那一拍给出，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完的那一拍「帧尾」为 1，「相符」说出这一帧的校验是否相符。
desc.en: Down: frames handed to it go out on its wire out, framed with their check byte; a frame begins on a tick send is 1, next is 1 on the tick it takes the byte in front of it, and a byte with last 1 ends its frame. Up: frames off its wire in are unwrapped and checked, each content byte given on the tick the byte after it is complete, with got 1; on the tick the closing flag is complete, end is 1 and fits says whether the frame's check fits.

brief.zh: 搭一块网卡，两个方向同时工作。往下：交来的帧带上校验字节成帧，从出线送出，「发送」为 1 时开始，「下一个」取走队首。往上：进线上的帧拆开、核对，输出的时机同<part-ref to="receiver"></part-ref>。
brief.en: Build a network adapter working both ways at once. Down: frames handed to it go out framed on the wire out with their check byte, starting on a tick send is 1, next taking the byte in front. Up: frames off the wire in are unwrapped and checked, timed as in <part-ref to="receiver"></part-ref>.

hint.zh: 两个方向互不相干，各接各的。
hint.en: The two directions do not touch each other.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-1"></level-ref>的板只能原样照搬：线上来什么，就说什么。要说出和听到的不一样的位，板得能按条件改变一个值。新元件<part-ref to="part:select"></part-ref>按条件在两路之间取一路，<part-ref to="part:const"></part-ref>给出一个固定的数。
t.en: The board of <level-ref to="1-1"></level-ref> can only copy: whatever comes down the wire is what it says. To say a bit other than the one it hears, a board must change a value by a condition. The new part <part-ref to="part:select"></part-ref> picks one of two values by a condition, and <part-ref to="part:const"></part-ref> gives a fixed number.

brief.zh: 每一拍把听到的位反过来说出去：听到 1 说 0，听到 0 说 1。
brief.en: Every tick, say the opposite of the bit you hear: 0 for 1, 1 for 0.

hint.zh: 听到的位本身就可以当作条件。
hint.en: The bit you hear can itself be the condition.

hint.zh: 听到 1 时该说什么、听到 0 时该说什么，各由一个常数给出。
hint.en: What to say on a 1 and what to say on a 0 can each come from a constant.

t.zh: 到这里为止，校验码只用来判断收到的东西是好是坏。这一次每个<wiki-ref to="codeword"></wiki-ref>只有 4 位数据，却带着 3 位校验码。
t.en: So far check bits have only judged whether something arrived intact. This time each <wiki-ref to="codeword"></wiki-ref> carries just 4 data bits, and 3 check bits.

after.zh: 找得出哪一位错了，就改得回来，不必请对方重发：这叫<wiki-ref to="error-correction"></wiki-ref>。
after.en: Knowing which bit is wrong is enough to put it right without asking for it again: this is <wiki-ref to="error-correction"></wiki-ref>.

brief.zh: 线上从第一拍起接连送来 7 位码字：4 位数据加 3 位校验码（生成式 1011），每个最多翻一位。码字最后一位到达的那一拍，输出翻的是第几位（先到的为第 1 位），没翻输出 0。
brief.en: From the first tick, 7-bit codewords come down the wire back to back: 4 data bits, then 3 check bits (generator 1011), with at most one bit flipped in each. On the tick a codeword's last bit arrives, output which bit flipped (the first to arrive is 1), or 0 if none.

hint.zh: 先在纸上算：没有翻位时余数是多少？只翻第 1 位时呢？
hint.en: Work it out on paper first: what is the remainder when nothing flipped? When only bit 1 flipped?

hint.zh: 7 个位置各翻一位，各留下什么余数？
hint.en: Flip each of the 7 positions in turn: what remainder does each leave?

t.zh: <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref>给出的是一个数，<part-ref to="part:select"></part-ref>要的却是是或否：数到几的时候该做什么，还无从判断。新元件<part-ref to="part:equal"></part-ref>说出两个数是否相同。
t.en: <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref> gives a number, but <part-ref to="part:select"></part-ref> wants a yes or no: what to do once the count reaches a value cannot yet be decided. The new part <part-ref to="part:equal"></part-ref> says whether two numbers are the same.

brief.zh: 在第 7、15、23……拍说 1，其余各拍说 0（第一拍是第 0 拍）。
brief.en: Say 1 on ticks 7, 15, 23 and so on, and 0 on every other tick (the first tick is tick 0).

hint.zh: <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref>的「重来」也可以由板自己说了算。
hint.en: The board itself can decide when <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref> restarts.

hint.zh: 数到 7 以后，计数要从 0 重新开始。
hint.en: After 7, the count must start again from 0.

hint.zh: 数到 7 的那一拍发生的事，要到下一拍才能让计数重来。
hint.en: What happens on the tick the count reaches 7 can restart it only on the tick after.

t.zh: <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref>数的是过了几拍。这一次要数的是线上连着来的 1。
t.en: <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref> counts the ticks that pass. This time what must be counted is the 1s in a row on the wire.

brief.zh: 每一拍输出线上已经连着来了几个 1；来的是 0 的那一拍输出 0。
brief.en: Every tick, output how many 1s in a row have come down the wire; output 0 on a tick a 0 arrives.

hint.zh: 什么时候该从 0 数起？
hint.en: When should the count start again from 0?

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-22"></level-ref>数出了连着来的 1，<part-ref to="part:equal"></part-ref>能把一个数变成是或否。这一次两件事合在一起。
t.en: <level-ref to="1-22"></level-ref> counts the 1s in a row, and <part-ref to="part:equal"></part-ref> turns a number into a yes or no. This time the two go together.

brief.zh: 线上连着来到第 5 个 1 的那一拍说 1，其余各拍说 0。
brief.en: Say 1 on the tick that brings the fifth 1 in a row, and 0 on every other tick.

hint.zh: 第 6 个、第 10 个 1 都不是第 5 个。
hint.en: The sixth 1 is not the fifth, and neither is the tenth.

t.zh: <part-ref to="flagspot"></part-ref>在旗标结束的那一拍说 1。旗标标出的是位流里的一个位置，从那里数起，就知道一帧的位走到了哪里。
t.en: <part-ref to="flagspot"></part-ref> says 1 on the tick a flag ends. A flag marks a place in the bit stream, and counting from there tells how far a frame's bits have got.

brief.zh: 每一拍输出上一个旗标结束以后线上又来了几位：旗标结束的那一拍为 0；还没来过旗标时也输出 0。
brief.en: Every tick, output how many bits have come since the last flag ended: 0 on the tick it ends, and 0 before any flag has come.

hint.zh: 旗标还没来过的时候，输出要停在 0。
hint.en: Until a flag has come, the output must stay at 0.

t.zh: 帧的内容里要是本身就有 01111110，<level-ref to="1-13"></level-ref>里收的一方会把它当成旗标，一帧从中间被切断。要把它拆开，就得在内容里多塞一位；多塞的那一拍，别的都得停下等一拍，可<part-ref to="counter"></part-ref>每拍都往前走。这一关先让计数器能停。
t.en: If a frame's content itself holds 01111110, the receiver of <level-ref to="1-13"></level-ref> takes it for a flag and cuts the frame in two. Breaking it up means slipping an extra bit into the content, and on that tick everything else must wait; but <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref> moves on every tick. This level first makes the counter able to stand still.

desc.zh: 比计数器多一个「暂停」：给出自「重来」上一次为 1 起过了几拍，那一拍为 0，「重来」还没为 1 过时从第一拍数起；「暂停」为 1 的拍不算，数停在原处，「重来」同时为 1 时仍为 0。
desc.en: A counter with a hold input: how many ticks since restart was last 1, 0 on that tick and, until restart is first 1, counted from the very first tick; ticks on which hold is 1 do not count and the number stands still, though it is 0 if restart is 1 as well.

brief.zh: 输出自「重来」上一次为 1 起过了几拍：那一拍为 0，「重来」还没为 1 过时从第一拍数起；「暂停」为 1 的拍不算，那一拍的数和上一拍相同。
brief.en: Output how many ticks have passed since restart was last 1: 0 on that tick, and, until restart is first 1, counted from the very first tick. Ticks on which hold is 1 do not count, and on them the number stays as it was.

hint.zh: 「重来」和「暂停」同时为 1 时，「重来」优先。
hint.en: When restart and hold are both 1, restart wins.

hint.zh: 要留到下一拍的值不止一个时，就用几个名字不同的寄存卡。
hint.en: When more than one value has to last until the next tick, use registers with different names.

t.zh: <part-ref to="counterhold"></part-ref>会停了。正在发的字节也要能停：多塞一位的那一拍，字节里该说的那一位留到下一拍。
t.en: <part-ref to="counterhold"></part-ref> can stand still now. The byte being sent must too: on the tick an extra bit goes in, the bit of the byte that was due waits for the next tick.

desc.zh: 比移位发送多一个「暂停」：从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起，把那一拍的字节从最高位起逐位说出，「暂停」为 1 的拍说 0，该说的那一位留到下一拍；8 位说完以后说「—」（线上是 0）。说出最后一位的那一拍「送完」为 1。「开始」再为 1 时重新送。
desc.en: Shift out with a hold input: from the tick start is 1, says the byte of that tick bit by bit from the top; on a tick hold is 1 it says 0 and the bit due waits a tick; after the eighth bit it says 「—」 (0 on a wire). Done is 1 on the tick the last bit is said. Start again sends anew.

brief.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起，把那一拍输入的字节从最高位起逐位说到线上，8 位说完后说 0；「暂停」为 1 的拍说 0，该说的那一位留到下一拍。说出最后一位的那一拍「送完」为 1。
brief.en: From the tick start is 1, say the byte input then on the wire bit by bit from the top, then 0; on a tick hold is 1 say 0, and the bit due waits for the next tick. Done is 1 on the tick the last bit is said.

hint.zh: 「开始」那一拍也可能是「暂停」的拍。
hint.en: The start tick may be a hold tick too.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-40"></level-ref>多塞的 0 不是内容。收的一方也要能停：<part-ref to="deserializer"></part-ref>在那一拍不能收线上的位。
t.en: The 0 slipped in by <level-ref to="1-40"></level-ref> is not content. The receiver must be able to stand still too: on that tick <part-ref to="deserializer"></part-ref> must not take in the wire's bit.

desc.zh: 比按字节收多一个「暂停」：从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起收进线上的 8 位，最高位在前，「暂停」为 1 的拍那一位不收；收满的那一拍给出这个字节，「收完」为 1；其余各拍字节是「—」，「收完」为 0。
desc.en: Shift in with a hold input: from the tick start is 1, takes in 8 bits off its wire in, top bit first, leaving out the bit of every tick hold is 1; on the tick the eighth comes in it gives the byte with done 1; on every other tick the byte is 「—」 and done 0.

brief.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起收进线上的 8 位，最高位在前，「暂停」为 1 的拍那一位不收；收满 8 位的那一拍输出这个字节，「收完」为 1，其余各拍为 0。
brief.en: From the tick start is 1, take in 8 bits off the wire, top bit first, leaving out the bit of any tick hold is 1; on the tick the eighth is taken in, output the byte and make done 1, and 0 on every other tick.

hint.zh: 「开始」那一拍也可能是「暂停」的拍。
hint.en: The start tick may be a hold tick too.

t.zh: 到这里为止，说什么只取决于一根线。这一次板同时听两根线，说出的位由两根线一起决定。
t.en: So far what the board says has depended on one wire. Now it listens to two, and what it says depends on both.

brief.zh: 听两根线：两根线上都是 1 时说 1，否则说 0。
brief.en: Listen to two wires: say 1 when both carry a 1, and 0 otherwise.

hint.zh: 先固定线 A 的值，看线 B 该怎样决定输出。
hint.en: Hold wire A still and see how wire B should decide the output.

hint.zh: 线 A 为 0 时，输出是什么？线 A 为 1 时呢？
hint.en: When wire A is 0, what is the output? And when A is 1?

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-40"></level-ref>送出的帧到了线的另一头。这一次在收的一方：认出旗标，去掉塞进的 0，把位拼回字节。
t.en: Frames like those of <level-ref to="1-40"></level-ref> reach the other end of the wire. Now the board is the receiver: spotting flags, taking out the stuffed 0s and putting the bits back into bytes.

desc.zh: 在进线的位流里认出旗标之间的每一帧，去掉塞进的 0：一个内容字节收全的那一拍给出它，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完的那一拍「帧尾」为 1；其余各拍字节是「—」，「收到」「帧尾」为 0。
desc.en: Finds each frame between flags in the bits on its wire in and takes out the stuffed 0s: gives each content byte on the tick it is complete, with got 1, and makes end 1 on the tick the closing flag is complete; on every other tick the byte is 「—」 and got and end are 0.

brief.zh: 认出线上旗标之间的每一帧，去掉塞进的 0，逐个给出内容字节：字节收全的那一拍输出它，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完的那一拍「帧尾」为 1。其余各拍字节为「—」，两个信号为 0。
brief.en: Find each frame between flags on the wire, take out the stuffed 0s and give the content bytes one by one: output each on the tick it is complete, with got 1; end is 1 on the tick the closing flag is complete. Otherwise the byte is 「—」 and both signals 0.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="deserializerhold"></part-ref>在「暂停」的拍不收线上的位。
hint.en: <part-ref to="deserializerhold"></part-ref> leaves out the wire's bit on hold ticks.

hint.zh: 一个 0 是不是塞进去的，要看它前面连着几个 1。
hint.en: Whether a 0 was stuffed in depends on how many 1s came just before it.

hint.zh: 该停的是第五个 1 后面的那一拍，不是第五个 1 到达的那一拍。
hint.en: The tick to leave out is the one after the fifth 1, not the tick the fifth 1 arrives.

t.zh: 这根线会翻位：收到的位错了，收的一方却毫不知情。最笨的办法是同一份话送两遍，两份不一样，就知道出了错。这叫<wiki-ref to="error-detection"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: This wire flips bits, and a bit that arrives wrong gives no sign of it. The crudest remedy is to say everything twice: when the copies disagree, something went wrong. This is <wiki-ref to="error-detection"></wiki-ref>.

desc.zh: 两位不同为 1，相同为 0；碰到「—」给「—」。
desc.en: 1 when two bits differ, 0 when they agree; 「—」 for 「—」.

brief.zh: 对方把每一位同时说在两根线上，线会翻位：两根线上的位不同时说 1，相同时说 0。
brief.en: The far end says every bit on two wires at once and the wires flip bits: say 1 when the two disagree and 0 when they agree.

hint.zh: <level-ref to="1-2"></level-ref>和<level-ref to="1-3"></level-ref>的做法，这里都用得上。
hint.en: What worked in <level-ref to="1-2"></level-ref> and <level-ref to="1-3"></level-ref> both help here.

hint.zh: 线 A 为 0 时，输出和线 B 是什么关系？线 A 为 1 时呢？
hint.en: When wire A is 0, how does the output relate to wire B? And when A is 1?

t.zh: 送两份要把线占去一倍。省得多的办法只附一位：让连它在内的 1 的个数凑成偶数，叫<wiki-ref to="parity"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: Sending twice takes up the wire twice over. A far cheaper rule appends a single bit that makes the count of 1s, itself included, even: a <wiki-ref to="parity"></wiki-ref>.

brief.zh: 从第一拍起把交来的字节一个接一个送出，中间不留空：每个字节后面跟一个校验位，字节里有奇数个 1 时为 1。
brief.en: From the first tick, send the bytes handed to you back to back, each followed by a parity bit that is 1 when the byte holds an odd number of 1s.

hint.zh: 1 的个数是奇是偶，可以一位一位地跟着记。
hint.en: Whether the count of 1s is odd or even can be tracked bit by bit.

hint.zh: 一个字节连同校验位占 9 拍。
hint.en: A byte with its parity bit takes 9 ticks.

t.zh: 这一次线在一个字节里可能翻两位，正是<level-ref to="1-14"></level-ref>的校验位漏掉的情形。<level-ref to="1-16"></level-ref>送出的校验码查不查得出？
t.en: This time the wire may flip two bits in one byte, just what the parity bit of <level-ref to="1-14"></level-ref> misses. Does the check sent in <level-ref to="1-16"></level-ref> catch it?

after.zh: 相隔正好 7 位的两处翻位，生成式 1011 照样查不出。
after.en: Two flips exactly 7 bits apart still slip past the generator 1011.

brief.zh: 从第一拍起，每个字节后面紧跟它的 3 位校验码，线在一个字节里可能翻两位：每个字节的校验码到齐的那一拍，输出这个字节和校验是否相符。
brief.en: From the first tick, each byte comes followed by its 3 check bits, and the wire may flip two bits in one: on the tick a byte's check is all in, output the byte and whether its check fits.

hint.zh: 一个字节连同校验码占 11 拍。
hint.en: A byte with its check takes 11 ticks.

hint.zh: 完好的字节连同它的校验码一起除，余数是多少？
hint.en: Divide an intact byte together with its check: what remainder is left?

t.zh: 塞进去的 0 不是内容，收的一方算校验码时也不能把它算进去：<part-ref to="crc"></part-ref>也要能停一拍。
t.en: A stuffed 0 is not content, and the receiver must leave it out of the check as well: <part-ref to="crc"></part-ref> must be able to stand still for a tick.

desc.zh: 比 CRC 多一个「暂停」：到这一拍为止收进的位该跟的 3 位校验码（补上三个 0 后不进位地除以 1011 的余数，0 到 7 的数）；「重来」为 1 的那一拍从这一位重新算起，「暂停」为 1 的拍不收这一位，校验码停在原处。
desc.en: A CRC with a hold input: the 3 check bits due after the bits taken in so far (their carry-less remainder by 1011 with three 0s appended, a number from 0 to 7); on a tick restart is 1 it starts over from that bit, and on a tick hold is 1 it leaves that bit out and the check stands still.

brief.zh: 每一拍输出到这一拍为止收到的位该跟的 3 位校验码（补上三个 0 后不进位地除以 1011 的余数）；「重来」为 1 的拍从这一位重新算起，「暂停」为 1 的拍那一位不收进去。
brief.en: Every tick, output the 3 check bits due after the bits received so far (their carry-less remainder by 1011 with three 0s appended); on a tick restart is 1, start over from that bit, and leave out the bit of any tick hold is 1.

hint.zh: 「暂停」那一拍，记下的余数一位也不变。
hint.en: On a hold tick, the remainder held does not change at all.

t.zh: <part-ref to="nic"></part-ref>收得到帧，也核对得了每一帧，发帧的一方却还不知道结果。线那头要听到回话，这叫<wiki-ref to="ack"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: <part-ref to="nic"></part-ref> receives frames and checks each one, but the sender does not know the result yet. The far end needs an answer: an <wiki-ref to="ack"></wiki-ref>.

brief.zh: 进线上每到一帧，就从出线回一个只有一个字节的帧：校验相符回 1，不符回 0。<part-ref to="nic"></part-ref>在「发送」为 1 时取走输入上的字节，不论那是什么；没有回话等着时，「发送」为 0。
brief.en: For every frame that arrives on the wire in, send back a one-byte frame on the wire out: 1 if its check fits, 0 if not. <part-ref to="nic"></part-ref> takes whatever byte is at its input once send is 1, so keep send at 0 until a reply is waiting.

hint.zh: 一帧结束、知道它好坏以后，才有回话可说。
hint.en: There is an answer to give only once a frame has ended and its state is known.

hint.zh: 回话要先留住，等网卡取走。
hint.en: Hold the answer until the adapter takes it.

t.zh: 板上的电路每一拍从头算一遍，算完什么也不留下：上一拍听到了什么，这一拍无从知道。要把一个值留到下一拍，需要一对新元件：<part-ref to="part:keep"></part-ref>把值存进寄存卡，<part-ref to="part:reg"></part-ref>在下一拍读出它。
t.en: The circuit on the board is worked out afresh every tick and keeps nothing afterwards: what it heard the tick before is lost. Keeping a value for the next tick takes a new pair of parts: <part-ref to="part:keep"></part-ref> stores a value in a register, and <part-ref to="part:reg"></part-ref> reads it out the next tick.

brief.zh: 每一拍说出上一拍听到的位；第一拍说 0。
brief.en: Every tick, say the bit heard the tick before; say 0 on the first tick.

hint.zh: 这一拍听到的，要到下一拍才说出去。
hint.en: What is heard this tick is said only on the next.

hint.zh: 存和读靠同一个寄存卡名字配对；第一拍读出的是初值。
hint.en: Keep and Register pair up by the register's name; on the first tick Register gives its start value.

t.zh: <part-ref to="counterhold"></part-ref>和<part-ref to="serializerhold"></part-ref>都能停一拍了。两头再约好塞哪一位、塞在哪里：内容里每连着 5 个 1，发送方就多说一个 0，收的一方再把它去掉，内容里就不会出现旗标。这叫<wiki-ref to="stuffing"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: <part-ref to="counterhold"></part-ref> and <part-ref to="serializerhold"></part-ref> can both stand still for a tick. Now the ends agree on what to slip in and where: after every five 1s in a row in the content the sender says an extra 0, and the receiver takes it out again, so the content never looks like a flag. This is <wiki-ref to="stuffing"></wiki-ref>.

desc.zh: 把交来的字节一帧一帧地送出：「发送」为 1 时开始新的一帧，前后各加旗标 01111110，内容里每连着 5 个 1 多说一个 0；没有开始新帧时线上说旗标。「下一个」为 1 的那一拍取走眼前的字节，「末字节」为 1 的字节是一帧的最后一个。
desc.en: Sends the bytes handed to it frame by frame: a new frame begins while send is 1, with the flag 01111110 at each end and a 0 added after every five 1s in its content; flags fill the wire between frames. Next is 1 on the tick it takes the byte in front of it, and a byte with last 1 ends its frame.

brief.zh: 把交来的每一帧送出，前后各加一个旗标 01111110，只在「发送」为 1 时开始新的一帧；内容里每连着 5 个 1，就多说一个 0。「下一个」取走队首，「末字节」标出帧尾。
brief.en: Send each frame handed to you with a flag 01111110 before and after it, starting a new frame only while send is 1, and add a 0 after every five 1s in a row in the content. Next takes the byte in front; last marks a frame's final byte.

hint.zh: 旗标原样说出，不做填充；填充只管内容。
hint.en: Flags go out as they are, unstuffed; only the content is stuffed.

hint.zh: 多说 0 的那一拍，内容停一拍不走：正在说的那一位留到下一拍。
hint.en: On the tick of the extra 0 the content stands still: the bit that was due waits a tick.

hint.zh: 该不该多说一个 0，要看刚说出去的内容里连着几个 1。
hint.en: Whether an extra 0 is due depends on how many 1s in a row the content has just put on the wire.

t.zh: 到这里为止，校验码护着的只是一个字节，<part-ref to="framer"></part-ref>送出的帧不带校验。一帧有几个字节事先不知道，校验码就放在整帧内容的后面：前面补 5 个 0，凑成一个校验字节。这一关先做发的一方。
t.en: So far a check has guarded a single byte, and the frames <part-ref to="framer"></part-ref> sends carry none. A frame's length is not known in advance, so its check goes after the whole content, with five 0s in front to make a check byte. This level builds the sending end.

desc.zh: 把交来的字节一帧一帧地送出：「发送」为 1 时开始新的一帧，内容后面跟一个校验字节（5 个 0 加内容的 3 位校验码），前后各加旗标 01111110，内容和校验字节里每连着 5 个 1 多说一个 0；没有开始新帧时线上说旗标。「下一个」为 1 的那一拍取走眼前的字节，「末字节」为 1 的字节是一帧的最后一个。
desc.en: Sends the bytes handed to it frame by frame: a new frame begins while send is 1, its content followed by a check byte (five 0s, then the content's 3 check bits), with the flag 01111110 at each end and a 0 added after every five 1s in the content and check byte; flags fill the wire between frames. Next is 1 on the tick it takes the byte in front of it, and a byte with last 1 ends its frame.

brief.zh: 像<level-ref to="1-40"></level-ref>那样送出每一帧，内容后面再跟一个校验字节：5 个 0 加内容的 3 位校验码，一起填充。只在「发送」为 1 时开始新帧。「下一个」取走队首，「末字节」标出帧尾。
brief.en: Send each frame as in <level-ref to="1-40"></level-ref>, its content now followed by a check byte: five 0s, then the content's 3 check bits, stuffed with the rest. Start a new frame only while send is 1. Next takes the byte in front; last marks a frame's final byte.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="framer"></part-ref>只送交给它的字节：校验字节要在最后一个内容字节之后交给它。
hint.en: <part-ref to="framer"></part-ref> sends only the bytes it is given: the check byte has to be given to it after the last content byte.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="crchold"></part-ref>要收的是内容字节本身的位，不是线上带着旗标和填充的位。
hint.en: <part-ref to="crchold"></part-ref> must take in the bits of the content bytes, not the wire's bits with flags and stuffing.

hint.zh: 每一帧的校验码只算这一帧的内容。
hint.en: Each frame's check covers that frame's content only.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-4"></level-ref>里，寄存卡存的是线上来的位。存进去的也可以是板上算出的任何值，下一拍再拿来接着算。
t.en: In <level-ref to="1-4"></level-ref> the register kept the bit off the wire. It can keep anything the board works out, to be worked on again the next tick.

brief.zh: 线上出现 1 之前一直说 0；出现过 1 以后，每一拍都说 1。
brief.en: Say 0 until a 1 has come down the wire, and 1 on every tick after that.

hint.zh: 要记住的是「到现在为止听到过 1 没有」。
hint.en: What has to be remembered is whether a 1 has been heard yet.

hint.zh: 这一拍该说什么，取决于这一拍听到的和上一拍记下的。
hint.en: What to say this tick depends on what is heard now and what was kept last tick.

hint.zh: 听到 1 的那一拍就要说 1，不能等到下一拍。
hint.en: On the very tick a 1 is heard, the board must already say 1, not a tick later.

t.zh: 寄存卡能把一个值留到下一拍，板却还不知道已经过了几拍：手上的元件只能选、只能存，没有一样能让一个数变大。新元件<part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref>给出两个数之和。
t.en: A register keeps a value for the next tick, but the board still cannot tell how many ticks have passed: the parts in hand can only pick and store, and none makes a number grow. The new part <part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref> gives the sum of two numbers.

desc.zh: 自「重来」上一次为 1 起过了几拍：那一拍为 0；「重来」还没为 1 过时从第一拍数起。
desc.en: How many ticks since restart was last 1: 0 on that tick, and, until restart is first 1, counted from the very first tick.

brief.zh: 输出自「重来」上一次为 1 起已经过了几拍：那一拍为 0；「重来」还没为 1 过时，从第一拍数起。
brief.en: Output how many ticks have passed since restart was last 1: 0 on that tick, and, until restart is first 1, counted from the very first tick.

hint.zh: 先不管「重来」，只让输出每拍大一。
hint.en: Leave restart aside at first, and just make the output grow by one each tick.

hint.zh: 「重来」那一拍的数是 0：这是一个选择。
hint.en: On a restart tick the number is 0: that is a choice.

t.zh: 要送过去的是 0 到 255 的数，线一拍却只送一位。一个<wiki-ref to="byte"></wiki-ref>是 8 位的<wiki-ref to="binary"></wiki-ref>，每一位的分量是后一位的两倍；把它拆成位，一拍一位地说出去，叫<wiki-ref to="serial"></wiki-ref>。新元件<part-ref to="part:bit"></part-ref>从一个数里取出指定的一位。
t.en: What must go across is a number from 0 to 255, but the wire carries one bit a tick. A <wiki-ref to="byte"></wiki-ref> is an 8-bit <wiki-ref to="binary"></wiki-ref>, each place worth twice the next; taking it apart and saying it a bit a tick is <wiki-ref to="serial"></wiki-ref>. The new part <part-ref to="part:bit"></part-ref> takes a given bit out of a number.

desc.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起，用 8 拍把那一拍的字节从最高位起逐位说出，之后说「—」（线上是 0）；说出最后一位的那一拍「送完」为 1。「开始」再为 1 时重新送。
desc.en: From the tick start is 1, says the byte of that tick bit by bit from the top over 8 ticks, then 「—」 (0 on a wire); done is 1 on the tick the last bit is said. Start again sends anew.

brief.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起，用 8 拍把那一拍输入的字节从最高位起逐位说到线上，之后说 0；最后一位说出的那一拍，「送完」为 1，其余各拍为 0。
brief.en: From the tick start is 1, say the byte input then on the wire bit by bit from the top over 8 ticks, then say 0; done is 1 on the tick the last bit is said and 0 on every other.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref>说得出从「开始」起过了几拍。
hint.en: <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref> can tell how many ticks have passed since start.

hint.zh: 「开始」之前和 8 位说完以后，线上都要是 0。
hint.en: The wire must be 0 before start and after the eighth bit.

hint.zh: 说到一半时，输入上的字节可能已经换了。
hint.en: Halfway through, the byte on the input may already have changed.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-7"></level-ref>把一个字节拆成位送了出去。这一次换到线的另一头：把一位一位到来的位拼回一个数。
t.en: <level-ref to="1-7"></level-ref> takes a byte apart into bits and sends them. Now the board is at the other end of the wire, putting the bits back into a number as they come.

desc.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起收进线上的 8 位，最高位在前；收满的那一拍给出这个字节，「收完」为 1；其余各拍字节是「—」，「收完」为 0。
desc.en: From the tick start is 1, takes in 8 bits off its wire in, top bit first; on the tick the eighth comes in gives the byte with done 1; on every other tick the byte is 「—」 and done 0.

brief.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起收进线上的 8 位，最高位在前；收满 8 位的那一拍输出这个字节，「收完」为 1，其余各拍为 0。
brief.en: From the tick start is 1, take in the wire's 8 bits, top bit first; on the tick the eighth comes in, output the byte and make done 1, and 0 on every other tick.

hint.zh: 每收进一位，已经攒下的数要怎样变，才能让先到的位分量更大？
hint.en: With each new bit, what must happen to the number held so far, so that earlier bits end up worth more?

hint.zh: 已经收了几位，<part-ref to="counter"></part-ref>数得出来。
hint.en: <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref> can count the bits taken in.

hint.zh: 「开始」那一拍收进的就是第一位，之前攒下的都不算。
hint.en: The bit on the start tick is the first one; whatever was gathered before it does not count.

t.zh: 发送方随时可能开口，而空着的线读出来是 0：一个以 0 开头的字节和安静的线分不出来，收的一方不知道从哪一拍数起。于是两头约好：字节之前先说一个 1，叫<wiki-ref to="start-bit"></wiki-ref>；字节之后说一个 0，叫<wiki-ref to="stop-bit"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: The sender may begin at any tick, and an idle wire reads 0: a byte that begins with 0s looks just like a quiet wire, and the receiver cannot tell where to start counting. So the ends agree that a 1, the <wiki-ref to="start-bit"></wiki-ref>, comes before each byte, and a 0, the <wiki-ref to="stop-bit"></wiki-ref>, after it.

brief.zh: 对方随时可能先说一个 1，再送 8 位，最后说一个 0；每收到一个字节，就在它最后一位到达的那一拍输出它，其余各拍输出「—」。
brief.en: At any tick the far end may say a 1, then 8 bits, then a 0; output each byte on the tick its last bit arrives, and 「—」 on every other tick.

hint.zh: 线空着的时候，来的第一个 1 就是起始位。
hint.en: While the wire is idle, the first 1 to come is a start bit.

hint.zh: 正在收一个字节时，线上的 1 是数据，不是起始位。
hint.en: While a byte is coming in, a 1 on the wire is data, not a start bit.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="deserializer"></part-ref>从「开始」那一拍收进第一位。
hint.en: <part-ref to="deserializer"></part-ref> takes in its first bit on the start tick.

brief.zh: 对方随时可能先说一个 1，再送 8 位，最后说一个 0；每收到一个字节，就在它最后一位到达的那一拍输出它，其余各拍输出「—」。
brief.en: At any tick the far end may say a 1, then 8 bits, then a 0; output each byte on the tick its last bit arrives, and 「—」 on every other tick.

brief.en: From the tick start is 1, say the byte input then on the wire bit by bit from the top over 8 ticks, then say 0; done is 1 on the tick the last bit is said and 0 on every other.

hint.en: <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref> can tell how many ticks have passed since start.

hint.en: Halfway through, the byte on the input may already have changed.

desc.en: From the tick start is 1, says the byte of that tick bit by bit from the top over 8 ticks, then 「—」 (0 on a wire); done is 1 on the tick the last bit is said. Start again sends anew.

brief.en: Output how many ticks have passed since restart was last 1: 0 on that tick, and, until restart is first 1, counted from the very first tick.

Next is 1 on the tick it takes the byte in front of it, and a byte with last 1 ends its frame.

brief.zh: 把交来的每一帧送出，前后各加一个旗标 01111110，只在「发送」为 1 时开始新的一帧；内容里每连着 5 个 1，就多说一个 0。「下一个」取走队首，「末字节」标出帧尾。
brief.en: Send each frame handed to you with a flag 01111110 before and after it, starting a new frame only while send is 1, and add a 0 after every five 1s in a row in the content. Next takes the byte in front; last marks a frame's final byte.

t.zh: <part-ref to="counterhold"></part-ref>和<part-ref to="serializerhold"></part-ref>都能停一拍了。两头再约好塞哪一位、塞在哪里：内容里每连着 5 个 1，发送方就多说一个 0，收的一方再把它去掉，内容里就不会出现旗标。这叫<wiki-ref to="stuffing"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: <part-ref to="counterhold"></part-ref> and <part-ref to="serializerhold"></part-ref> can both stand still for a tick. Now the ends agree on what to slip in and where: after every five 1s in a row in the content the sender says an extra 0, and the receiver takes it out again, so the content never looks like a flag. This is <wiki-ref to="stuffing"></wiki-ref>.

hint.zh: 旗标原样说出，不做填充；填充只管内容。
hint.en: Flags go out as they are, unstuffed; only the content is stuffed.

hint.zh: 多说 0 的那一拍，内容停一拍不走：正在说的那一位留到下一拍。
