Next is 1 on the tick it takes the byte in front of it, and a byte with last 1 ends its frame.

brief.zh: 每一拍说出上一拍听到的位；第一拍说 0。
brief.en: Every tick, say the bit heard the tick before; say 0 on the first tick.

t.zh: 板上的电路每一拍从头算一遍，算完什么也不留下：上一拍听到了什么，这一拍无从知道。要把一个值留到下一拍，需要一对新元件：<part-ref to="part:keep"></part-ref>把值存进寄存卡，<part-ref to="part:reg"></part-ref>在下一拍读出它。
t.en: The circuit on the board is worked out afresh every tick and keeps nothing afterwards: what it heard the tick before is lost. Keeping a value for the next tick takes a new pair of parts: <part-ref to="part:keep"></part-ref> stores a value in a register, and <part-ref to="part:reg"></part-ref> reads it out the next tick.

hint.zh: 这一拍听到的，要到下一拍才说出去。
hint.en: What is heard this tick is said only on the next.

hint.zh: 存和读靠同一个寄存卡名字配对；第一拍读出的是初值。
hint.en: Keep and Register pair up by the register's name; on the first tick Register gives its start value.

brief.zh: 进线上每到一帧，就从出线回一个只有一个字节的帧：校验相符回 1，不符回 0。<part-ref to="nic"></part-ref>在「发送」为 1 时取走输入上的字节，不论那是什么；没有回话等着时，「发送」为 0。
brief.en: For every frame that arrives on the wire in, send back a one-byte frame on the wire out: 1 if its check fits, 0 if not. <part-ref to="nic"></part-ref> takes whatever byte is at its input once send is 1, so keep send at 0 until a reply is waiting.

t.zh: <part-ref to="nic"></part-ref>收得到帧，也核对得了每一帧，发帧的一方却还不知道结果。线那头要听到回话，这叫<wiki-ref to="ack"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: <part-ref to="nic"></part-ref> receives frames and checks each one, but the sender does not know the result yet. The far end needs an answer: an <wiki-ref to="ack"></wiki-ref>.

hint.zh: 一帧结束、知道它好坏以后，才有回话可说。
hint.en: There is an answer to give only once a frame has ended and its state is known.

hint.zh: 回话要先留住，等网卡取走。
hint.en: Hold the answer until the adapter takes it.

brief.zh: 每一拍输出到这一拍为止收到的位该跟的 3 位校验码（补上三个 0 后不进位地除以 1011 的余数）；「重来」为 1 的拍从这一位重新算起，「暂停」为 1 的拍那一位不收进去。
brief.en: Every tick, output the 3 check bits due after the bits received so far (their carry-less remainder by 1011 with three 0s appended); on a tick restart is 1, start over from that bit, and leave out the bit of any tick hold is 1.

t.zh: 塞进去的 0 不是内容，收的一方算校验码时也不能把它算进去：<part-ref to="crc"></part-ref>也要能停一拍。
t.en: A stuffed 0 is not content, and the receiver must leave it out of the check as well: <part-ref to="crc"></part-ref> must be able to stand still for a tick.

hint.zh: 「暂停」那一拍，记下的余数一位也不变。
hint.en: On a hold tick, the remainder held does not change at all.

desc.zh: 比 CRC 多一个「暂停」：到这一拍为止收进的位该跟的 3 位校验码（补上三个 0 后不进位地除以 1011 的余数，0 到 7 的数）；「重来」为 1 的那一拍从这一位重新算起，「暂停」为 1 的拍不收这一位，校验码停在原处。
desc.en: A CRC with a hold input: the 3 check bits due after the bits taken in so far (their carry-less remainder by 1011 with three 0s appended, a number from 0 to 7); on a tick restart is 1 it starts over from that bit, and on a tick hold is 1 it leaves that bit out and the check stands still.

brief.zh: 从第一拍起，每个字节后面紧跟它的 3 位校验码，线在一个字节里可能翻两位：每个字节的校验码到齐的那一拍，输出这个字节和校验是否相符。
brief.en: From the first tick, each byte comes followed by its 3 check bits, and the wire may flip two bits in one: on the tick a byte's check is all in, output the byte and whether its check fits.

t.zh: 这一次线在一个字节里可能翻两位，正是<level-ref to="1-14"></level-ref>的校验位漏掉的情形。<level-ref to="1-16"></level-ref>送出的校验码查不查得出？
t.en: This time the wire may flip two bits in one byte, just what the parity bit of <level-ref to="1-14"></level-ref> misses. Does the check sent in <level-ref to="1-16"></level-ref> catch it?

hint.zh: 一个字节连同校验码占 11 拍。
hint.en: A byte with its check takes 11 ticks.

hint.zh: 完好的字节连同它的校验码一起除，余数是多少？
hint.en: Divide an intact byte together with its check: what remainder is left?

after.zh: 相隔正好 7 位的两处翻位，生成式 1011 照样查不出。
after.en: Two flips exactly 7 bits apart still slip past the generator 1011.

brief.zh: 从第一拍起把交来的字节一个接一个送出，中间不留空：每个字节后面跟一个校验位，字节里有奇数个 1 时为 1。
brief.en: From the first tick, send the bytes handed to you back to back, each followed by a parity bit that is 1 when the byte holds an odd number of 1s.

t.zh: 送两份要把线占去一倍。省得多的办法只附一位：让连它在内的 1 的个数凑成偶数，叫<wiki-ref to="parity"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: Sending twice takes up the wire twice over. A far cheaper rule appends a single bit that makes the count of 1s, itself included, even: a <wiki-ref to="parity"></wiki-ref>.

hint.zh: 1 的个数是奇是偶，可以一位一位地跟着记。
hint.en: Whether the count of 1s is odd or even can be tracked bit by bit.

hint.zh: 一个字节连同校验位占 9 拍。
hint.en: A byte with its parity bit takes 9 ticks.

brief.zh: 对方把每一位同时说在两根线上，线会翻位：两根线上的位不同时说 1，相同时说 0。
brief.en: The far end says every bit on two wires at once and the wires flip bits: say 1 when the two disagree and 0 when they agree.

t.zh: 这根线会翻位：收到的位错了，收的一方却毫不知情。最笨的办法是同一份话送两遍，两份不一样，就知道出了错。这叫<wiki-ref to="error-detection"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: This wire flips bits, and a bit that arrives wrong gives no sign of it. The crudest remedy is to say everything twice: when the copies disagree, something went wrong. This is <wiki-ref to="error-detection"></wiki-ref>.

hint.zh: <level-ref to="1-2"></level-ref>和<level-ref to="1-3"></level-ref>的做法，这里都用得上。
hint.en: What worked in <level-ref to="1-2"></level-ref> and <level-ref to="1-3"></level-ref> both help here.

hint.zh: 线 A 为 0 时，输出和线 B 是什么关系？线 A 为 1 时呢？
hint.en: When wire A is 0, how does the output relate to wire B? And when A is 1?

desc.zh: 两位不同为 1，相同为 0；碰到「—」给「—」。
desc.en: 1 when two bits differ, 0 when they agree; 「—」 for 「—」.

brief.zh: 认出线上旗标之间的每一帧，去掉塞进的 0，逐个给出内容字节：字节收全的那一拍输出它，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完的那一拍「帧尾」为 1。其余各拍字节为「—」，两个信号为 0。
brief.en: Find each frame between flags on the wire, take out the stuffed 0s and give the content bytes one by one: output each on the tick it is complete, with got 1; end is 1 on the tick the closing flag is complete. Otherwise the byte is 「—」 and both signals 0.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-40"></level-ref>送出的帧到了线的另一头。这一次在收的一方：认出旗标，去掉塞进的 0，把位拼回字节。
t.en: Frames like those of <level-ref to="1-40"></level-ref> reach the other end of the wire. Now the board is the receiver: spotting flags, taking out the stuffed 0s and putting the bits back into bytes.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="deserializerhold"></part-ref>在「暂停」的拍不收线上的位。
hint.en: <part-ref to="deserializerhold"></part-ref> leaves out the wire's bit on hold ticks.

hint.zh: 一个 0 是不是塞进去的，要看它前面连着几个 1。
hint.en: Whether a 0 was stuffed in depends on how many 1s came just before it.

hint.zh: 该停的是第五个 1 后面的那一拍，不是第五个 1 到达的那一拍。
hint.en: The tick to leave out is the one after the fifth 1, not the tick the fifth 1 arrives.

desc.zh: 在进线的位流里认出旗标之间的每一帧，去掉塞进的 0：一个内容字节收全的那一拍给出它，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完的那一拍「帧尾」为 1；其余各拍字节是「—」，「收到」「帧尾」为 0。
desc.en: Finds each frame between flags in the bits on its wire in and takes out the stuffed 0s: gives each content byte on the tick it is complete, with got 1, and makes end 1 on the tick the closing flag is complete; on every other tick the byte is 「—」 and got and end are 0.

brief.zh: 听两根线：两根线上都是 1 时说 1，否则说 0。
brief.en: Listen to two wires: say 1 when both carry a 1, and 0 otherwise.

t.zh: 到这里为止，说什么只取决于一根线。这一次板同时听两根线，说出的位由两根线一起决定。
t.en: So far what the board says has depended on one wire. Now it listens to two, and what it says depends on both.

hint.zh: 先固定线 A 的值，看线 B 该怎样决定输出。
hint.en: Hold wire A still and see how wire B should decide the output.

hint.zh: 线 A 为 0 时，输出是什么？线 A 为 1 时呢？
hint.en: When wire A is 0, what is the output? And when A is 1?

brief.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起收进线上的 8 位，最高位在前，「暂停」为 1 的拍那一位不收；收满 8 位的那一拍输出这个字节，「收完」为 1，其余各拍为 0。
brief.en: From the tick start is 1, take in 8 bits off the wire, top bit first, leaving out the bit of any tick hold is 1; on the tick the eighth is taken in, output the byte and make done 1, and 0 on every other tick.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-40"></level-ref>多塞的 0 不是内容。收的一方也要能停：<part-ref to="deserializer"></part-ref>在那一拍不能收线上的位。
t.en: The 0 slipped in by <level-ref to="1-40"></level-ref> is not content. The receiver must be able to stand still too: on that tick <part-ref to="deserializer"></part-ref> must not take in the wire's bit.

hint.zh: 「开始」那一拍也可能是「暂停」的拍。
hint.en: The start tick may be a hold tick too.

desc.zh: 比按字节收多一个「暂停」：从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起收进线上的 8 位，最高位在前，「暂停」为 1 的拍那一位不收；收满的那一拍给出这个字节，「收完」为 1；其余各拍字节是「—」，「收完」为 0。
desc.en: Shift in with a hold input: from the tick start is 1, takes in 8 bits off its wire in, top bit first, leaving out the bit of every tick hold is 1; on the tick the eighth comes in it gives the byte with done 1; on every other tick the byte is 「—」 and done 0.

brief.zh: 从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起，把那一拍输入的字节从最高位起逐位说到线上，8 位说完后说 0；「暂停」为 1 的拍说 0，该说的那一位留到下一拍。说出最后一位的那一拍「送完」为 1。
brief.en: From the tick start is 1, say the byte input then on the wire bit by bit from the top, then 0; on a tick hold is 1 say 0, and the bit due waits for the next tick. Done is 1 on the tick the last bit is said.

t.zh: <part-ref to="counterhold"></part-ref>会停了。正在发的字节也要能停：多塞一位的那一拍，字节里该说的那一位留到下一拍。
t.en: <part-ref to="counterhold"></part-ref> can stand still now. The byte being sent must too: on the tick an extra bit goes in, the bit of the byte that was due waits for the next tick.

hint.zh: 「开始」那一拍也可能是「暂停」的拍。
hint.en: The start tick may be a hold tick too.

desc.zh: 比移位发送多一个「暂停」：从「开始」为 1 的那一拍起，把那一拍的字节从最高位起逐位说出，「暂停」为 1 的拍说 0，该说的那一位留到下一拍；8 位说完以后说「—」（线上是 0）。说出最后一位的那一拍「送完」为 1。「开始」再为 1 时重新送。
desc.en: Shift out with a hold input: from the tick start is 1, says the byte of that tick bit by bit from the top; on a tick hold is 1 it says 0 and the bit due waits a tick; after the eighth bit it says 「—」 (0 on a wire). Done is 1 on the tick the last bit is said. Start again sends anew.

brief.zh: 输出自「重来」上一次为 1 起过了几拍：那一拍为 0，「重来」还没为 1 过时从第一拍数起；「暂停」为 1 的拍不算，那一拍的数和上一拍相同。
brief.en: Output how many ticks have passed since restart was last 1: 0 on that tick, and, until restart is first 1, counted from the very first tick. Ticks on which hold is 1 do not count, and on them the number stays as it was.

t.zh: 帧的内容里要是本身就有 01111110，<level-ref to="1-13"></level-ref>里收的一方会把它当成旗标，一帧从中间被切断。要把它拆开，就得在内容里多塞一位；多塞的那一拍，别的都得停下等一拍，可<part-ref to="counter"></part-ref>每拍都往前走。这一关先让计数器能停。
t.en: If a frame's content itself holds 01111110, the receiver of <level-ref to="1-13"></level-ref> takes it for a flag and cuts the frame in two. Breaking it up means slipping an extra bit into the content, and on that tick everything else must wait; but <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref> moves on every tick. This level first makes the counter able to stand still.

hint.zh: 「重来」和「暂停」同时为 1 时，「重来」优先。
hint.en: When restart and hold are both 1, restart wins.

hint.zh: 要留到下一拍的值不止一个时，就用几个名字不同的寄存卡。
hint.en: When more than one value has to last until the next tick, use registers with different names.

desc.zh: 比计数器多一个「暂停」：给出自「重来」上一次为 1 起过了几拍，那一拍为 0，「重来」还没为 1 过时从第一拍数起；「暂停」为 1 的拍不算，数停在原处，「重来」同时为 1 时仍为 0。
desc.en: A counter with a hold input: how many ticks since restart was last 1, 0 on that tick and, until restart is first 1, counted from the very first tick; ticks on which hold is 1 do not count and the number stands still, though it is 0 if restart is 1 as well.

brief.zh: 每一拍输出上一个旗标结束以后线上又来了几位：旗标结束的那一拍为 0；还没来过旗标时也输出 0。
brief.en: Every tick, output how many bits have come since the last flag ended: 0 on the tick it ends, and 0 before any flag has come.

t.zh: <part-ref to="flagspot"></part-ref>在旗标结束的那一拍说 1。旗标标出的是位流里的一个位置，从那里数起，就知道一帧的位走到了哪里。
t.en: <part-ref to="flagspot"></part-ref> says 1 on the tick a flag ends. A flag marks a place in the bit stream, and counting from there tells how far a frame's bits have got.

hint.zh: 旗标还没来过的时候，输出要停在 0。
hint.en: Until a flag has come, the output must stay at 0.

brief.zh: 线上连着来到第 5 个 1 的那一拍说 1，其余各拍说 0。
brief.en: Say 1 on the tick that brings the fifth 1 in a row, and 0 on every other tick.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-22"></level-ref>数出了连着来的 1，<part-ref to="part:equal"></part-ref>能把一个数变成是或否。这一次两件事合在一起。
t.en: <level-ref to="1-22"></level-ref> counts the 1s in a row, and <part-ref to="part:equal"></part-ref> turns a number into a yes or no. This time the two go together.

hint.zh: 第 6 个、第 10 个 1 都不是第 5 个。
hint.en: The sixth 1 is not the fifth, and neither is the tenth.

brief.zh: 每一拍输出线上已经连着来了几个 1；来的是 0 的那一拍输出 0。
brief.en: Every tick, output how many 1s in a row have come down the wire; output 0 on a tick a 0 arrives.

t.zh: <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref>数的是过了几拍。这一次要数的是线上连着来的 1。
t.en: <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref> counts the ticks that pass. This time what must be counted is the 1s in a row on the wire.

hint.zh: 什么时候该从 0 数起？
hint.en: When should the count start again from 0?

brief.zh: 在第 7、15、23……拍说 1，其余各拍说 0（第一拍是第 0 拍）。
brief.en: Say 1 on ticks 7, 15, 23 and so on, and 0 on every other tick (the first tick is tick 0).

t.zh: <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref>给出的是一个数，<part-ref to="part:select"></part-ref>要的却是是或否：数到几的时候该做什么，还无从判断。新元件<part-ref to="part:equal"></part-ref>说出两个数是否相同。
t.en: <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref> gives a number, but <part-ref to="part:select"></part-ref> wants a yes or no: what to do once the count reaches a value cannot yet be decided. The new part <part-ref to="part:equal"></part-ref> says whether two numbers are the same.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref>的「重来」也可以由板自己说了算。
hint.en: The board itself can decide when <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref> restarts.

hint.zh: 数到 7 以后，计数要从 0 重新开始。
hint.en: After 7, the count must start again from 0.

hint.zh: 数到 7 的那一拍发生的事，要到下一拍才能让计数重来。
hint.en: What happens on the tick the count reaches 7 can restart it only on the tick after.

brief.zh: 线上从第一拍起接连送来 7 位码字：4 位数据加 3 位校验码（生成式 1011），每个最多翻一位。码字最后一位到达的那一拍，输出翻的是第几位（先到的为第 1 位），没翻输出 0。
brief.en: From the first tick, 7-bit codewords come down the wire back to back: 4 data bits, then 3 check bits (generator 1011), with at most one bit flipped in each. On the tick a codeword's last bit arrives, output which bit flipped (the first to arrive is 1), or 0 if none.

t.zh: 到这里为止，校验码只用来判断收到的东西是好是坏。这一次每个<wiki-ref to="codeword"></wiki-ref>只有 4 位数据，却带着 3 位校验码。
t.en: So far check bits have only judged whether something arrived intact. This time each <wiki-ref to="codeword"></wiki-ref> carries just 4 data bits, and 3 check bits.

hint.zh: 先在纸上算：没有翻位时余数是多少？只翻第 1 位时呢？
hint.en: Work it out on paper first: what is the remainder when nothing flipped? When only bit 1 flipped?

hint.zh: 7 个位置各翻一位，各留下什么余数？
hint.en: Flip each of the 7 positions in turn: what remainder does each leave?

after.zh: 找得出哪一位错了，就改得回来，不必请对方重发：这叫<wiki-ref to="error-correction"></wiki-ref>。
after.en: Knowing which bit is wrong is enough to put it right without asking for it again: this is <wiki-ref to="error-correction"></wiki-ref>.

brief.zh: 每一拍把听到的位反过来说出去：听到 1 说 0，听到 0 说 1。
brief.en: Every tick, say the opposite of the bit you hear: 0 for 1, 1 for 0.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-1"></level-ref>的板只能原样照搬：线上来什么，就说什么。要说出和听到的不一样的位，板得能按条件改变一个值。新元件<part-ref to="part:select"></part-ref>按条件在两路之间取一路，<part-ref to="part:const"></part-ref>给出一个固定的数。
t.en: The board of <level-ref to="1-1"></level-ref> can only copy: whatever comes down the wire is what it says. To say a bit other than the one it hears, a board must change a value by a condition. The new part <part-ref to="part:select"></part-ref> picks one of two values by a condition, and <part-ref to="part:const"></part-ref> gives a fixed number.

hint.zh: 听到的位本身就可以当作条件。
hint.en: The bit you hear can itself be the condition.

hint.zh: 听到 1 时该说什么、听到 0 时该说什么，各由一个常数给出。
hint.en: What to say on a 1 and what to say on a 0 can each come from a constant.

brief.zh: 搭一块网卡，两个方向同时工作。往下：交来的帧带上校验字节成帧，从出线送出，「发送」为 1 时开始，「下一个」取走队首。往上：进线上的帧拆开、核对，输出的时机同<part-ref to="receiver"></part-ref>。
brief.en: Build a network adapter working both ways at once. Down: frames handed to it go out framed on the wire out with their check byte, starting on a tick send is 1, next taking the byte in front. Up: frames off the wire in are unwrapped and checked, timed as in <part-ref to="receiver"></part-ref>.

t.zh: <part-ref to="sender"></part-ref>和<part-ref to="receiver"></part-ref>各管一个方向，每一个要用线的节点都得把两者重新接一遍。把它们装进一块网卡：对上面只收发整帧的字节，对下面只收发线上的位，旗标、填充和校验字节都留在网卡里。这叫<wiki-ref to="layering"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: <part-ref to="sender"></part-ref> and <part-ref to="receiver"></part-ref> each handle one direction, and every node that uses a wire would have to wire the two up again. Put them into one network adapter: it deals in the bytes of whole frames with the layer above and in bits on the wire below, and flags, stuffing and the check byte stay inside it. This is <wiki-ref to="layering"></wiki-ref>.

hint.zh: 两个方向互不相干，各接各的。
hint.en: The two directions do not touch each other.

desc.zh: 往下：交来的帧带上校验字节成帧送到出线上，「发送」为 1 的拍开始一帧，「下一个」为 1 的那一拍取走眼前的字节，「末字节」为 1 的字节是一帧的最后一个。往上：进线上来的帧拆开、核对，每个内容字节在它后面那个字节收全的那一拍给出，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完的那一拍「帧尾」为 1，「相符」说出这一帧的校验是否相符。
desc.en: Down: frames handed to it go out on its wire out, framed with their check byte; a frame begins on a tick send is 1, next is 1 on the tick it takes the byte in front of it, and a byte with last 1 ends its frame. Up: frames off its wire in are unwrapped and checked, each content byte given on the tick the byte after it is complete, with got 1; on the tick the closing flag is complete, end is 1 and fits says whether the frame's check fits.

brief.zh: 逐个给出每帧的内容字节（校验字节除外）：每个在后一个字节收全的那一拍给出，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完时「帧尾」为 1，「相符」说出这帧的校验是否相符；其余各拍为「—」或 0。
brief.en: Give each frame's content bytes, the check byte aside: each on the tick the byte after it is complete, with got 1. When the closing flag is complete, end is 1 and fits says whether the frame's check fits. On every other tick, 「—」 or 0.

t.zh: <part-ref to="sender"></part-ref>在每帧内容后面带上了校验字节，<part-ref to="deframer"></part-ref>却把它当成又一个内容字节交出去，坏了的帧照样往上送。这一关在收的一方把拆帧和查错合在一起。
t.en: <part-ref to="sender"></part-ref> puts a check byte after each frame's content, but <part-ref to="deframer"></part-ref> hands it on as one more content byte, and broken frames go up all the same. This level puts unwrapping and checking together at the receiving end.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="deframer"></part-ref>交出的每个字节，都可能是最后那个校验字节。
hint.en: Any byte <part-ref to="deframer"></part-ref> gives could be the closing check byte.

hint.zh: 一个字节先留住，等下一个字节收全时再交出去。
hint.en: Hold each byte back until the next one is complete, then pass it on.

hint.zh: 帧尾那一拍，<part-ref to="crchold"></part-ref>收进的应当只有内容字节的位。
hint.en: By the frame's end, <part-ref to="crchold"></part-ref> should have taken in the bits of the content bytes and nothing else.

desc.zh: 从进线上拆出每一帧，扣下最后的校验字节：每个内容字节在它后面那个字节收全的那一拍给出，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完的那一拍「帧尾」为 1，「相符」说出这一帧的校验是否相符。其余各拍字节和「相符」是「—」，「收到」「帧尾」为 0。
desc.en: Unwraps each frame off its wire in and holds back the closing check byte: gives each content byte on the tick the byte after it is complete, with got 1; on the tick the closing flag is complete, end is 1 and fits says whether the frame's check fits. On every other tick the byte and fits are 「—」, got and end 0.

brief.zh: 把交来的字节从第一拍起逐位送出（最高位在前），紧接着送出它的 3 位校验码。
brief.en: Send the byte handed to you bit by bit from the first tick, top bit first, followed at once by its 3 check bits.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-15"></level-ref>在收的一方算出校验码。这一次换到发送的一方：校验码要紧跟在数据后面送出去。
t.en: <level-ref to="1-15"></level-ref> works out the check at the receiving end. Now the board is the sender, and the check has to follow the data onto the wire.

hint.zh: 说到线上的每一位，也要同时交给<part-ref to="crc"></part-ref>。
hint.en: Every bit said on the wire should also go to <part-ref to="crc"></part-ref>.

hint.zh: 字节说完的那一拍，校验码就定了；之后线上的位不该再改变它。
hint.en: The check is settled on the tick the byte is out; the bits on the wire after that must not change it.

hint.zh: 校验码是 0 到 7 的数：它的 3 位排在一个 8 位数的最后。
hint.en: The check is a number from 0 to 7: its 3 bits are the last three of an 8-bit number.

brief.zh: 每一拍输出到这一拍为止收到的位该跟的 3 位校验码，即这些位补上三个 0 后不进位地除以 1011 的余数；「重来」为 1 的拍从这一位重新算起。
brief.en: Every tick, output the 3 check bits due after the bits received so far: their carry-less remainder by 1011 with three 0s appended, as a number. On a tick restart is 1, start over from that bit.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-14"></level-ref>的校验位只查得出奇数个错位：恰好翻两位时，校验照样相符。
t.en: The parity bit of <level-ref to="1-14"></level-ref> catches only an odd number of flips: with exactly two flipped, it still checks out.

t.zh: 更强的校验把一串位当作一个大数，后面补上几个 0，用<wiki-ref to="carryless"></wiki-ref>除以约好的除数，这个除数叫<wiki-ref to="generator"></wiki-ref>；余数就是跟在数据后面的校验码。这种校验叫<wiki-ref to="crc"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: A stronger check reads a run of bits as one big number, appends a few 0s and divides it, using <wiki-ref to="carryless"></wiki-ref>, by an agreed divisor, the <wiki-ref to="generator"></wiki-ref>; the remainder is the check sent after the data. This check is a <wiki-ref to="crc"></wiki-ref>.

hint.zh: 先在纸上把 1101 补上 000，不进位地除以 1011，看每一步余数怎样变。
hint.en: On paper, append 000 to 1101 and divide it by 1011 without carries, watching the remainder at each step.

hint.zh: 三个寄存卡各记一位，就记得下除到这一拍为止的结果。
hint.en: Three registers, a bit each, are enough to hold where the division stands.

hint.zh: 要的是补上三个 0 以后的余数：新来的一位先和结果的最高位比一比，再决定这一步减不减生成式。
hint.en: What is wanted is the remainder with three 0s appended: compare each new bit with the top bit held before deciding whether this step subtracts the generator.

desc.zh: 到这一拍为止收进的位该跟的 3 位校验码（补上三个 0 后不进位地除以 1011 的余数，0 到 7 的数）；「重来」为 1 的那一拍从这一位重新算起。
desc.en: The 3 check bits due after the bits taken in so far (their carry-less remainder by 1011 with three 0s appended, a number from 0 to 7); on a tick restart is 1 it starts over from that bit.

brief.zh: 从第一拍起，线上接连送来字节，每个后跟一个校验位，使这 9 位里 1 的个数为偶数；线会翻位。每个校验位到达的那一拍，输出收到的字节和校验是否相符，其余各拍为「—」。
brief.en: From the first tick, bytes come down the wire back to back, each followed by a bit that makes the count of 1s in the nine even; the wire flips bits. On the tick each such bit arrives, output the byte received and whether it checks out; 「—」 on every other tick.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-32"></level-ref>在发送的一方附上校验位。这一次换到收的一方：线照样会翻位，每个字节都要核对。
t.en: <level-ref to="1-32"></level-ref> appends the parity bit at the sending end. Now the board is the receiver: the wire still flips bits, and every byte must be checked.

hint.zh: <level-ref to="1-32"></level-ref>里跟着记奇偶的办法，收的一方也用得上。
hint.en: The way <level-ref to="1-32"></level-ref> keeps track of parity works at the receiving end too.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="xor"></part-ref>把记下的奇偶和新来的一位合成新的奇偶。
hint.en: <part-ref to="xor"></part-ref> folds a new bit into the parity kept so far.

hint.zh: 字节一个接一个，中间没有空拍：每 9 拍从头算起。
hint.en: The bytes come back to back with no gap: start afresh every 9 ticks.

brief.zh: 认出线上旗标之间的每一帧，逐个给出内容字节：字节收全的那一拍输出它，「收到」为 1；结尾旗标收完的那一拍「帧尾」为 1；其余各拍两个信号为 0。
brief.en: Find each frame between flags on the wire and give its content bytes one by one: output each on the tick it is complete, with got 1; end is 1 on the tick the closing flag is complete; otherwise both are 0.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-12"></level-ref>送出的帧到了线的另一头。这一次在收的一方：认出旗标，把旗标之间的位拼回字节。
t.en: Frames like those of <level-ref to="1-12"></level-ref> reach the other end of the wire. Now the board is the receiver: spotting flags and putting the bits between them back into bytes.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="deserializer"></part-ref>要从旗标后面的第一位收起。
hint.en: <part-ref to="deserializer"></part-ref> must start at the first bit after a flag.

hint.zh: 结尾旗标的 8 位收齐时，看起来也像收满了一个字节。
hint.en: When the 8 bits of the closing flag are in, they look like a full byte too.

brief.zh: 把交来的每一帧送出，前后各加一个旗标 01111110，只在「发送」为 1 时开始新的一帧。「下一个」取走队首，「末字节」标出帧尾。
brief.en: Send each frame handed to you with a flag 01111110 before and after it, starting a new frame only while send is 1. Next takes the byte in front; last marks a frame's final byte.

t.zh: <part-ref to="flagspot"></part-ref>在位流里认得出旗标。这一次换到发送的一方：给每一帧前后加上旗标再送出去，这叫<wiki-ref to="framing"></wiki-ref>。一帧有几个字节，看队首的「末字节」就知道。上面交下一整帧时才让「发送」为 1；为 0 时队首还没有可送的帧，线上只说旗标。
t.en: <part-ref to="flagspot"></part-ref> spots flags in the bit stream. Now the board is the sender, putting a flag at each end of every frame it sends: this is <wiki-ref to="framing"></wiki-ref>. How many bytes a frame holds shows in the last-byte mark at the head of the queue. The layer above sets send to 1 only once it has handed down a whole frame; while send is 0 there is no frame to send yet, and the wire says only flags.

hint.zh: 旗标就是字节 126。
hint.en: A flag is the byte 126.

hint.zh: 一帧的结尾旗标不能兼作下一帧的开头。
hint.en: A frame's closing flag cannot double as the next frame's opening one.

hint.zh: 没有帧要送的时候，线上可以一直说旗标。
hint.en: While there is no frame to send, the wire may keep saying flags.

brief.zh: 线上连续送来位；每当到这一拍为止最近 8 位是 01111110，就在那一拍输出 1，其余各拍输出 0。
brief.en: Bits keep coming down the wire; output 1 on every tick at which the last 8 bits read 01111110, and 0 on every other.

t.zh: 要送的往往不止一个字节，而是一串字节合成的一<wiki-ref to="frame"></wiki-ref>，有几个字节事先不知道。收的一方只看见不停到来的位，分不出一帧从哪里开始、到哪里结束。两头于是约好一个记号 01111110，叫<wiki-ref to="flag"></wiki-ref>，放在每一帧的开头和结尾；收的一方要在位流里随时认出它。
t.en: What goes across is often not one byte but a <wiki-ref to="frame"></wiki-ref>, a run of bytes whose length is not known in advance. The receiver sees only bits that keep coming, and cannot tell where a frame begins or ends. So the ends agree on a mark, 01111110, the <wiki-ref to="flag"></wiki-ref>, at each end of every frame; the receiver must spot it anywhere in the stream.

hint.zh: 旗标是一个 0，接着六个 1，再接一个 0。
hint.en: A flag is a 0, then six 1s, then a 0.

hint.zh: 数一数到这一拍为止连着来了几个 1，来了 0 就从头数。
hint.en: Count how many 1s in a row have come so far, starting over at each 0.

hint.zh: 那六个 1 前面必须真有一个 0：线一开始就来的 1 不算。
hint.en: The six 1s must really follow a 0: 1s from the very first tick do not count.

desc.zh: 进线上最近收到的 8 位正好是 01111110 的那一拍为 1，其余各拍为 0。
desc.en: 1 on each tick at which the last 8 bits on its wire in read 01111110, 0 on every other.

brief.zh: 把交来的字节依次送出，每个字节前加起始位 1，后加停止位 0；字节送完以后线上一直是 0。说「下一个」为 1 的那一拍取走眼前的字节，下一拍换上后一个。
brief.en: Send the bytes handed to you one after another, each with a start bit 1 before it and a stop bit 0 after; once they are all sent the wire stays 0. Saying next takes the byte in front of you that tick, and the following one shows the tick after.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-9"></level-ref>收的是这样的字节，这一次换到发送的一方。要送的字节排成一队，板只看得见排在最前面的那一个；队伍空了，看到的是「—」。
t.en: <level-ref to="1-9"></level-ref> received bytes like these; now the board is the sender. The bytes to send wait in a queue, and only the one in front can be seen; once the queue is empty, it shows 「—」.

hint.zh: 一个字节连同起始位和停止位，一共占 10 拍。
hint.en: A byte with its start and stop bits takes 10 ticks.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="serializer"></part-ref>只说那 8 位，起始位那一拍要另外说。
hint.en: <part-ref to="serializer"></part-ref> says only the 8 bits; the start bit's tick is up to you.

hint.zh: 队伍空了以后，也不能再说起始位。
hint.en: Once the queue is empty, no more start bits either.

brief.zh: 每一拍把左线上听到的位说到右线上。
brief.en: Every tick, say on the right wire the bit heard on the left wire.

t.zh: 两头之间只有一根线。线上分得出的只有两种状态，记作 0 和 1；两头对它们的约定，就是最初的<wiki-ref to="protocol"></wiki-ref>。线每<wiki-ref to="tick"></wiki-ref>送一<wiki-ref to="bit"></wiki-ref>，从一头说出，过几拍才到另一头，中间隔的拍数叫<wiki-ref to="delay"></wiki-ref>。这块板夹在两根线中间。
t.en: There is only a wire between the two ends. It shows just two states, written 0 and 1, and what the ends agree they mean is their first <wiki-ref to="protocol"></wiki-ref>. The wire carries one <wiki-ref to="bit"></wiki-ref> a <wiki-ref to="tick"></wiki-ref>: said at one end, it reaches the other some ticks later, and the ticks in between are the wire's <wiki-ref to="delay"></wiki-ref>. This board sits between two wires.

hint.zh: 这一关不必放任何元件。
hint.en: No parts are needed here.

hint.zh: 从左线的输出口拉一根连线，接到右线上。
hint.en: Draw a connection from the left wire's output to the right wire.

why: Every task has an id (vocabulary 3): a level’s one task takes the level’s id.
